 129def help_lines(
 130    self: Canvas,
 131    pos: PointType | None = None,
 132    width: float | None = None,
 133    height: float | None = None,
 134    spacing: float | None = None,
 135    cs_size: float | None = None,
 136    deferred: bool = False,
 137    **kwargs: object,
 138) -> Self:
 139    """Draw a square grid, and optionally the coordinate axes.
 140
 141    When ``deferred`` is true, or when ``pos``, ``width``, and ``height``
 142    are omitted, a ``HelpLinesSketch`` is stored and clipped to the
 143    canvas at save time. Omitted size with ``deferred`` false uses the
 144    current canvas matrix. Otherwise the grid is drawn immediately, and
 145    the coordinate system is drawn when ``cs_size`` is greater than 0.
 146
 147    Args:
 148        pos: Lower-left corner of the grid.
 149        width: Length of the grid along the x-axis.
 150        height: Length of the grid along the y-axis.
 151        spacing: Distance between grid lines.
 152        cs_size: Length of the coordinate axes. Used when ``deferred``
 153            is false.
 154        deferred: If true, store a help-lines sketch instead of drawing.
 155        **kwargs: Style overrides for the grid and axes.
 156
 157    Returns:
 158        Self: The canvas.
 159
 160    Examples:
 161        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 162        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
 163        >>> canvas.help_lines((0, 0), 20, 20, spacing=40, cs_size=0, deferred=False) is canvas
 164        True
 165        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) > 0
 166        True
 167    """
 168    if deferred or (pos is None and width is None and height is None):
 169        matrix = (
 170            identity_matrix() if deferred else self._xform_matrix.copy()
 171        )
 172        style_source = SimpleNamespace(type=Types.SKETCH)
 173
 174        grid_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
 175        if "line_width" not in grid_kwargs:
 176            grid_kwargs["line_width"] = runtime_defaults["grid_line_width"]
 177        if "line_color" not in grid_kwargs and "color" not in grid_kwargs:
 178            grid_kwargs["line_color"] = runtime_defaults["grid_line_color"]
 179        if "line_dash_array" not in grid_kwargs:
 180            grid_kwargs["line_dash_array"] = runtime_defaults[
 181                "grid_line_dash_array"
 182            ]
 183        grid_style = self.resolve_style_properties(
 184            style_source,
 185            line_style_map,
 186            **grid_kwargs,
 187        )
 188
 189        if "colors" in kwargs:
 190            x_axis_color, y_axis_color = kwargs["colors"]
 191        else:
 192            x_axis_color = runtime_defaults["CS_x_color"]
 193            y_axis_color = runtime_defaults["CS_y_color"]
 194
 195        axis_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
 196        if "line_width" not in axis_kwargs:
 197            axis_kwargs["line_width"] = runtime_defaults["CS_line_width"]
 198        x_axis_kwargs = dict(axis_kwargs)
 199        x_axis_kwargs["line_color"] = x_axis_color
 200        x_axis_style = self.resolve_style_properties(
 201            style_source,
 202            line_style_map,
 203            **x_axis_kwargs,
 204        )
 205        y_axis_kwargs = dict(axis_kwargs)
 206        y_axis_kwargs["line_color"] = y_axis_color
 207        y_axis_style = self.resolve_style_properties(
 208            style_source,
 209            line_style_map,
 210            **y_axis_kwargs,
 211        )
 212
 213        if "line_color" in kwargs:
 214            origin_color = kwargs["line_color"]
 215        elif "color" in kwargs:
 216            origin_color = kwargs["color"]
 217        else:
 218            origin_color = runtime_defaults["CS_origin_color"]
 219        origin_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
 220        origin_kwargs["color"] = origin_color
 221        origin_kwargs["fill"] = True
 222        origin_kwargs["stroke"] = True
 223        origin_style = self.resolve_style_properties(
 224            style_source,
 225            shape_style_map,
 226            **origin_kwargs,
 227        )
 228
 229        sketch = HelpLinesSketch(
 230            spacing,
 231            cs_size,
 232            grid_style,
 233            x_axis_style,
 234            y_axis_style,
 235            origin_style,
 236            runtime_defaults["CS_origin_size"],
 237            xform_matrix=matrix,
 238        )
 239        self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
 240    else:
 241        self.grid(pos, width, height, spacing, **kwargs)
 242        if cs_size > 0:
 243            self.draw_CS(cs_size, **kwargs)
 244    return self

 247@alias_argument({"radius_x": "rx", "radius_y": "ry"})
 248def arc(
 249    self: Canvas,
 250    center: PointType,
 251    radius_x: float,
 252    radius_y: float | None = None,
 253    start_angle: float = 0,
 254    span_angle: float | None = None,
 255    rot_angle: float = 0,
 256    n_points: int | None = None,
 257    *,
 258    end_angle: float | None = None,
 259    clockwise: bool = False,
 260    **kwargs: object,
 261) -> Self:
 262    """Draw an elliptic arc from ``start_angle`` through ``span_angle``
 263    or ``end_angle``.
 264
 265    Args:
 266        center: Center of the arc.
 267        radius_x: Radius along the local x-axis.
 268        radius_y: Radius along the local y-axis; defaults to ``radius_x``.
 269        start_angle: Start angle in radians. Defaults to 0.
 270        span_angle: Sweep in radians. A negative value draws clockwise.
 271            Mutually exclusive with ``end_angle``. At least one of
 272            ``span_angle`` or ``end_angle`` is required.
 273        rot_angle: Rotation of the arc about ``center``, in radians.
 274        n_points: Number of samples along the arc.
 275        end_angle: Ending angle in radians. Mutually exclusive with
 276            ``span_angle``.
 277        clockwise: If True, the arc is drawn clockwise. Defaults to False.
 278        **kwargs: Style overrides for the arc sketch.
 279
 280    Returns:
 281        Self: The canvas.
 282
 283    Examples:
 284        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 285        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
 286        >>> canvas.arc((0, 0), 10, 10, 0, sg.pi / 2, 0) is canvas
 287        True
 288        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[-1].subtype.name
 289        'ARC_SKETCH'
 290    """
 291    if radius_y is None:
 292        radius_y = radius_x
 293    signed_span = resolve_arc_sweep(
 294        start_angle,
 295        span_angle,
 296        end_angle,
 297        clockwise,
 298    )
 299    vertices = _elliptic_arc_points_from_signed(
 300        center, radius_x, radius_y, start_angle, signed_span, n_points
 301    )
 302    if rot_angle != 0:
 303        vertices = homogenize(vertices) @ rotation_matrix(rot_angle, center)
 304    self._all_vertices.extend(vertices.tolist() + [center])
 305
 306    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
 307    sketch = ArcSketch(
 308        vertices=vertices, xform_matrix=self._sketch_xform_matrix
 309    )
 310    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
 311    resolved = self.resolve_style_properties(sketch, shape_style_map, **kwargs)
 312    for attrib_name, attrib_value in resolved.items():
 313        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
 314
 315    for k, v in kwargs.items():
 316        if k not in _PRECEDENCE_KEYS:
 317            setattr(sketch, k, v)
 318    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
 319
 320    return self

 323def bezier(
 324    self: Canvas, control_points: Sequence[PointType], **kwargs: object
 325) -> Self:
 326    """Draw a Bezier curve through the given control points.
 327
 328    Args:
 329        control_points: Control points of the curve, in walk order.
 330        **kwargs: Style overrides for the curve sketch.
 331
 332    Returns:
 333        Self: The canvas.
 334
 335    Examples:
 336        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 337        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
 338        >>> canvas.bezier([(0, 0), (20, 40), (40, 0)]) is canvas
 339        True
 340        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
 341        1
 342    """
 343    self._all_vertices.extend(control_points)
 344    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
 345    sketch = BezierSketch(control_points, self._sketch_xform_matrix)
 346    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
 347    resolved = self.resolve_style_properties(sketch, shape_style_map, **kwargs)
 348    for attrib_name, attrib_value in resolved.items():
 349        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
 350
 351    for k, v in kwargs.items():
 352        if k not in _PRECEDENCE_KEYS:
 353            setattr(sketch, k, v)
 354    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
 355    return self

 358def _circle_sketch(
 359    center: PointType, radius: float, matrix: object
 360) -> CircleSketch | EllipseSketch:
 361    """Return a circle sketch, or an ellipse when the axis scales differ.
 362
 363    Examples:
 364        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 365        >>> from simetri.render.draw import _circle_sketch
 366        >>> _circle_sketch((0, 0), 10, sg.identity_matrix()).subtype.name
 367        'CIRCLE_SKETCH'
 368    """
 369    _, _, scale = decompose_transformations(matrix)
 370    scale_x = float(scale[0])
 371    scale_y = float(scale[1])
 372    if abs(scale_x - scale_y) > runtime_defaults["abs_tol"]:
 373        return EllipseSketch(center, radius, radius, 0, matrix)
 374    return CircleSketch(center, radius, matrix)
 375

 377def circle(
 378    self: Canvas, radius: float, center: PointType = (0, 0), **kwargs: object
 379) -> Self:
 380    """Draw a circle with the given radius and optional center.
 381
 382    Args:
 383        radius: Radius of the circle.
 384        center: Center of the circle. Defaults to ``(0, 0)``.
 385        **kwargs: Style overrides for the circle sketch.
 386
 387    Returns:
 388        Self: The canvas.
 389
 390    Examples:
 391        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 392        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
 393        >>> canvas.circle(10, (0, 0)) is canvas
 394        True
 395        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[-1].subtype.name
 396        'CIRCLE_SKETCH'
 397    """
 398    x, y = center[:2]
 399    p1 = x - radius, y - radius
 400    p2 = x + radius, y + radius
 401    p3 = x - radius, y + radius
 402    p4 = x + radius, y - radius
 403    self._all_vertices.extend([p1, p2, p3, p4])
 404    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
 405    sketch = _circle_sketch(center, radius, self._sketch_xform_matrix)
 406    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
 407    resolved = self.resolve_style_properties(sketch, shape_style_map, **kwargs)
 408    for attrib_name, attrib_value in resolved.items():
 409        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
 410
 411    for k, v in kwargs.items():
 412        if k not in _PRECEDENCE_KEYS:
 413            setattr(sketch, k, v)
 414    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
 415
 416    return self

 419def ellipse(
 420    self: Canvas,
 421    width: float,
 422    height: float,
 423    center: PointType = (0, 0),
 424    angle: float = 0,
 425    **kwargs: object,
 426) -> Self:
 427    """Draw an ellipse with the given width, height, and optional center.
 428
 429    Args:
 430        width: Full width. The x-radius is ``width / 2``.
 431        height: Full height. The y-radius is ``height / 2``.
 432        center: Center of the ellipse. Defaults to ``(0, 0)``.
 433        angle: Rotation of the ellipse in radians. Defaults to 0.
 434        **kwargs: Style overrides for the ellipse sketch.
 435
 436    Returns:
 437        Self: The canvas.
 438
 439    Examples:
 440        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 441        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
 442        >>> canvas.ellipse(20, 40) is canvas
 443        True
 444        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[-1].subtype.name
 445        'ELLIPSE_SKETCH'
 446    """
 447    x, y = center[:2]
 448    x_radius = width / 2
 449    y_radius = height / 2
 450    p1 = x - x_radius, y - y_radius
 451    p2 = x + x_radius, y + y_radius
 452    p3 = x - x_radius, y + y_radius
 453    p4 = x + x_radius, y - y_radius
 454    self._all_vertices.extend([p1, p2, p3, p4])
 455    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
 456    sketch = EllipseSketch(
 457        center, x_radius, y_radius, angle, self._sketch_xform_matrix
 458    )
 459    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
 460    resolved = self.resolve_style_properties(sketch, shape_style_map, **kwargs)
 461    for attrib_name, attrib_value in resolved.items():
 462        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
 463
 464    for k, v in kwargs.items():
 465        if k not in _PRECEDENCE_KEYS:
 466            setattr(sketch, k, v)
 467    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
 468
 469    return self

 472def text(
 473    self: Canvas,
 474    txt: str,
 475    pos: PointType,
 476    font_family: str | None = None,
 477    font_size: int | None = None,
 478    font_color: Color | None = None,
 479    anchor: Anchor | None = None,
 480    align: Align | None = None,
 481    **kwargs: object,
 482) -> Self:
 483    """Draw text at the given position.
 484
 485    Args:
 486        txt: Text to draw.
 487        pos: Position of the text.
 488        font_family: Font family. None uses the default.
 489        font_size: Font size. None uses the default.
 490        font_color: Color of the text. None uses the default.
 491        anchor: Anchor of the text. None uses the default.
 492        align: Alignment of the text. None uses the default.
 493        **kwargs: Style overrides forwarded to the text tag.
 494
 495    Returns:
 496        Self: The canvas.
 497
 498    Examples:
 499        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 500        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
 501        >>> canvas.text("A", (0, 0)) is canvas
 502        True
 503        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
 504        1
 505    """
 506    # first create a Tag object
 507    tag_obj = Tag(
 508        txt,
 509        pos,
 510        font_family=font_family,
 511        font_size=font_size,
 512        font_color=font_color,
 513        anchor=anchor,
 514        align=align,
 515        **kwargs,
 516    )
 517    tag_obj.draw_frame = False
 518    # extend vertices with the Tag's bounding box
 519    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
 520    extend_vertices(self, tag_obj)
 521    sketch = create_sketch(tag_obj, self, **kwargs)
 522    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
 523    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
 524
 525    return self

 528def text_path(
 529    self: Canvas,
 530    txt: str,
 531    path: Path2D | Shape,
 532    font_family: str | None = None,
 533    font_size: int | None = None,
 534    font_color: Color | None = None,
 535    bold: bool = False,
 536    italic: bool = False,
 537    draw_path: bool = False,
 538    **kwargs: object,
 539) -> Self:
 540    """Draw text along a path.
 541
 542    Args:
 543        txt: Text to place on the path.
 544        path: A ``Path2D`` or ``Shape``.
 545        font_family: Font family. None uses the default.
 546        font_size: Font size. None uses the default.
 547        font_color: Color of the text. None uses the default.
 548        bold: Bold type. Defaults to False.
 549        italic: Italic type. Defaults to False.
 550        draw_path: If True, also stroke the guide path. Defaults to False.
 551        **kwargs: Extra attributes stored on the ``TextPath``.
 552
 553    Returns:
 554        Self: The canvas.
 555
 556    Examples:
 557        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 558        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
 559        >>> curve = sg.Path2D((0, 0)).line_to((80, 0))
 560        >>> canvas.text_path("along", curve) is canvas
 561        True
 562        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[-1].subtype.name
 563        'TEXT_PATH_SKETCH'
 564    """
 565    item = TextPath(
 566        txt,
 567        path,
 568        font_family=font_family,
 569        font_size=font_size,
 570        font_color=font_color,
 571        bold=bold,
 572        italic=italic,
 573        draw_path=draw_path,
 574        **kwargs,
 575    )
 576    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
 577    extend_vertices(self, item)
 578    sketch = create_sketch(item, self)
 579    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
 580    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
 581    return self

 584def line(
 585    self: Canvas, start: PointType, end: PointType, **kwargs: object
 586) -> Self:
 587    """Draw a line segment from start to end.
 588
 589    Args:
 590        start: Starting point of the line.
 591        end: Ending point of the line.
 592        **kwargs: Style overrides for the line.
 593
 594    Returns:
 595        Self: The canvas.
 596
 597    Examples:
 598        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 599        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
 600        >>> canvas.line((0, 0), (40, 0)) is canvas
 601        True
 602        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
 603        1
 604    """
 605    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
 606    line_shape = Shape([start, end], closed=False, **kwargs)
 607    extend_vertices(self, line_shape)
 608    line_sketch = create_sketch(line_shape, self, **kwargs)
 609    self.active_page.sketches.append(line_sketch)
 610    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
 611    return self

 614def rectangle(
 615    self: Canvas,
 616    width: float,
 617    height: float,
 618    center: PointType = (0, 0),
 619    angle: float = 0,
 620    **kwargs: object,
 621) -> Self:
 622    """Draw a rectangle with the given width, height, and optional center.
 623
 624    Args:
 625        width: Width of the rectangle.
 626        height: Height of the rectangle.
 627        center: Center of the rectangle. Defaults to ``(0, 0)``.
 628        angle: Rotation about ``center``, in radians. Defaults to 0.
 629        **kwargs: Style overrides for the rectangle.
 630
 631    Returns:
 632        Self: The canvas.
 633
 634    Examples:
 635        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 636        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
 637        >>> canvas.rectangle(40, 60) is canvas
 638        True
 639        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
 640        1
 641    """
 642    x, y = center[:2]
 643    w2 = width / 2
 644    h2 = height / 2
 645    p1 = x - w2, y + h2
 646    p2 = x - w2, y - h2
 647    p3 = x + w2, y - h2
 648    p4 = x + w2, y + h2
 649    points = homogenize([p1, p2, p3, p4]) @ rotation_matrix(angle, center)
 650    rect_shape = Shape(points.tolist(), closed=True, **kwargs)
 651    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
 652    extend_vertices(self, rect_shape)
 653    rect_sketch = create_sketch(rect_shape, self, **kwargs)
 654    self.active_page.sketches.append(rect_sketch)
 655    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
 656
 657    return self

 660def draw_CS(self: Canvas, size: float | None = None, **kwargs: object) -> Self:
 661    """Draw the coordinate axes and an origin marker.
 662
 663    ``size`` None uses ``runtime_defaults["CS_size"]``. ``kwargs["colors"]`` is
 664    ``(x_color, y_color)`` for the two axes.
 665
 666    Args:
 667        size: Length of each axis.
 668        **kwargs: Style overrides. ``colors`` selects the axis colors.
 669
 670    Returns:
 671        Self: The canvas.
 672
 673    Examples:
 674        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 675        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
 676        >>> canvas.draw_CS(10) is canvas
 677        True
 678        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) >= 2
 679        True
 680    """
 681    if size is None:
 682        size = runtime_defaults["CS_size"]
 683    if "colors" in kwargs:
 684        x_color, y_color = kwargs["colors"]
 685        del kwargs["colors"]
 686    else:
 687        x_color = runtime_defaults["CS_x_color"]
 688        y_color = runtime_defaults["CS_y_color"]
 689    if "line_width" not in kwargs:
 690        kwargs["line_width"] = runtime_defaults["CS_line_width"]
 691    self.line((0, 0), (size, 0), line_color=x_color, **kwargs)
 692    self.line((0, 0), (0, size), line_color=y_color, **kwargs)
 693    if "line_color" not in kwargs:
 694        kwargs["line_color"] = runtime_defaults["CS_origin_color"]
 695    self.circle(radius=runtime_defaults["CS_origin_size"], **kwargs)
 696
 697    return self
 698

 700def lines(self: Canvas, points: Sequence[PointType], **kwargs: object) -> Self:
 701    """Draw connected line segments through the given points.
 702
 703    Args:
 704        points: Points in walk order.
 705        **kwargs: Style overrides for the line sketch.
 706
 707    Returns:
 708        Self: The canvas.
 709
 710    Examples:
 711        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 712        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
 713        >>> canvas.lines([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 20)]) is canvas
 714        True
 715        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
 716        1
 717    """
 718    self._all_vertices.extend(points)
 719    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
 720    sketch = LineSketch(points, self._sketch_xform_matrix, **kwargs)
 721    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
 722    for attrib_name in line_style_map:
 723        attrib_value = self.resolve_property(sketch, attrib_name)
 724        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
 725    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
 726
 727    return self

 729
 730def _measure_latex_formula(
 731    formula: str,
 732    font_size: int,
 733    font_family: str | None,
 734    bold: bool,
 735) -> tuple[float, float]:
 736    """Return the rendered size of a math formula.
 737
 738    Args:
 739        formula: LaTeX math string without surrounding dollar signs.
 740        font_size: Font size in points.
 741        font_family: Mathtext font family, or None for the current default.
 742        bold: If true, wrap the formula in ``\\boldsymbol``.
 743
 744    Returns:
 745        tuple[float, float]: Width and height in points.
 746    """
 747    import io
 748    import re
 749
 750    import matplotlib
 751
 752    _FONTSET_MAP = {
 753        "computer modern": "cm",
 754        "cm": "cm",
 755        "stix": "stix",
 756        "stix sans": "stixsans",
 757        "stixsans": "stixsans",
 758        "dejavu sans": "dejavusans",
 759        "dejavusans": "dejavusans",
 760        "dejavu": "dejavusans",
 761        "dejavu serif": "dejavuserif",
 762        "dejavuserif": "dejavuserif",
 763    }
 764    _TEXT_MODE_MAP = [
 765        (r"\mbox", r"\mathrm"),
 766        (r"\texttt", r"\mathtt"),
 767        (r"\textrm", r"\mathrm"),
 768        (r"\textbf", r"\mathbf"),
 769        (r"\textit", r"\mathit"),
 770        (r"\textsf", r"\mathsf"),
 771    ]
 772
 773    if bold:
 774        formula = rf"\boldsymbol{{{formula}}}"
 775    for src, dst in _TEXT_MODE_MAP:
 776        formula = formula.replace(src, dst)
 777    if not font_family:
 778        font_family = "cm"
 779
 780    fontset = _FONTSET_MAP.get((font_family or "").strip().lower())
 781    rc_overrides = {"mathtext.fontset": fontset} if fontset else {}
 782
 783    with matplotlib.rc_context(rc_overrides):
 784        fig = matplotlib.pyplot.figure(figsize=(0.01, 0.01), dpi=72)
 785        fig.text(0, 0, f"${formula}$", fontsize=font_size, usetex=False)
 786        buf = io.StringIO()
 787        fig.savefig(
 788            buf,
 789            format="svg",
 790            bbox_inches="tight",
 791            transparent=True,
 792            pad_inches=0.05,
 793        )
 794        matplotlib.pyplot.close(fig)
 795
 796    svg_str = buf.getvalue()
 797    w_match = re.search(r'<svg[^>]*\bwidth="([\d.]+)pt"', svg_str)
 798    h_match = re.search(r'<svg[^>]*\bheight="([\d.]+)pt"', svg_str)
 799    W = float(w_match.group(1)) if w_match else 100.0
 800    H = float(h_match.group(1)) if h_match else 20.0
 801    return W, H
 802
 803
 804def draw_latex(
 805    self: Canvas,
 806    formula: str,
 807    pos: PointType,
 808    font_size: int = 14,
 809    font_family: str | None = None,
 810    font_color: Color | str | Sequence[float] | None = None,
 811    bold: bool = False,
 812    anchor: Anchor | None = None,
 813    **kwargs: object,
 814) -> Self:
 815    """Draw a LaTeX math formula on the canvas using matplotlib mathtext (no TeX compiler needed).
 816
 817    Args:
 818        formula (str): LaTeX math string without surrounding $. E.g. r'\\frac{a}{b}'.
 819            Text-mode commands are silently mapped to their math-mode equivalents:
 820            \\mbox and \\textrm → \\mathrm, \\texttt → \\mathtt
 821            (monospace), \\textbf → \\mathbf, \\textit → \\mathit,
 822            \\textsf → \\mathsf.
 823        pos (PointType): Canvas position of the formula anchor.
 824        font_size (int): Font size in points. Defaults to 14.
 825        font_family (str, optional): Mathtext fontset — 'computer modern'/'cm', 'stix',
 826            'stix sans'/'stixsans', 'dejavu sans'/'dejavusans', 'dejavu serif'/'dejavuserif'.
 827            If omitted, Computer Modern is used to match LaTeX's default
 828            math font.
 829        font_color: Formula colour — simetri Color, (r,g,b) tuple, or matplotlib colour
 830            string (e.g. 'red', '#ff0000'). Defaults to black.
 831        bold (bool): Wrap the *entire* formula in \\mathbf{}. For partial bold, write
 832            \\mathbf{} directly in the formula string.
 833            Defaults to False.
 834        anchor (Anchor, optional): Anchor point. Defaults to Anchor.SOUTHWEST.
 835        **kwargs: Style overrides applied to the formula sketch.
 836
 837    Returns:
 838        Self: The canvas object.
 839
 840    Examples:
 841        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
 842        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
 843        >>> canvas.draw_latex("x", (0, 0), visible=False) is canvas
 844        True
 845        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[-1].visible
 846        False
 847    """
 848    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
 849    sketch = LatexSketch(
 850        formula=formula,
 851        pos=pos,
 852        font_size=font_size,
 853        font_family=font_family,
 854        font_color=font_color,
 855        bold=bold,
 856        anchor=anchor,
 857        xform_matrix=self._sketch_xform_matrix,
 858    )
 859    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
 860    for name, value in kwargs.items():
 861        setattr(sketch, name, value)
 862    # Measure the formula's rendered bounding box so we can register the
 863    # correct canvas extents in _all_vertices.
 864    W, H = _measure_latex_formula(formula, sketch.font_size, font_family, bold)
 865    sketch.formula_size = (W, H)
 866
 867    # Compute the anchor offset within the formula box (same table as svg.py)
 868    _anchor_offsets = {
 869        Anchor.SOUTHWEST: (0, 0),
 870        Anchor.SOUTH: (W / 2, 0),
 871        Anchor.BOTTOM: (W / 2, 0),
 872        Anchor.SOUTHEAST: (W, 0),
 873        Anchor.WEST: (0, H / 2),
 874        Anchor.LEFT: (0, H / 2),
 875        Anchor.CENTER: (W / 2, H / 2),
 876        Anchor.MIDPOINT: (W / 2, H / 2),
 877        Anchor.EAST: (W, H / 2),
 878        Anchor.RIGHT: (W, H / 2),
 879        Anchor.NORTHWEST: (0, H),
 880        Anchor.NORTH: (W / 2, H),
 881        Anchor.TOP: (W / 2, H),
 882        Anchor.NORTHEAST: (W, H),
 883    }
 884    resolved_anchor = anchor if anchor is not None else Anchor.SOUTHWEST
 885    ax, ay = _anchor_offsets.get(resolved_anchor, (0, 0))
 886
 887    # sketch.pos is already in transformed canvas-space (xform_matrix applied)
 888    sx, sy = sketch.pos[:2]
 889    # All four corners of the formula box in canvas-space (y-up)
 890    self._all_vertices.extend(
 891        [
 892            (sx - ax, sy - ay),  # SW
 893            (sx + W - ax, sy - ay),  # SE
 894            (sx - ax, sy + H - ay),  # NW
 895            (sx + W - ax, sy + H - ay),  # NE
 896        ]
 897    )
 898    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
 899    return self
 900

 902def _tag_latex_formula(text: object) -> str | None:
 903    """Return the formula inside a dollar-delimited Tag, otherwise None."""
 904    if not isinstance(text, str):
 905        return None
 906    if len(text) >= 2 and text.startswith("$") and text.endswith("$"):
 907        return text[1:-1]
 908    return None

 961def _bbox_feature_style(option: object) -> dict[str, object] | None:
 962    """Return draw kwargs for a bbox feature, or None to skip it.
 963
 964    ``False`` skips. ``True`` uses default line color and width.
 965    A style dict or ``Style`` is applied as given.
 966    """
 967    if option is False:
 968        return None
 969    if option is True:
 970        return {
 971            "fill": False,
 972            "stroke": True,
 973            "line_color": runtime_defaults["line_color"],
 974            "line_width": runtime_defaults["line_width"],
 975        }
 976    return coerce_style_overlay(option)
 977
 978
 979def _merge_style(
 980    base: dict[str, object], extra: dict[str, object]
 981) -> dict[str, object]:
 982    """Return ``base`` with ``extra`` keys overwriting."""
 983    merged = dict(base)
 984    for key in extra:
 985        merged[key] = extra[key]
 986    return merged

 988
 989def draw_bbox(
 990    self: Canvas,
 991    bbox: BoundingBox,
 992    border: bool | dict[str, object] = False,
 993    centerlines: bool | dict[str, object] = False,
 994    diagonals: bool | dict[str, object] = False,
 995    **kwargs: object,
 996) -> Self:
 997    """Draw a bounding box.
 998
 999    If ``border``, ``centerlines``, and ``diagonals`` are all False, the
1000    box is drawn as a bounding-box sketch (same as ``canvas.draw(bbox)``).
1001    If a flag is True, those lines use the default line color and width.
1002    If a flag is a style dict, those lines use that style.
1003
1004    Args:
1005        bbox: Bounding box to draw.
1006        border: Rectangle outline. Defaults to False.
1007        centerlines: Horizontal and vertical centerlines. Defaults to False.
1008        diagonals: Both diagonals. Defaults to False.
1009        **kwargs: Extra style forwarded to each drawn part, or to the
1010            bounding-box sketch when all flags are False.
1011
1012    Returns:
1013        Self: The canvas.
1014
1015    Examples:
1016        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1017        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1018        >>> box = sg.BoundingBox((0, 0), (40, 20))
1019        >>> canvas.draw_bbox(box) is canvas
1020        True
1021        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[0].subtype.name
1022        'BBOX_SKETCH'
1023        >>> len(canvas._all_vertices)
1024        4
1025        >>> canvas.draw_bbox(box, border=True) is canvas
1026        True
1027        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[1].subtype.name
1028        'SHAPE_SKETCH'
1029        >>> before = len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
1030        >>> canvas.draw_bbox(box, centerlines=True, diagonals={"line_width": 2}) is canvas
1031        True
1032        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) - before
1033        4
1034    """
1035    border_style = _bbox_feature_style(border)
1036    centerlines_style = _bbox_feature_style(centerlines)
1037    diagonals_style = _bbox_feature_style(diagonals)
1038    if (
1039        border_style is None
1040        and centerlines_style is None
1041        and diagonals_style is None
1042    ):
1043        extend_vertices(self, bbox)
1044        sketch = create_sketch(bbox, self, **kwargs)
1045        self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
1046        return self
1047
1048    if border_style is not None:
1049        draw(
1050            self,
1051            Shape(bbox.corners, closed=True),
1052            **_merge_style(border_style, kwargs),
1053        )
1054    if centerlines_style is not None:
1055        part_style = _merge_style(centerlines_style, kwargs)
1056        vertical = bbox.vert_centerline
1057        horizontal = bbox.horiz_centerline
1058        draw(self, Shape([vertical[0], vertical[1]]), **part_style)
1059        draw(self, Shape([horizontal[0], horizontal[1]]), **part_style)
1060    if diagonals_style is not None:
1061        part_style = _merge_style(diagonals_style, kwargs)
1062        first = bbox.diagonal1
1063        second = bbox.diagonal2
1064        draw(self, Shape([first[0], first[1]]), **part_style)
1065        draw(self, Shape([second[0], second[1]]), **part_style)
1066
1067    return self
1068
1069
1070_GEOMETRIC_GRID_TYPES = frozenset(
1071    (
1072        Types.CIRCULAR_GRID,
1073        Types.HEX_GRID,
1074        Types.MIXED_GRID,
1075        Types.SQUARE_GRID,
1076    )
1077)

1079
1080def draw_geometric_grid(self: Canvas, grid: Group, **kwargs: object) -> Self:
1081    """Draw a geometric grid from ``connections``, ``skip``, ``border``,
1082    ``orthogonals``, ``diagonals``, and ``centerlines``.
1083
1084    Args:
1085        grid: ``CircularGrid``, ``SquareGrid``, ``HexGrid``, or ``Grid``.
1086        **kwargs: Extra style forwarded to each drawn part. ``indices=True``
1087            labels the grid vertices only, not the chord endpoints.
1088
1089    Returns:
1090        Self: The canvas.
1091
1092    Examples:
1093        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1094        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1095        >>> grid = sg.CircularGrid(n=6, radius=40)
1096        >>> grid.connections = [3]
1097        >>> grid.orthogonals = False
1098        >>> canvas.draw(grid) is canvas
1099        True
1100        >>> [sketch.subtype.name for sketch in canvas.active_page.sketches]
1101        ['SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'CIRCLE_SKETCH']
1102        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1103        >>> grid = sg.SquareGrid(n=16, cell_size=25)
1104        >>> canvas.draw(grid, indices=True) is canvas
1105        True
1106        >>> [
1107        ...     len(sketch.vertices)
1108        ...     for sketch in canvas.active_page.sketches
1109        ...     if "indices" in sketch.__dict__ and sketch.indices
1110        ... ]
1111        [16]
1112        >>> [
1113        ...     sketch.subtype.name
1114        ...     for sketch in canvas.active_page.sketches
1115        ...     if "indices" not in sketch.__dict__ or not sketch.indices
1116        ... ].count("SHAPE_SKETCH")
1117        22
1118        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1119        >>> grid = sg.SquareGrid(n=16, cell_size=25)
1120        >>> grid.orthogonals = False
1121        >>> grid.diagonals = True
1122        >>> canvas.draw(grid) is canvas
1123        True
1124        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
1125        2
1126        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1127        >>> grid = sg.SquareGrid(n=16, cell_size=25)
1128        >>> grid.orthogonals = False
1129        >>> grid.centerlines = True
1130        >>> canvas.draw(grid) is canvas
1131        True
1132        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
1133        2
1134    """
1135    points = list(grid.points)
1136    part_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
1137    if "indices" in part_kwargs:
1138        del part_kwargs["indices"]
1139    line_style = {
1140        "fill": False,
1141        "stroke": True,
1142        "line_color": runtime_defaults["grid_line_color"],
1143        "line_width": runtime_defaults["grid_line_width"],
1144    }
1145    line_style = _merge_style(line_style, part_kwargs)
1146    for first, second in grid.line_index_pairs():
1147        draw(
1148            self,
1149            Shape([points[first], points[second]]),
1150            **line_style,
1151        )
1152
1153    ortho_style = _bbox_feature_style(grid.orthogonals)
1154    if ortho_style is not None:
1155        for first, second in grid.orthogonal_index_pairs():
1156            draw(
1157                self,
1158                Shape([points[first], points[second]]),
1159                **_merge_style(ortho_style, part_kwargs),
1160            )
1161
1162    centerlines_style = _bbox_feature_style(grid.centerlines)
1163    if centerlines_style is not None and points:
1164        box = bounding_box(points)
1165        part_style = _merge_style(centerlines_style, part_kwargs)
1166        vertical = box.vert_centerline
1167        horizontal = box.horiz_centerline
1168        draw(self, Shape([vertical[0], vertical[1]]), **part_style)
1169        draw(self, Shape([horizontal[0], horizontal[1]]), **part_style)
1170
1171    diag_style = _bbox_feature_style(grid.diagonals)
1172    if diag_style is not None:
1173        for first, second in grid.diagonal_index_pairs():
1174            draw(
1175                self,
1176                Shape([points[first], points[second]]),
1177                **_merge_style(diag_style, part_kwargs),
1178            )
1179
1180    border_style = _bbox_feature_style(grid.border)
1181    if border_style is not None:
1182        draw(
1183            self,
1184            Shape(points, closed=True),
1185            **_merge_style(border_style, part_kwargs),
1186        )
1187
1188    if "indices" in kwargs and kwargs["indices"]:
1189        index_style: dict[str, object] = {
1190            "fill": False,
1191            "stroke": False,
1192            "indices": True,
1193        }
1194        for key in kwargs:
1195            if key == "indices" or key.startswith("index_"):
1196                index_style[key] = kwargs[key]
1197        draw(self, Shape(points), **index_style)
1198
1199    for element in grid:
1200        if element is grid._points:
1201            continue
1202        draw(self, element, **part_kwargs)
1203    return self
1204
1205
1206def draw_pattern(self: Canvas, pattern: Pattern, **kwargs: object) -> Self:
1207    """Draw a pattern by sketching each shape from ``get_shapes()``.
1208
1209    Args:
1210        pattern: Pattern to expand and draw.
1211        **kwargs: Style overrides forwarded to ``get_sketches``.
1212
1213    Returns:
1214        Self: The canvas.
1215
1216    Examples:
1217        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1218        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1219        >>> kernel = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)
1220        >>> pat = sg.Pattern(kernel)
1221        >>> _ = pat.translate(40, 0, reps=1)
1222        >>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_pattern
1223        >>> draw_pattern(canvas, pat) is canvas
1224        True
1225    """
1226    active_sketches = self.active_page.sketches
1227    shapes = pattern.get_shapes()
1228    for shape in shapes:
1229        sketches = get_sketches(shape, self, **kwargs)
1230        if sketches:
1231            active_sketches.extend(sketches)
1232
1233    return self

1261def draw_widget(self: Canvas, item: Drawable, **kwargs: object) -> Self:
1262    """Draw an item that exposes ``draw_list`` as a composite sketch.
1263
1264    Args:
1265        item: Drawable with a ``draw_list`` of drawables and/or functions.
1266        **kwargs: Style overrides applied to nested drawables.
1267
1268    Returns:
1269        Self: The canvas.
1270
1271    Examples:
1272        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1273        >>> from types import SimpleNamespace
1274        >>> widget = SimpleNamespace(
1275        ...     draw_list=[sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)])],
1276        ... )
1277        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1278        >>> canvas.draw_widget(widget) is canvas
1279        True
1280    """
1281    active_sketches = self.active_page.sketches
1282    first_sketch_index = len(active_sketches)
1283
1284    for drawable_item in item.draw_list:
1285        if callable(drawable_item):
1286            drawable_item(self, item, **kwargs)
1287            continue
1288        draw(self, drawable_item, **kwargs)
1289
1290    widget_sketches = active_sketches[first_sketch_index:]
1291    if widget_sketches:
1292        del active_sketches[first_sketch_index:]
1293        active_sketches.append(CompositeSketch(widget_sketches))
1294
1295    return self
1296
1297
1298def draw_hobby(
1299    self: Canvas,
1300    points: Sequence[PointType],
1301    controls: Sequence[PointType],
1302    cyclic: bool = False,
1303    **kwargs: object,
1304) -> Self:
1305    """Draw a Hobby curve through the given points using the control points.
1306
1307    Args:
1308        points (Sequence[PointType]): Points through which the curve passes.
1309        controls (Sequence[PointType]): Control points for the curve.
1310        cyclic (bool, optional): Whether the curve is cyclic. Defaults to False.
1311        **kwargs: Style overrides forwarded to each Bezier ``draw`` call.
1312
1313    Returns:
1314        Self: The canvas.
1315
1316    Examples:
1317        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1318        >>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_hobby
1319        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1320        >>> draw_hobby(canvas, [(0, 0), (40, 0)], [(20, 20), (20, -20)]) is canvas
1321        True
1322    """
1323    n = len(points)
1324    if cyclic:
1325        for i in range(n):
1326            ind = i * 2
1327            bezier_pnts = bezier_points(
1328                points[i], *controls[ind : ind + 2], points[(i + 1) % n], 20
1329            )
1330            bezier_ = Shape(bezier_pnts)
1331            self.draw(bezier_, **kwargs)
1332    else:
1333        for i in range(len(points) - 1):
1334            ind = i * 2
1335            bezier_pnts = bezier_points(
1336                points[i], *controls[ind : ind + 2], points[i + 1], 20
1337            )
1338            bezier_ = Shape(bezier_pnts)
1339            self.draw(bezier_, **kwargs)
1340    return self
1341

1363def _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs: DrawStyleKwargs) -> DrawStyleKwargs:
1364    """Return draw kwargs with lace-only option names removed."""
1365    return {
1366        name: value
1367        for name, value in kwargs.items()
1368        if name not in _LACE_DRAW_OPTION_NAMES
1369    }

1372def _resolved_plait_fill_color(
1373    lace: Lace | None, kwargs: DrawStyleKwargs
1374) -> Color | str | Sequence[float] | Sequence[int]:
1375    """Return the plait fill color from draw options, then the lace, then defaults.
1376
1377    Args:
1378        lace: Lace supplying ``plait_color`` when kwargs do not.
1379        kwargs: Draw keyword arguments (not mutated).
1380
1381    Returns:
1382        Resolved fill color for plait drawing.
1383    """
1384    if "plait_color" in kwargs:
1385        return kwargs["plait_color"]
1386    if "plait_fill_color" in kwargs:
1387        return kwargs["plait_fill_color"]
1388    if "fill_color" in kwargs:
1389        return kwargs["fill_color"]
1390    if lace is not None:
1391        if lace.plait_color is not None:
1392            return lace.plait_color
1393    return runtime_defaults["plait_color"]

1396def _emboss_base_color(
1397    lace: Lace | None, kwargs: DrawStyleKwargs
1398) -> Color | str | Sequence[float] | Sequence[int]:
1399    """Return the shade base color for emboss and frustum plaits.
1400
1401    An omitted plait color is ``avocado_green``. A color passed on the
1402    draw call or stored on the lace is kept.
1403    """
1404    color = _resolved_plait_fill_color(lace, kwargs)
1405    if color is runtime_defaults["plait_color"]:
1406        return avocado_green
1407    return color

1410def _resolved_shade_plaits(kwargs: DrawStyleKwargs) -> bool:
1411    """Return whether plaits should be shaded for this draw call.

1413    Args:

1415
1416    Returns:
1417        bool: ``shade_plaits`` from kwargs or ``defaults``.
1418    """
1419    if "shade_plaits" in kwargs:
1420        return kwargs["shade_plaits"]
1421    return runtime_defaults["shade_plaits"]

1424def _lace_far_point(lace: Lace) -> tuple[float, float]:
1425    """Return the shade light used by emboss and frustum plaits."""
1426    dist = lace.width * 3
1427    cx, cy = lace.midpoint
1428    return cx - dist, cy + dist

1431def _draw_fill(canvas: Canvas, shape, color, style_kwargs: dict) -> None:
1432    """Draw one shape with a fill color and the lace style kwargs."""
1433    draw_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
1434    draw_kwargs["fill_color"] = color
1435    draw(canvas, shape, **draw_kwargs)

1438def plait_emboss(self: Canvas, lace: Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None:
1439    """Draw lace plaits with ``emboss`` quads and open-end triangles.
1440
1441    Args:
1442        lace: Lace object whose plaits are embossed (mutated).
1443        **kwargs: Style overrides such as ``fill_color``.
1444
1445    Returns:
1446        None
1447
1448    Examples:
1449        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1450        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1451        >>> lace = sg.Lace([(0, 0), (20, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)  # doctest: +SKIP
1452        >>> canvas.draw_lace(lace, plait_style=sg.PlaitStyle.EMBOSS)  # doctest: +SKIP
1453    """
1454    from ..interlace.lace import emboss, shade_emboss, shade_triangle
1455
1456    emboss(lace)
1457    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1458    color = _emboss_base_color(lace, kwargs)
1459    shade = _resolved_shade_plaits(kwargs)
1460    far_point = _lace_far_point(lace)
1461    for ppoly in lace.parallel_poly_list:
1462        poly, poly2 = ppoly.offset_poly_list
1463        for j, div in enumerate(poly.divisions):
1464            for i, sect in enumerate(div.sections):
1465                if sect.is_overlap:
1466                    continue
1467                sect2 = poly2.divisions[j].sections[i]
1468                quad1 = sect.emboss
1469                quad2 = sect2.emboss
1470                if shade:
1471                    color1, color2 = shade_emboss(
1472                        quad1, quad2, color, far_point
1473                    )
1474                else:
1475                    color1 = color2 = color
1476                _draw_fill(self, quad1, color1, style_kwargs)
1477                _draw_fill(self, quad2, color2, style_kwargs)
1478                if sect.end_triangle is not None:
1479                    tri_color = color
1480                    if shade:
1481                        tri_color = shade_triangle(
1482                            sect.end_triangle, color, far_point
1483                        )
1484                    _draw_fill(self, sect.end_triangle, tri_color, style_kwargs)
1485
1486
1487def _draw_emboss_pair(
1488    canvas: Canvas,
1489    pair,
1490    color,
1491    far_point,
1492    style_kwargs: dict,
1493    shade: bool,
1494) -> None:
1495    """Draw one emboss quad pair, shaded when ``shade`` is true."""
1496    from ..interlace.lace import shade_emboss
1497
1498    quad1 = Shape(pair[0], closed=True)
1499    quad2 = Shape(pair[1], closed=True)
1500    if shade:
1501        color1, color2 = shade_emboss(quad1, quad2, color, far_point)
1502    else:
1503        color1 = color2 = color
1504    _draw_fill(canvas, quad1, color1, style_kwargs)
1505    _draw_fill(canvas, quad2, color2, style_kwargs)
1506
1507
1508def plait_emboss2(self: Canvas, lace: Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None:
1509    """Draw lace plaits with ``emboss2_quads``.
1510
1511    Triangles are drawn first, then end quad pairs, then interior pairs.
1512
1513    Args:
1514        lace: Lace object whose plaits are embossed (mutated).
1515        **kwargs: Style overrides such as ``fill_color``.
1516
1517    Returns:
1518        None
1519
1520    Examples:
1521        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1522        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1523        >>> lace = sg.Lace([(0, 0), (20, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)  # doctest: +SKIP
1524        >>> canvas.draw_lace(lace, plait_style=sg.PlaitStyle.EMBOSS2)  # doctest: +SKIP
1525    """
1526    from ..interlace.lace import emboss2_quads, shade_triangle
1527
1528    interior, end_quads, triangles = emboss2_quads(lace)
1529    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1530    color = _emboss_base_color(lace, kwargs)
1531    shade = _resolved_shade_plaits(kwargs)
1532    far_point = _lace_far_point(lace)
1533    for tri in triangles:
1534        tri_color = color
1535        if shade:
1536            tri_color = shade_triangle(tri, color, far_point)
1537        _draw_fill(self, tri, tri_color, style_kwargs)
1538    for pair in end_quads:
1539        _draw_emboss_pair(self, pair, color, far_point, style_kwargs, shade)
1540    for pair in interior:
1541        _draw_emboss_pair(self, pair, color, far_point, style_kwargs, shade)
1542
1543
1544def plait_frustum(self: Canvas, lace: Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None:
1545    """Draw lace plaits with ``get_frustum``.
1546
1547    Args:
1548        lace: Lace object whose plaits are drawn (mutated).
1549        **kwargs: Style overrides such as ``fill_color``.
1550
1551    Returns:
1552        None
1553
1554    Examples:
1555        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1556        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1557        >>> lace = sg.Lace([(0, 0), (20, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)  # doctest: +SKIP
1558        >>> canvas.draw_lace(lace, plait_style=sg.PlaitStyle.FRUSTUM)  # doctest: +SKIP
1559    """
1560    from ..interlace.lace import get_frustum, shade_end_quad
1561
1562    pairs, end_quads, inner_loops = get_frustum(lace)
1563    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1564    color = _emboss_base_color(lace, kwargs)
1565    shade = _resolved_shade_plaits(kwargs)
1566    far_point = _lace_far_point(lace)
1567    for quad1, quad2 in pairs:
1568        if shade:
1569            angle = inclination_angle(*quad1[:2])
1570            shade_angle = abs(radians(135) - angle)
1571            shade_factor = shade_value(shade_angle)
1572            mid1 = midpoint(*quad1[:2])
1573            x1, _ = intersect((far_point, mid1), quad1[:2])
1574            x2, _ = intersect((far_point, mid1), quad2[:2])
1575            shade_step = 0.2
1576            if x2 < x1:
1577                color1 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * -shade_step)
1578                color2 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * shade_step)
1579            elif x1 < x2:
1580                color1 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * shade_step)
1581                color2 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * -shade_step)
1582            else:
1583                color1 = color2 = color
1584        else:
1585            color1 = color2 = color
1586        _draw_fill(self, quad1, color1, style_kwargs)
1587        _draw_fill(self, quad2, color2, style_kwargs)
1588    for quad in end_quads:
1589        end_color = color
1590        if shade:
1591            end_color = shade_end_quad(quad, color, far_point)
1592        _draw_fill(self, quad, end_color, style_kwargs)
1593    for loop in inner_loops:
1594        _draw_fill(self, loop, color, style_kwargs)
1595
1596
1597def plait_innerloops(self: Canvas, lace: Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None:
1598    loop_offsets = kwargs.get("loop_offsets", None)
1599    loop_offset = kwargs.get("loop_offset", None)
1600    loop_style = kwargs.get("loop_style", None)
1601    plait_style = kwargs.get("plait_style", None)
1602    if not plait_style:
1603        plait_style = {"fill_color": runtime_defaults["plait_color"]}
1604    if loop_offsets:
1605        loop_styles = kwargs.get("loop_styles", None)
1606        for plait in lace.plaits:
1607            self.draw(plait, **plait_style)
1608            for i, offset in enumerate(loop_offsets):
1609                if offset > 0:
1610                    offset *= -1
1611                if loop_styles:
1612                    loop_style = loop_styles[i]
1613                else:
1614                    loop_style = {"fill": False}
1615                loop = Shape(offset_polygon(plait.vertices, offset))
1616                self.draw(loop, **loop_style)
1617    elif loop_offset:
1618        for plait in lace.plaits:
1619            self.draw(plait, **plait_style)
1620            loop = Shape(offset_polygon(plait.vertices, offset))
1621            self.draw(loop, **loop_style)
1622
1623
1624def plait_diamond(self: Canvas, lace: Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None:
1625    """Draw lace plaits using a diamond/offset-quad fill style.
1626
1627    Args:
1628        lace: Lace object whose plaits are drawn.
1629        **kwargs: Style overrides such as ``fill_color``.
1630
1631    Returns:
1632        None
1633
1634    Examples:
1635        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1636        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1637        >>> lace = sg.Lace([(0, 0), (20, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)  # doctest: +SKIP
1638        >>> canvas.plait_diamond(lace)  # doctest: +SKIP
1639    """
1640    lace._set_plait_ends()
1641    quad_pairs = []
1642    end_quads = []
1643    inner_loops = []
1644    if "fill_color" not in kwargs:
1645        kwargs["fill_color"] = _resolved_plait_fill_color(lace, kwargs)
1646    for plait in lace.plaits:
1647        vertices = list(plait.vertices)
1648        e1, e2 = plait.ends
1649        ends = [e1 + 1, e2 + 1]
1650
1651        count = 0
1652        for j, vert in enumerate(vertices):
1653            if j in ends:
1654                break
1655            count += 1
1656
1657        if count:
1658            vertices = vertices[count:] + vertices[:count]
1659
1660        n = len(vertices)
1661        inner_loop = Shape(offset_polygon(vertices, -5), closed=True)
1662        inner_loops.append(inner_loop)
1663        # self.draw(plait, fill=False,**kwargs)
1664        # self.draw(inner_loop, fill=False)
1665        quads = []
1666
1667        for i, vert in enumerate(vertices):
1668            quad = (
1669                vert,
1670                vertices[(i + 1) % n],
1671                inner_loop[(i + 1) % n],
1672                inner_loop[i],
1673            )
1674            shp = Shape(quad, closed=True)
1675            quads.append(shp)
1676        n2 = int(len(quads) / 2) - 1
1677        style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1678        for i in range(n2):
1679            draw(self, quads[i], **style_kwargs)
1680            draw(self, quads[-(i + 2)], **style_kwargs)
1681            quad_pairs.append((quads[i], quads[-(i + 2)]))
1682        end_quads.extend([quads[-1], quads[n2]])
1683
1684    dist = lace.width * 3
1685    cx, cy = lace.midpoint
1686    far_point = cx - dist, cy + dist
1687    plait_fill_color = _resolved_plait_fill_color(lace, kwargs)
1688    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1689
1690    if _resolved_shade_plaits(kwargs):
1691        color = plait_fill_color
1692        for quad1, quad2 in quad_pairs:
1693            angle = inclination_angle(*quad1[:2])
1694            shade_angle = abs(radians(135) - angle)
1695            shade_factor = shade_value(shade_angle)
1696
1697            mid1 = midpoint(*quad1[:2])
1698            line1 = (far_point, mid1)
1699            line2 = quad1[:2]
1700            line3 = quad2[:2]
1701
1702            x1, _ = intersect(line1, line2)
1703            x2, _ = intersect(line1, line3)
1704            shade_step = 0.2
1705
1706            if x2 < x1:
1707                color1 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * -shade_step)
1708                color2 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * shade_step)
1709            elif x1 < x2:
1710                color1 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * shade_step)
1711                color2 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * -shade_step)
1712            else:
1713                color1 = color2 = color
1714
1715            quad1_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
1716            quad1_kwargs["fill_color"] = color1
1717            quad2_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
1718            quad2_kwargs["fill_color"] = color2
1719            draw(self, quad1, **quad1_kwargs)
1720            draw(self, quad2, **quad2_kwargs)
1721
1722        color = change_lightness(plait_fill_color, -0.1)
1723        for quad in end_quads:
1724            end_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
1725            end_kwargs["fill_color"] = color
1726            draw(self, quad, **end_kwargs)
1727
1728        color = change_lightness(plait_fill_color, 0.1)
1729        for loop in inner_loops:
1730            loop_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
1731            loop_kwargs["fill_color"] = color
1732            draw(self, loop, **loop_kwargs)
1733        return
1734
1735    for quad in end_quads:
1736        draw(self, quad, **style_kwargs)
1737    for loop in inner_loops:
1738        draw(self, loop, **style_kwargs)
1739

1762def draw_plaits(
1763    self: Canvas, lace: Lace | None = None, **kwargs: object
1764) -> None:
1765    """Draw lace plaits, optionally using a plait style handler.
1766
1767    Args:
1768        lace (optional): Lace object providing ``plaits``. If omitted,
1769            ``kwargs['plaits']`` is used.
1770        **kwargs: Style overrides such as ``plait_color`` and
1771            ``plait_style``.
1772
1773    Examples:
1774        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1775        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1776        >>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_plaits
1777        >>> plait = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 20)], closed=True)
1778        >>> draw_plaits(canvas, plaits=[plait], plait_fill_color=sg.red)
1779        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) > 0
1780        True
1781    """
1782    if "plaits" in kwargs:
1783        plaits = kwargs["plaits"]
1784    elif lace is not None:
1785        plaits = lace.plaits
1786    else:
1787        raise KeyError("plaits")
1788
1789    if "plait_fill_color" not in kwargs:
1790        kwargs["plait_fill_color"] = _resolved_plait_fill_color(lace, kwargs)
1791    if "plait_style" in kwargs and kwargs["plait_style"] is not None:
1792        _handle_plait_style(self, lace, kwargs)
1793    else:
1794        _draw_default_plaits(self, lace, kwargs)

1797def draw_fragments(
1798    self: Canvas,
1799    lace: Lace | None = None,
1800    palette: Sequence[Sequence[float]] | None = None,
1801    **kwargs: object,
1802) -> None:
1803    """Draw lace fragments colored by area or radius bins from a palette.
1804
1805    Args:
1806        lace (optional): Lace object providing ``fragments`` and, for
1807            ``FragmentColoring.RADIUS``, the lace center.
1808        palette (optional): Color palette; ``swatch`` in ``kwargs``
1809            overrides it.
1810        **kwargs: May include ``fragments``, ``fragment_coloring``, and
1811            style overrides forwarded to ``draw``.
1812
1813    Examples:
1814        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1815        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1816        >>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_fragments
1817        >>> fragment = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (20, 0), (20, 20)], closed=True)
1818        >>> draw_fragments(canvas, fragments=[fragment])
1819        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) > 0
1820        True
1821    """
1822    if "fragments" in kwargs:
1823        fragments = kwargs["fragments"]
1824    elif lace is not None:
1825        fragments = lace.fragments
1826    else:
1827        raise KeyError("fragments")
1828
1829    fragments_by_id = {fragment.id: fragment for fragment in fragments}
1830    if "fragment_coloring" in kwargs:
1831        fragment_coloring = kwargs["fragment_coloring"]
1832    else:
1833        fragment_coloring = runtime_defaults["fragment_coloring"]
1834    if fragment_coloring == FragmentColoring.AREA:
1835        items = [(fragment.area, fragment.id) for fragment in fragments]
1836        if lace is not None:
1837            threshold = lace.area_threshold
1838        else:
1839            threshold = runtime_defaults["area_threshold"]
1840    elif fragment_coloring == FragmentColoring.RADIUS:
1841        if lace is None:
1842            raise ValueError("FragmentColoring.RADIUS requires a Lace object.")
1843        center = lace.center
1844        items = [
1845            (distance(center, fragment.CG), fragment.id)
1846            for fragment in fragments
1847        ]
1848        threshold = lace.radius_threshold
1849    else:
1850        raise ValueError(f"Unknown fragment_coloring: {fragment_coloring!r}")
1851
1852    bins = group_into_bins(items, threshold)
1853
1854    if "swatch" in kwargs:
1855        palette = kwargs["swatch"]
1856    elif palette is None:
1857        palette = runtime_defaults["swatch"]
1858
1859    n_palette = len(palette)
1860    n_bins = len(bins)
1861    palette = palette[:: n_palette // n_bins]
1862    palette = [Color(*c) for c in palette]
1863    n = len(palette)
1864    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1865    for i, bin_ in enumerate(bins):
1866        color = palette[i % n]
1867        for _, fragment_id in bin_:
1868            fragment = fragments_by_id[fragment_id]
1869            draw_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
1870            draw_kwargs["fill_color"] = color
1871            draw(self, fragment, **draw_kwargs)
1872

1874def _handle_plait_innerlines(
1875    canvas: Canvas, lace: Lace, **kwargs: object
1876) -> None:
1877    """Handle INNERLINES plait style."""
1878    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1879    for plait in lace.plaits:
1880        extend_vertices(canvas, plait)
1881        canvas.active_page.sketches.append(
1882            create_sketch(plait, canvas, **style_kwargs)
1883        )
1884
1885    if not lace.plaits[0].lerp_points:
1886        if "percent_offsets" in kwargs:
1887            offsets = kwargs["percent_offsets"]
1888        else:
1889            offsets = runtime_defaults["percent_offsets"]
1890        if "line_widths" in kwargs:
1891            widths = kwargs["line_widths"]
1892        else:
1893            widths = runtime_defaults["line_widths"]
1894
1895        lace._set_plait_inner_lines(offsets, widths)
1896
1897        if "line_widths" in kwargs and len(kwargs["line_widths"]) == len(
1898            lace.plaits[0].lerp_points[0]
1899        ):
1900            widths = kwargs["line_widths"]
1901        else:
1902            widths = False
1903
1904        for plait in lace.plaits:
1905            for i in range(len(plait.lerp_points[0])):
1906                points = [pnts[i] for pnts in plait.lerp_points]
1907                shape = Shape(points)
1908                extend_vertices(canvas, shape)
1909                sketch_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
1910                if widths:
1911                    sketch_kwargs["line_width"] = plait.line_widths[i]
1912                else:
1913                    sketch_kwargs["line_width"] = runtime_defaults["line_width"]
1914                canvas.active_page.sketches.append(
1915                    create_sketch(shape, canvas, **sketch_kwargs)
1916                )

1919def _handle_plait_double_lines(

1921) -> None:

1925    else:
1926        plaits = lace.plaits
1927    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)

1936def _handle_plait_style(
1937    canvas: Canvas, lace: Lace | None, kwargs: DrawStyleKwargs
1938) -> None:
1939    """Handle different plait styles."""
1940    p_style = kwargs["plait_style"]
1941
1942    if p_style == PlaitStyle.INNERLINES:
1943        _handle_plait_innerlines(canvas, lace, **kwargs)
1944    elif p_style == PlaitStyle.INNERLOOPS:
1945        plait_innerloops(canvas, lace, **kwargs)
1946    elif p_style == PlaitStyle.DIAMOND:
1947        plait_diamond(canvas, lace, **kwargs)
1948    elif p_style == PlaitStyle.EMBOSS:
1949        plait_emboss(canvas, lace, **kwargs)
1950    elif p_style == PlaitStyle.EMBOSS2:
1951        plait_emboss2(canvas, lace, **kwargs)
1952    elif p_style == PlaitStyle.FRUSTUM:
1953        plait_frustum(canvas, lace, **kwargs)
1954    elif p_style == PlaitStyle.DOUBLE_LINES:
1955        _handle_plait_double_lines(canvas, lace, kwargs)
1956    else:
1957        raise ValueError(f"Unknown plait_style: {p_style!r}")

1983def draw_lace(
1984    self: Canvas,
1985    lace: Lace,
1986    *,
1987    fragment_coloring: FragmentColoring | None = None,
1988    plait_style: PlaitStyle | None = None,
1989    shade_plaits: bool | None = None,
1990    fillet_radii: tuple[float, float] | None = None,
1991    palette: Sequence[Sequence[float]] | None = None,
1992    swatch: Sequence[Sequence[float]] | None = None,
1993    plait_color: Color | str | Sequence[float] | Sequence[int] | None = None,
1994    draw_fragments: bool | None = None,
1995    draw_plaits: bool | None = None,
1996    percent_offsets: Sequence[float] | None = None,
1997    line_widths: Sequence[float] | bool | None = None,
1998    **kwargs: object,
1999) -> Self:
2000    """Draw the lace object.
2001
2002    Lace-specific options belong here, not on ``canvas.draw``. Generic
2003    shape styles in ``kwargs`` are forwarded to fragment and plait draws.
2004
2005    Args:
2006        lace: Lace object to be drawn.
2007        fragment_coloring: Color equivalent fragments by area, or by
2008            distance from the lace center.
2009        plait_style: Plait drawing style. ``None`` uses filled plaits.
2010        shade_plaits: Shade embossed or diamond plaits.
2011        fillet_radii: ``(inner, outer)`` fillet radii. ``None`` does not
2012            fillet.
2013        palette: Fragment color palette.
2014        swatch: Overrides ``palette`` when given.
2015        plait_color: Fill color for plaits.
2016        draw_fragments: Draw fragment regions.
2017        draw_plaits: Draw plaits.
2018        percent_offsets: Inner-line positions for ``PlaitStyle.INNERLINES``.
2019        line_widths: Inner-line widths for ``PlaitStyle.INNERLINES``.
2020        **kwargs: Generic shape style overrides.
2021
2022    Returns:
2023        Self: The canvas object.
2024
2025    Examples:
2026        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2027        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2028        >>> lace = sg.Lace([(0, 0), (20, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)  # doctest: +SKIP
2029        >>> canvas.draw_lace(lace, draw_fragments=False, draw_plaits=False) is canvas  # doctest: +SKIP
2030        True
2031    """
2032    if fragment_coloring is None:
2033        fragment_coloring = runtime_defaults["fragment_coloring"]
2034    if plait_style is None:
2035        plait_style = runtime_defaults["lace_plait_style"]
2036    if shade_plaits is None:
2037        shade_plaits = runtime_defaults["shade_plaits"]
2038    if fillet_radii is None:
2039        fillet_radii = runtime_defaults["fillet_radii"]
2040    if swatch is not None:
2041        palette = swatch
2042    elif palette is None:
2043        if lace.palette is not None:
2044            palette = lace.palette
2045        elif lace.swatch is not None:
2046            palette = lace.swatch
2047        else:
2048            palette = runtime_defaults["swatch"]
2049    if plait_color is None:
2050        plait_color = _resolved_plait_fill_color(lace, kwargs)
2051    if draw_fragments is None:
2052        draw_fragments = runtime_defaults["draw_fragments"]
2053    if draw_plaits is None:
2054        draw_plaits = runtime_defaults["draw_plaits"]
2055    if percent_offsets is None:
2056        percent_offsets = runtime_defaults["percent_offsets"]
2057    if line_widths is None:
2058        line_widths = runtime_defaults["line_widths"]
2059
2060    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
2061    fragments = lace.fragments
2062    plaits = lace.plaits
2063    if fillet_radii is not None:
2064        inner_radius, outer_radius = fillet_radii
2065        fragments = lace._fillet_fragments(inner_radius, outer_radius)
2066        plaits = lace._fillet_plaits(inner_radius, outer_radius)
2067
2068    if draw_fragments:
2069        fragment_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
2070        fragment_kwargs["fragments"] = fragments
2071        fragment_kwargs["fragment_coloring"] = fragment_coloring
2072        _draw_fragments(self, lace, palette=palette, **fragment_kwargs)
2073
2074    if draw_plaits:
2075        plait_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
2076        plait_kwargs["plaits"] = plaits
2077        plait_kwargs["plait_color"] = plait_color
2078        plait_kwargs["shade_plaits"] = shade_plaits
2079        plait_kwargs["percent_offsets"] = percent_offsets
2080        plait_kwargs["line_widths"] = line_widths
2081        if plait_style is not None:
2082            plait_kwargs["plait_style"] = plait_style
2083        _draw_plaits(self, lace, **plait_kwargs)
2084
2085    return self

2088def draw_lines(
2089    self: Canvas, lines: Sequence[Sequence[PointType]], **kwargs: object
2090) -> Self:
2091    """Draw a collection of line segments onto the canvas.
2092
2093    Args:
2094        lines: Sequence of line segments ``((x1, y1), (x2, y2))``.
2095        **kwargs: Style overrides for the line sketches.
2096
2097    Returns:
2098        Self: The canvas.
2099
2100    Examples:
2101        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2102        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2103        >>> canvas.draw_lines([((0, 0), (40, 0))]) is canvas
2104        True
2105        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
2106        1
2107    """
2108    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
2109    for segment in lines:
2110        start = segment[0]
2111        end = segment[1]
2112        line_shape = Shape([start, end], closed=False, **kwargs)
2113        extend_vertices(self, line_shape)
2114        line_sketch = create_sketch(line_shape, self, **kwargs)
2115        self.active_page.sketches.append(line_sketch)
2116    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
2117    return self

2146def draw_points(
2147    self: Canvas,
2148    points: Sequence[PointType],
2149    marker_style: object | None = None,
2150    **kwargs: object,
2151) -> Self:
2152    """Draw markers at the given points.
2153
2154    If ``marker_style`` is omitted, default marker values are used.
2155    A ``MarkerStyle``, style dict, or ``marker_*`` keyword arguments
2156    override those defaults.
2157
2158    Args:
2159        points: Sequence of ``(x, y)`` positions.
2160        marker_style: Optional marker style. Defaults to None (library
2161            marker defaults).
2162        **kwargs: Extra style forwarded to ``draw``.
2163
2164    Returns:
2165        Self: The canvas.
2166
2167    Raises:
2168        ValueError: If ``points`` is empty.
2169
2170    Examples:
2171        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2172        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2173        >>> canvas.draw_points([(0, 0), (40, 0)]) is canvas
2174        True
2175        >>> sketch = canvas.active_page.sketches[0]
2176        >>> sketch.draw_markers
2177        True
2178        >>> sketch.markers_only
2179        True
2180        >>> sketch.marker_type == sg.defaults["marker_type"]
2181        True
2182        >>> sketch.marker_size == sg.defaults["marker_size"]
2183        True
2184        >>> tuple(sketch.vertices)
2185        ((0.0, 0.0), (40.0, 0.0))
2186        >>> canvas.draw_points([(0, 0)], marker_size=5) is canvas
2187        True
2188        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[1].marker_size
2189        5
2190    """
2191    point_list = list(points)
2192    if not point_list:
2193        raise ValueError("points must be a non-empty sequence")
2194    draw_kwargs: dict[str, object] = {
2195        "draw_markers": True,
2196        "markers_only": True,
2197    }
2198    for name in _MARKER_DEFAULT_KEYS:
2199        draw_kwargs[name] = runtime_defaults[name]
2200    if marker_style is not None:
2201        overlay = _marker_style_as_draw_kwargs(marker_style)
2202        for name in overlay:
2203            draw_kwargs[name] = overlay[name]
2204    for name in kwargs:
2205        draw_kwargs[name] = kwargs[name]
2206    draw(self, Shape(point_list), **draw_kwargs)
2207    return self
2208

2210def draw_image(
2211    self: Canvas,
2212    image: Image,
2213    position: PointType | None = None,
2214    scale: tuple[float, float] | float | None = None,
2215    **kwargs: object,
2216) -> Self:
2217    """Draw the image object.
2218
2219    Args:
2220        image: Image object to be drawn.
2221        position: Position to draw the image at.
2222        scale: Extra scale applied on top of ``image.size``.
2223            ``None`` uses ``(1, 1)``.
2224        **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments.
2225
2226    Returns:
2227        Self: The canvas object.
2228
2229    Examples:
2230        >>> from PIL import Image as PILImage
2231        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2232        >>> from simetri.images.image import Image
2233        >>> image = sg.Image(PILImage.new('RGB', (2, 2)))
2234        >>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_image
2235        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2236        >>> draw_image(canvas, image) is canvas
2237        True
2238    """
2239    if not image.visible:
2240        return self
2241
2242    _translation, rotation, _ = decompose_transformations(image.xform_matrix)
2243    if position is None:
2244        x, y = image.pos[:2]
2245    else:
2246        x, y = position[:2]
2247    pos = [x, y]
2248
2249    if scale is None:
2250        scale = (1, 1)
2251
2252    owns_matrix = (self._sketch_xform_matrix == identity_matrix()).all()
2253    if owns_matrix:
2254        self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
2255    extend_vertices(self, image)
2256    sketch = ImageSketch(
2257        image,
2258        pos=pos,
2259        angle=rotation,
2260        scale=scale,
2261        size=image.size,
2262        file_path=image.file_path,
2263        anchor=image.anchor,
2264        xform_matrix=self._sketch_xform_matrix,
2265    )
2266    if owns_matrix:
2267        self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
2268    for attrib_name in shape_style_map:
2269        attrib_value = self.resolve_property(image, attrib_name)
2270        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
2271    for attrib_name, attrib_value in kwargs.items():
2272        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
2273    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
2274
2275    return self

2278def draw_pdf(
2279    self: Canvas,
2280    pdf: str | PDF,
2281    pos: PointType | None = None,
2282    size: tuple[float, float] | None = None,
2283    scale: float | None = None,
2284    angle: float | None = 0,
2285    **kwargs: object,
2286) -> Self:
2287    """Draw a PDF file on the canvas.
2288
2289    Args:
2290        pdf: PDF object, or a file path.
2291        pos: Position of the PDF. None uses the object's position, or
2292            ``(0, 0)`` when ``pdf`` is a path.
2293        size: Drawn size. None uses the object's size.
2294        scale: Scale factor. None uses the object's scale.
2295        angle: Rotation in radians. Defaults to 0.
2296        **kwargs: Style overrides for the PDF sketch.
2297
2298    Returns:
2299        Self: The canvas.
2300
2301    Examples:
2302        >>> import os
2303        >>> import tempfile
2304        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2305        >>> fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.pdf')
2306        >>> _ = os.write(fd, b'%PDF-1.0\\n%%EOF\\n')
2307        >>> os.close(fd)
2308        >>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_pdf
2309        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2310        >>> draw_pdf(canvas, path) is canvas
2311        True
2312        >>> os.unlink(path)
2313    """
2314    if not isinstance(pdf, str):
2315        if not pdf.visible:
2316            return self
2317        translation, rotation, decomposed_scale = decompose_transformations(
2318            pdf.xform_matrix
2319        )
2320        if pos is None:
2321            x, y = pdf.pos[:2]
2322        else:
2323            x, y = pos[:2]
2324        dx, dy = translation
2325        pos = [x + dx, y + dy]
2326
2327        if scale is None:
2328            scale = pdf.scale if pdf.scale is not None else decomposed_scale
2329
2330        if angle is None:
2331            angle = rotation
2332        file_path = pdf.file_path
2333        if size is None:
2334            size = pdf.size
2335    else:
2336        # If pdf is a file path, we assume it is a PDF object
2337        pos = pos[:2] if pos else (0, 0)
2338        scale = scale if scale is not None else 1.0
2339        file_path = pdf
2340    if size is None:
2341        placed = [pos]
2342    else:
2343        width, height = size
2344        if isinstance(scale, (int, float)):
2345            sx = sy = float(scale)
2346        else:
2347            sx, sy = float(scale[0]), float(scale[1])
2348        half_w = width * sx / 2
2349        half_h = height * sy / 2
2350        x, y = pos[:2]
2351        placed = [
2352            (x - half_w, y - half_h),
2353            (x + half_w, y - half_h),
2354            (x + half_w, y + half_h),
2355            (x - half_w, y + half_h),
2356        ]
2357        if angle:
2358            placed = (
2359                homogenize(placed) @ rotation_matrix(angle, (x, y))
2360            ).tolist()
2361    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
2362    _extend_canvas_space_points(self, placed)
2363    sketch = PDFSketch(
2364        file_path,
2365        pos=pos,
2366        scale=scale,
2367        angle=angle if angle is not None else 0,
2368        size=size,
2369        xform_matrix=self._sketch_xform_matrix,
2370    )
2371    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
2372    for attrib_name, attrib_value in kwargs.items():
2373        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
2374    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
2375
2376    return self
2377

2379def _pop_prefixed(
2380    draw_kwargs: dict[str, object], prefix: str
2381) -> dict[str, object]:
2382    """Remove ``prefix`` keys and return them without the prefix."""
2383    part: dict[str, object] = {}
2384    for key in list(draw_kwargs):
2385        if key.startswith(prefix):
2386            part[key[len(prefix) :]] = draw_kwargs[key]
2387            del draw_kwargs[key]
2388    return part

2395    return True, part[name]
