2486def _dimension_formula_frame(tag: Tag) -> Shape | None:
2487    """Return the local background shape for a dimension formula label."""
2488    formula = _tag_latex_formula(tag.text)
2489    if formula is None or not tag.draw_frame:
2490        return None
2491    if not tag.fill and not tag.stroke:
2492        return None
2493    if isinstance(tag.font_size, (int, float)):
2494        font_size = tag.font_size
2495    else:
2496        font_size = convert_latex_font_size(tag.font_size)
2497    font_family = tag.font_family
2498    if font_family == runtime_defaults["font_family"]:
2499        font_family = None
2500    width, height = _measure_latex_formula(
2501        formula, font_size, font_family, tag.bold
2502    )
2503    offsets = {
2504        Anchor.SOUTHWEST: (0, 0),
2505        Anchor.SOUTH: (width / 2, 0),
2506        Anchor.SOUTHEAST: (width, 0),
2507        Anchor.WEST: (0, height / 2),
2508        Anchor.CENTER: (width / 2, height / 2),
2509        Anchor.EAST: (width, height / 2),
2510        Anchor.NORTHWEST: (0, height),
2511        Anchor.NORTH: (width / 2, height),
2512        Anchor.NORTHEAST: (width, height),
2513    }
2514    offset_x, offset_y = offsets[tag.anchor]
2515    x, y = tag.pos[:2]
2516    inner_sep = tag.frame_inner_sep
2517    left = x - offset_x - inner_sep
2518    bottom = y - offset_y - inner_sep
2519    right = x + width - offset_x + inner_sep
2520    top = y + height - offset_y + inner_sep
2521    return Shape(
2522        [(left, bottom), (right, bottom), (right, top), (left, top)],
2523        closed=True,
2524        fill=tag.fill,
2525        fill_color=tag.fill_color,
2526        stroke=tag.stroke,
2527        line_color=tag.line_color,
2528        line_width=tag.line_width,
2529    )
2530
2531
2532def draw_dimension(self: Canvas, item: Dimension, **kwargs: object) -> Self:
2533    """Draw the dimension object.
2534
2535    Constructor style keywords stored on ``item.kwargs`` are used first.
2536    Keywords passed to this call replace those.
2537
2538    Args:
2539        item: Dimension object to be drawn.
2540        **kwargs: ``ext_line_alpha``, ``ext_line_color``,
2541            ``ext_line_dash_array``, and ``ext_line_width`` style both
2542            extension lines. ``shaft_line_alpha``, ``shaft_line_color``,
2543            ``shaft_line_dash_array``, and ``shaft_line_width`` style
2544            the dimension line and, when the label is at the side, both
2545            arrow shafts and the line between them. ``head_fill_alpha``,
2546            ``head_fill_color``, ``head_line_alpha``,
2547            ``head_line_color``, and ``head_line_width`` style every
2548            arrow head. ``tag_bold``, ``tag_fill``,
2549            ``tag_fill_color``, ``tag_font_alpha``, ``tag_font_color``,
2550            ``tag_font_family``, ``tag_font_size``, ``tag_line_color``,
2551            ``tag_line_width``, and ``tag_stroke`` style the label.
2552            The label defaults to a white fill with no stroke. ``color``
2553            and ``alpha`` set every part; a prefixed name wins.
2554
2555    Returns:
2556        Self: The canvas object.
2557
2558    Examples:
2559        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2560        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2561        >>> dim = sg.Dimension((0, 0), (40, 0), "up", 5)
2562        >>> canvas.draw_dimension(dim) is canvas
2563        True
2564        >>> dim.ext1.line_width
2565        0.75
2566        >>> dim.dim_line.line.line_width
2567        0.75
2568        >>> dim.ext1.line_color == sg.colors.dark_gray
2569        True
2570        >>> dim.dim_line.head.fill_color == sg.colors.dark_gray
2571        True
2572    """
2573    if item.kwargs:
2574        merged = dict(item.kwargs)
2575        merged.update(kwargs)
2576        kwargs = merged
2577
2578    for shape in item.all_shapes:
2579        _extend_canvas_space_points(self, shape.corners)
2580
2581    def _add_sketch(sketch: Sketch | list[Sketch] | None) -> None:
2582        if sketch is None:
2583            return
2584        if isinstance(sketch, list):
2585            self.active_page.sketches.extend(sketch)
2586        else:
2587            self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
2588
2589    draw_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
2590    ext_style = _line_part_style(
2591        _pop_prefixed(draw_kwargs, "ext_"),
2592        draw_kwargs["color"] if "color" in draw_kwargs else None,
2593        draw_kwargs["alpha"] if "alpha" in draw_kwargs else None,
2594    )
2595    common_color = draw_kwargs["color"] if "color" in draw_kwargs else None
2596    common_alpha = draw_kwargs["alpha"] if "alpha" in draw_kwargs else None
2597    if "color" in draw_kwargs:
2598        del draw_kwargs["color"]
2599    if "alpha" in draw_kwargs:
2600        del draw_kwargs["alpha"]
2601    shaft_style = _line_part_style(
2602        _pop_prefixed(draw_kwargs, "shaft_"), common_color, common_alpha
2603    )
2604    head_style = _head_part_style(
2605        _pop_prefixed(draw_kwargs, "head_"), common_color, common_alpha
2606    )
2607    tag_part = _pop_prefixed(draw_kwargs, "tag_")
2608    for name in (
2609        "bold",
2610        "font_alpha",
2611        "font_color",
2612        "font_family",
2613        "italic",
2614    ):
2615        if name not in draw_kwargs:
2616            continue
2617        if name not in tag_part:
2618            tag_part[name] = draw_kwargs[name]
2619        del draw_kwargs[name]
2620
2621    for ext in [item.ext1, item.ext2, item.ext3]:
2622        if ext:
2623            _apply_part_style(ext, ext_style)
2624            _add_sketch(create_sketch(ext, self, **draw_kwargs))
2625    _apply_arrow_style(item.dim_line, shaft_style, head_style)
2626    _apply_arrow_style(item.arrow1, shaft_style, head_style)
2627    _apply_arrow_style(item.arrow2, shaft_style, head_style)
2628    if item.midline is not None and item.show_midline:
2629        _apply_part_style(item.midline, shaft_style)
2630    if item.dim_line:
2631        _add_sketch(create_sketch(item.dim_line, self, **draw_kwargs))
2632    if item.arrow1:
2633        _add_sketch(create_sketch(item.arrow1, self, **draw_kwargs))
2634        if item.midline is not None and item.show_midline:
2635            _add_sketch(create_sketch(item.midline, self, **draw_kwargs))
2636    if item.arrow2:
2637        _add_sketch(create_sketch(item.arrow2, self, **draw_kwargs))
2638    x, y = item.text_pos[:2]
2639    tag_kwargs: dict[str, object] = {}
2640    if "font_size" in tag_part and tag_part["font_size"] is not None:
2641        tag_kwargs["font_size"] = tag_part["font_size"]
2642    elif "font_size" in draw_kwargs:
2643        tag_kwargs["font_size"] = draw_kwargs["font_size"]
2644    else:
2645        tag_kwargs["font_size"] = item.font_size
2646    if "anchor" in draw_kwargs:
2647        tag_kwargs["anchor"] = draw_kwargs["anchor"]
2648    else:
2649        tag_kwargs["anchor"] = item.text_anchor
2650    if "align" in draw_kwargs:
2651        tag_kwargs["align"] = draw_kwargs["align"]
2652    else:
2653        tag_kwargs["align"] = item.text_align
2654    if "fill" in tag_part and tag_part["fill"] is not None:
2655        tag_kwargs["fill"] = tag_part["fill"]
2656    elif "fill" in draw_kwargs:
2657        tag_kwargs["fill"] = draw_kwargs["fill"]
2658    else:
2659        tag_kwargs["fill"] = True
2660    if "stroke" in tag_part and tag_part["stroke"] is not None:
2661        tag_kwargs["stroke"] = tag_part["stroke"]
2662    else:
2663        tag_kwargs["stroke"] = False
2664    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "font_color")
2665    if stated:
2666        tag_kwargs["font_color"] = value
2667    elif common_color is not None:
2668        tag_kwargs["font_color"] = common_color
2669    else:
2670        tag_kwargs["font_color"] = runtime_defaults["dim_color"]
2671    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "font_family")
2672    if stated:
2673        tag_kwargs["font_family"] = value
2674    font_alpha = None
2675    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "font_alpha")
2676    if stated:
2677        font_alpha = value
2678    elif common_alpha is not None:
2679        font_alpha = common_alpha
2680    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "bold")
2681    if stated:
2682        tag_kwargs["bold"] = value
2683    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "italic")
2684    if stated:
2685        tag_kwargs["italic"] = value
2686    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "fill_color")
2687    if stated:
2688        tag_kwargs["fill_color"] = value
2689    elif "fill_color" in draw_kwargs:
2690        tag_kwargs["fill_color"] = draw_kwargs["fill_color"]
2691    else:
2692        tag_kwargs["fill_color"] = colors.white
2693    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "line_color")
2694    if stated:
2695        tag_kwargs["line_color"] = value
2696    elif common_color is not None:
2697        tag_kwargs["line_color"] = common_color
2698    else:
2699        tag_kwargs["line_color"] = runtime_defaults["dim_color"]
2700    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "line_width")
2701    if stated:
2702        tag_kwargs["line_width"] = value
2703    tag = Tag(item.text, (x, y), **tag_kwargs)
2704    if font_alpha is not None:
2705        tag.font_alpha = font_alpha
2706    formula_frame = _dimension_formula_frame(tag)
2707    if formula_frame is not None:
2708        _extend_canvas_space_points(self, formula_frame.corners)
2709        self.active_page.sketches.append(create_sketch(formula_frame, self))
2710    extend_vertices(self, tag)
2711    self.active_page.sketches.append(create_sketch(tag, self))
2712
2713    return self
2714
2715
2716def grid(
2717    self: Canvas,
2718    pos: PointType = (0, 0),
2719    width: float | None = None,
2720    height: float | None = None,
2721    step_size: float | None = None,
2722    **kwargs: object,
2723) -> Self:
2724    """Draw a rectangular grid.
2725
2726    Args:
2727        pos: Lower-left corner of the grid.
2728        width: Length along the x-axis. None uses ``runtime_defaults["grid_size"]``.
2729        height: Length along the y-axis. None uses ``runtime_defaults["grid_size"]``
2730            when ``width`` is also None.
2731        step_size: Distance between grid lines.
2732        **kwargs: Style overrides for the grid lines.
2733
2734    Returns:
2735        Self: The canvas.
2736
2737    Examples:
2738        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2739        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2740        >>> canvas.grid((0, 0), 20, 20, 10) is canvas
2741        True
2742        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) > 0
2743        True
2744    """
2745    x, y = pos[:2]
2746    if width is None:
2747        width = runtime_defaults["grid_size"]
2748        height = runtime_defaults["grid_size"]
2749    if "line_width" not in kwargs:
2750        kwargs["line_width"] = runtime_defaults["grid_line_width"]
2751    if "line_color" not in kwargs:
2752        kwargs["line_color"] = runtime_defaults["grid_line_color"]
2753    if "line_dash_array" not in kwargs:
2754        kwargs["line_dash_array"] = runtime_defaults["grid_line_dash_array"]
2755
2756    line_y = Shape([(x, y), (x + width, y)], **kwargs)
2757    line_x = Shape([(x, y), (x, y + height)], **kwargs)
2758    lines_x = line_y.translate(0, step_size, reps=int(height / step_size))
2759    lines_y = line_x.translate(step_size, 0, reps=int(width / step_size))
2760    self.draw(lines_x)
2761    self.draw(lines_y)
2762    return self
2763

2807def _canvas_space_points(
2808    canvas: Canvas, points: Sequence[PointType]
2809) -> list[tuple[float, float]]:
2810    """Map drawable points into current canvas sketch space."""
2811    if points is None or len(points) == 0:
2812        return []
2813    return [x[:2] for x in homogenize(points) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix]
2814
2815
2816def _extend_canvas_space_points(
2817    canvas: Canvas, points: Sequence[PointType]
2818) -> None:
2819    """Append ``points`` transformed by ``canvas._sketch_xform_matrix``."""
2820    canvas._all_vertices.extend(_canvas_space_points(canvas, points))
2821
2822
2823def _bezier_handle_segments(item: Drawable) -> list[tuple[PointType, PointType]]:
2824    """Return a Bezier curve's handle segments in drawable space."""
2825    control_points = [
2826        tuple(point[:2])
2827        for point in homogenize(item.control_points) @ item.xform_matrix
2828    ]
2829    if item.subtype == Types.BEZIER:
2830        return [
2831            (control_points[0], control_points[1]),
2832            (control_points[2], control_points[3]),
2833        ]
2834    return [
2835        (control_points[0], control_points[1]),
2836        (control_points[1], control_points[2]),
2837    ]
2838
2839
2840def extend_vertices(canvas: Canvas, item: Drawable | BoundingBox) -> None:
2841    """Append the item's bounds geometry in draw-time canvas space.
2842
2843    Polygonal shapes and arrow parts use their actual vertices so rotating
2844    an enclosing rectangle does not introduce empty space into the bounds.
2845
2846    Args:
2847        canvas: Canvas whose ``_all_vertices`` list is extended (mutated).
2848        item: Item whose vertices are copied onto the canvas.
2849
2850    Examples:
2851        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2852        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2853        >>> extend_vertices(canvas, sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (0, 40)]))
2854        >>> len(canvas._all_vertices) > 0
2855        True
2856    """
2857    all_vertices = canvas._all_vertices
2858    if item.subtype == Types.DOTS:
2859        vertices = [x.pos for x in item.all_shapes]
2860        vertices = [
2861            x[:2] for x in homogenize(vertices) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2862        ]
2863        all_vertices.extend(vertices)
2864    elif item.subtype == Types.DOT:
2865        vertices = [item.pos]
2866        vertices = [
2867            x[:2] for x in homogenize(vertices) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2868        ]
2869        all_vertices.extend(vertices)
2870    elif item.subtype == Types.TABLE:
2871        vertices = [
2872            x[:2]
2873            for x in homogenize(item.all_vertices) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2874        ]
2875        all_vertices.extend(vertices)
2876    elif item.subtype == Types.TAG:
2877        # Tag objects have all_vertices property that includes text bounding box
2878        vertices = [
2879            x[:2]
2880            for x in homogenize(item.all_vertices) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2881        ]
2882        all_vertices.extend(vertices)
2883    elif item.subtype == Types.TEXT_PATH:
2884        vertices = [
2885            x[:2]
2886            for x in homogenize(item.all_vertices) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2887        ]
2888        all_vertices.extend(vertices)
2889    elif item.subtype == Types.ARROW:
2890        for shape in item.all_shapes:
2891            all_vertices.extend(_canvas_space_points(canvas, shape.vertices))
2892    elif item.subtype == Types.LACE:
2893        for plait in item.plaits:
2894            all_vertices.extend(_canvas_space_points(canvas, plait.corners))
2895        for fragment in item.fragments:
2896            all_vertices.extend(_canvas_space_points(canvas, fragment.corners))
2897    elif item.subtype == Types.PATH2D:
2898        vertices = [
2899            x[:2]
2900            for x in homogenize(item.all_vertices) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2901        ]
2902        all_vertices.extend(vertices)
2903    elif item.subtype == Types.PATTERN:
2904        all_vertices.extend(_canvas_space_points(canvas, item.all_vertices))
2905    elif item.subtype in (Types.ANNOTATION, Types.DCEL, Types.GROUP):
2906        for element in item:
2907            extend_vertices(canvas, element)
2908    elif item.subtype == Types.FIGURE:
2909        if getattr(item, "draw_geometry", True) and item.geometry is not None:
2910            extend_vertices(canvas, item.geometry)
2911        if getattr(item, "draw_skin", True) and item.skin is not None:
2912            extend_vertices(canvas, item.skin)
2913    elif item.subtype == Types.VECTOR:
2914        return
2915    elif item.subtype in (
2916        Types.ARROW_HEAD,
2917        Types.LINE,
2918        Types.POLYLINE,
2919        Types.RECTANGLE,
2920        Types.SEGMENT,
2921        Types.SHAPE,
2922        Types.SQUARE,
2923    ):
2924        all_vertices.extend(_canvas_space_points(canvas, item.vertices))
2925    else:
2926        corners = [
2927            x[:2]
2928            for x in homogenize(item.corners) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2929        ]
2930        all_vertices.extend(corners)
2931
2932
2933def draw_vector(self: Canvas, item: Vector, **kwargs: object) -> Self:
2934    """Draw a vector as an arrow.
2935
2936    Args:
2937        item: Vector to draw. Tail is at the origin unless ``vec_start``
2938            or ``vec_end`` is given.
2939        **kwargs: Placement and style arguments. ``shaft_`` and ``head_``
2940            names style those parts. ``color`` and ``alpha`` style both.
2941
2942    Returns:
2943        Self: The canvas.
2944
2945    Examples:
2946        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2947        >>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_vector
2948        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2949        >>> draw_vector(canvas, sg.Vector(40, 0)) is canvas
2950        True
2951        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
2952        2
2953    """
2954    draw_items = kwargs.pop("draw_items", None)
2955    draw_pos = kwargs.pop("draw_pos", None)
2956    batch = (item,) if draw_items is None else draw_items
2957    vector_draw.prepare_vector_batch(batch, kwargs, draw_pos)
2958    arrow, part_kwargs = vector_draw.drawable_for_item(item, kwargs)
2959    return draw(self, arrow, **part_kwargs)
2960
2961
2962def draw(
2963    self: Canvas, item: Drawable | BoundingBox | Clipping, **kwargs: object
2964) -> Self:
2965    """Draw an item on the canvas.
2966
2967    ``draw_items`` and ``draw_pos`` are the ``Canvas.draw`` call list and
2968    its ``pos``. They are removed before any sketch is styled.
2969
2970    Args:
2971        item: Shape, group, or other drawable.
2972        **kwargs: Style overrides applied while drawing.
2973
2974    Returns:
2975        Self: The canvas.
2976
2977    Raises:
2978        TypeError: If ``item`` is a ``Lattice``. Draw ``lattice.pattern``
2979            after ``expand`` or ``populate_unit``.
2980
2981    Examples:
2982        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2983        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2984        >>> canvas.draw(sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)])) is canvas
2985        True
2986        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
2987        1
2988        >>> lattice = sg.lattice_p1(40, 40)
2989        >>> _ = lattice.expand(sg.letter_F(), 1)
2990        >>> canvas.draw(lattice)  # doctest: +IGNORE_EXCEPTION_DETAIL
2991        Traceback (most recent call last):
2992            ...
2993        TypeError: Cannot draw a Lattice. Draw lattice.pattern instead.
2994        >>> mesh = sg.DCEL()
2995        >>> _ = mesh.build_from_polygons([[(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40), (0, 40)]])
2996        >>> dcel_canvas = sg.Canvas()
2997        >>> dcel_canvas.draw(mesh) is dcel_canvas
2998        True
2999        >>> len(dcel_canvas.active_page.sketches)
3000        1
3001        >>> labeled = sg.Canvas()
3002        >>> labeled.draw(mesh, face_indices=True) is labeled
3003        True
3004        >>> len(labeled.active_page.sketches)
3005        2
3006    """
3007    draw_items = kwargs.pop("draw_items", None)
3008    draw_pos = kwargs.pop("draw_pos", None)
3009    try:
3010        draw_list = item.draw_list
3011    except AttributeError:
3012        draw_list = None
3013    if draw_list is not None:
3014        if callable(draw_list):
3015            raise TypeError(
3016                "item.draw_list must be a list of drawables and/or functions."
3017            )
3018        draw_widget(self, item, **kwargs)
3019        return self
3020
3021    # check if the item has any points
3022    if not item:
3023        return self
3024
3025    if item.type is Types.LATTICE:
3026        raise TypeError("Cannot draw a Lattice. Draw lattice.pattern instead.")
3027
3028    if vector_draw.is_vector_marker_shape(item, kwargs):
3029        vector_draw.draw_vector_marker_shape(self, item, kwargs)
3030        return self
3031
3032    active_sketches = self.active_page.sketches
3033    subtype = item.subtype
3034    tag_formula = (
3035        _tag_latex_formula(item.text) if subtype == Types.TAG else None
3036    )
3037    if item.type is not Types.CLIPPING and tag_formula is None:
3038        extend_vertices(self, item)
3039
3040    if subtype in _GEOMETRIC_GRID_TYPES:
3041        draw_geometric_grid(self, item, **kwargs)
3042        return self
3043
3044    if subtype == Types.PATH2D and kwargs.get("handles", False):
3045        handle_size = runtime_defaults["handle_marker_size"]
3046        half_size = handle_size / 2
3047        for handle in item.handles:
3048            if not handle:
3049                continue
3050            _extend_canvas_space_points(self, handle)
3051
3052            # square handle markers at segment endpoints (3x3)
3053            for x, y in (handle[0], handle[-1]):
3054                _extend_canvas_space_points(
3055                    self,
3056                    [
3057                        (x - half_size, y - half_size),
3058                        (x + half_size, y - half_size),
3059                        (x + half_size, y + half_size),
3060                        (x - half_size, y + half_size),
3061                    ],
3062                )
3063    elif subtype in (Types.BEZIER, Types.Q_BEZIER) and kwargs.get(
3064        "handles", False
3065    ):
3066        handle_size = runtime_defaults["handle_marker_size"]
3067        half_size = handle_size / 2
3068        for handle in _bezier_handle_segments(item):
3069            _extend_canvas_space_points(self, handle)
3070            for x, y in (handle[0], handle[-1]):
3071                _extend_canvas_space_points(
3072                    self,
3073                    [
3074                        (x - half_size, y - half_size),
3075                        (x + half_size, y - half_size),
3076                        (x + half_size, y + half_size),
3077                        (x - half_size, y + half_size),
3078                    ],
3079                )
3080
3081    if subtype == Types.ANNOTATION:
3082        kwargs = _style_annotation(item, kwargs)
3083    if subtype in (Types.GROUP, Types.STAR, Types.ANNOTATION, Types.DCEL):
3084        group_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
3085        if kwargs.get("vertex_on_hull") and "_group_hull_points" not in kwargs:
3086            group_kwargs["_group_hull_points"] = convex_hull(
3087                item.all_vertices, on_edge=True
3088            )
3089        index_requested = False
3090        face_index_requested = False
3091        if subtype == Types.DCEL:
3092            if "indices" in group_kwargs:
3093                index_requested = bool(group_kwargs["indices"])
3094                del group_kwargs["indices"]
3095            if "face_indices" in group_kwargs:
3096                face_index_requested = bool(group_kwargs["face_indices"])
3097                del group_kwargs["face_indices"]
3098        if subtype == Types.GROUP and group_kwargs.get("non_zero"):
3099            compound_path = group_to_nonzero_path(item)
3100            active_sketches.extend(
3101                get_sketches(compound_path, self, **group_kwargs)
3102            )
3103        else:
3104            for group_item in item:
3105                if subtype == Types.DCEL and group_item is item.outer_face:
3106                    continue
3107                draw(self, group_item, **group_kwargs)
3108            if subtype == Types.DCEL:
3109                for edge in item.edges:
3110                    if edge.half_edge is None:
3111                        continue
3112                    left, right = edge.adjacent_faces()
3113                    if left is not right:
3114                        continue
3115                    draw(self, edge, **group_kwargs)
3116                if index_requested:
3117                    points = [vertex.point for vertex in item.vertices]
3118                    index_style: dict[str, object] = {
3119                        "fill": False,
3120                        "stroke": False,
3121                        "indices": True,
3122                    }
3123                    for key in kwargs:
3124                        if key == "indices" or key.startswith("index_"):
3125                            index_style[key] = kwargs[key]
3126                    if points:
3127                        draw(self, Shape(points), **index_style)
3128                if face_index_requested:
3129                    tag_kwargs: dict[str, object] = {}
3130                    if "index_font_size" in kwargs:
3131                        tag_kwargs["font_size"] = kwargs["index_font_size"]
3132                    if "index_font_color" in kwargs:
3133                        tag_kwargs["font_color"] = kwargs["index_font_color"]
3134                    if "index_font_family" in kwargs:
3135                        tag_kwargs["font_family"] = kwargs["index_font_family"]
3136                    for index, face in enumerate(item.faces):
3137                        if face is item.outer_face:
3138                            continue
3139                        tag_obj = Tag(str(index), face.midpoint, **tag_kwargs)
3140                        tag_obj.draw_frame = False
3141                        draw(self, tag_obj)
3142    elif subtype == Types.FACE and item.inner_boundaries:
3143        # Holes belong to the face; same path as canvas.draw(group, non_zero=True).
3144        if item.mesh is None:
3145            raise ValueError("face with holes is not linked to a DCEL")
3146        outer_points = [vertex.point for vertex in item.boundary_vertices()]
3147        rings = [Shape(outer_points, closed=True)]
3148        outer_area = polygon_area(outer_points)
3149        for cycle in item.mesh.holes(item):
3150            points = [vertex.point for vertex in cycle]
3151            # group_to_nonzero_path reverses non-outer rings; feed matching
3152            # winding (DCEL hole cycles are opposite the outer).
3153            if polygon_area(points) * outer_area < 0:
3154                points = list(reversed(points))
3155            rings.append(Shape(points, closed=True))
3156        hole_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
3157        hole_kwargs["non_zero"] = True
3158        draw(self, Group(rings), **hole_kwargs)
3159    elif subtype in regular_sketch_types:
3160        sketches = get_sketches(item, self, **kwargs)
3161        if sketches:
3162            active_sketches.extend(sketches)
3163            if (
3164                "midpoints" in kwargs
3165                and kwargs["midpoints"]
3166                and isinstance(item, Shape)
3167            ):
3168                midpoint_indices = "indices" in kwargs and bool(
3169                    kwargs["indices"]
3170                )
3171                edge_midpoints = item.edge_midpoints
3172                if edge_midpoints and midpoint_indices:
3173                    label_source = sketches[0]
3174                    marker_radius = runtime_defaults["midpoint_radius"]
3175                    midpoint_markers = Shape(
3176                        edge_midpoints,
3177                        closed=False,
3178                        draw_markers=True,
3179                        markers_only=True,
3180                        marker_type=MarkerType.CIRCLE,
3181                        marker_radius=marker_radius,
3182                        marker_size=marker_radius,
3183                        marker_color=sketch_label_font_color(
3184                            label_source, "index"
3185                        ),
3186                        fill=False,
3187                        stroke=True,
3188                    )
3189                    draw(self, midpoint_markers)
3190    elif subtype == Types.IMAGE:
3191        draw_image(self, item, **kwargs)
3192    elif subtype == Types.PATTERN:
3193        draw_pattern(self, item, **kwargs)
3194    elif subtype in (
3195        Types.ALIGNED_DIMENSION,
3196        Types.ANGULAR_DIMENSION,
3197        Types.DIMENSION,
3198    ):
3199        draw_dimension(self, item, **kwargs)
3200    elif subtype == Types.ARROW:
3201        active_sketches.append(create_sketch(item.line, self, **kwargs))
3202        for head in item.heads:
3203            active_sketches.append(create_sketch(head, self, **kwargs))
3204    elif subtype == Types.VECTOR:
3205        draw_vector(
3206            self,
3207            item,
3208            draw_items=draw_items,
3209            draw_pos=draw_pos,
3210            **kwargs,
3211        )
3212    elif subtype == Types.LACE:
3213        draw_lace(self, item, **kwargs)
3214    elif subtype == Types.FIGURE:
3215        if getattr(item, "draw_geometry", True) and item.geometry is not None:
3216            draw(self, item.geometry, **kwargs)
3217        if getattr(item, "draw_skin", True) and item.skin is not None:
3218            draw(self, item.skin)
3219    elif subtype == Types.BOUNDING_BOX:
3220        draw_bbox(self, item, **kwargs)
3221    elif subtype == Types.CLIPPING:
3222        target = item.target
3223        clipper = item.clipper
3224        self._sketch_xform_matrix = (
3225            self._sketch_xform_matrix @ self._xform_matrix
3226        )
3227        self.active_page.sketches.append(
3228            get_clipped_sketch(target, clipper, self, **kwargs)
3229        )
3230        extend_vertices(self, clipper)
3231        self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
3232
3233        return self
3234    return self
3235
3236
3237def draw_all_segments(
3238    self: Canvas,
3239    item: Shape | Group,
3240    vert_indices: bool = False,
3241    **kwargs: object,
3242) -> Self:
3243    """Split edges into segments and draw them with index labels.
3244
3245    Used with loop-finding workflows. When ``vert_indices`` is true,
3246    vertex indices are drawn at endpoints instead of edge indices at
3247    midpoints.
3248
3249    Args:
3250        item: Shape or group whose edges are split and drawn.
3251        vert_indices: Label vertices instead of edges.
3252        **kwargs: Style overrides forwarded to ``draw`` and ``text``.
3253
3254    Returns:
3255        Self: The canvas.
3256
3257    Examples:
3258        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
3259        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
3260        >>> shape = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40), (0, 40)])
3261        >>> canvas.draw_all_segments(shape) is canvas
3262        True
3263    """
3264    segments = all_segments(item)
3265    count = 0
3266    for i, edge in enumerate(segments):
3267        draw(self, Shape(edge), **kwargs)
3268        if vert_indices:
3269            p1, p2 = edge
3270            text(self, f"{count}", p1, **kwargs)
3271            count += 1
3272            text(self, f"{count}", p2, **kwargs)
3273            count += 1
3274        else:
3275            text(self, f"{i}", midpoint(*edge), **kwargs)
3276
3277    return self
3278
3279
3280def get_clipped_sketch(
3281    target: Drawable,
3282    clipper: Drawable,
3283    canvas: Canvas,
3284    **kwargs: object,
3285) -> ClippedSketch:
3286    """Build a ``ClippedSketch`` for a target clipped by ``clipper``.
3287
3288    Args:
3289        target: Drawable content to clip (shape or group).
3290        clipper: Drawable used as the clipping path.
3291        canvas: Canvas providing transform context.
3292        **kwargs: Style overrides for target sketches.
3293
3294    Returns:
3295        ClippedSketch: Composite sketch with clipper attached.
3296
3297    Examples:
3298        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
3299        >>> from simetri.render.draw import get_clipped_sketch
3300        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
3301        >>> target = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)])
3302        >>> clipper = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (20, 0), (20, 20)])
3303        >>> clipped = get_clipped_sketch(target, clipper, canvas)
3304        >>> clipped.subtype.name
3305        'CLIPPED_SKETCH'
3306    """
3307    if target.type == Types.GROUP:
3308        sketches = [get_sketches(item, canvas, **kwargs) for item in target]
3309    else:
3310        sketches = [get_sketches(target, canvas, **kwargs)]
3311    clipper = get_sketches(clipper, canvas)
3312    return ClippedSketch(sketches=sketches, clipper=clipper)
3313
3314
3315def get_sketches(
3316    item: Drawable,
3317    canvas: Canvas | None = None,
3318    **kwargs: object,
3319) -> list[Sketch]:
3320    """Create sketches from the given item and return them as a list.
3321
3322    Args:
3323        item: Item to be sketched.
3324        canvas: Canvas object. Defaults to None.
3325        **kwargs: Style overrides forwarded to ``create_sketch``.
3326
3327    Returns:
3328        list[Sketch]: Sketches for the item, or an empty list when hidden.
3329
3330    Examples:
3331        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
3332        >>> from simetri.render.draw import get_sketches
3333        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
3334        >>> shape = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)])
3335        >>> len(get_sketches(shape, canvas))
3336        1
3337    """
3338    if not (item.visible):
3339        res = []
3340    elif item.subtype in drawable_types:
3341        sketches = create_sketch(item, canvas, **kwargs)
3342        if isinstance(sketches, list):
3343            res = sketches
3344        elif sketches is not None:
3345            res = [sketches]
3346        else:
3347            res = []
3348    else:
3349        res = []
3350    return res
3351

3387def set_shape_sketch_style(
3388    sketch: Sketch,
3389    item: Drawable,
3390    canvas: Canvas,
3391    linear: bool = False,
3392    **kwargs: object,
3393) -> None:
3394    """Set the style properties of the sketch.
3395
3396    Args:
3397        sketch: Sketch object (mutated).
3398        item: Item whose style properties are to be set.
3399        canvas: Canvas object.
3400        linear (bool, optional): Whether the style is linear. Defaults to False.
3401        **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments.
3402
3403    Examples:
3404        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
3405        >>> from simetri.render.draw import create_sketch, set_shape_sketch_style
3406        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
3407        >>> shape = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)])
3408        >>> sketch = create_sketch(shape, canvas)
3409        >>> set_shape_sketch_style(sketch, shape, canvas)
3410        >>> sketch.visible
3411        True
3412    """
3413    if linear:
3414        style_map = line_style_map
3415    else:
3416        style_map = shape_style_map
3417
3418    resolved_style = canvas.resolve_style_properties(item, style_map, **kwargs)
3419
3420    for attrib_name, attrib_value in resolved_style.items():
3421        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
3422
3423    sketch.visible = item.visible
3424    sketch.closed = item.closed
3425    # fill and stroke are resolved through resolve_property in the loop above
3426
3427    # Copy tile_svg (direct shape property, not style attribute)
3428    if hasattr(item, "tile_svg"):
3429        sketch.tile_svg = item.tile_svg
3430
3431    # Copy clip and mask for clipping support
3432    if hasattr(item, "clip"):
3433        sketch.clip = item.clip
3434    if hasattr(item, "mask"):
3435        sketch.mask = item.mask
3436    if "_mask_opacity" in item.__dict__:
3437        sketch._mask_opacity = item._mask_opacity
3438    if "_mask_stops" in item.__dict__:
3439        sketch._mask_stops = item._mask_stops
3440    if "_mask_axis" in item.__dict__:
3441        sketch._mask_axis = item._mask_axis
3442
3443    if hasattr(item, "even_odd") and item.even_odd is not None:
3444        sketch.even_odd = item.even_odd
3445    elif "non_zero" in kwargs and kwargs["non_zero"] is not None:
3446        use_nonzero = bool(kwargs["non_zero"])
3447        sketch.even_odd = not use_nonzero
3448        sketch.fill_mode = FillMode.NONZERO if use_nonzero else FillMode.EVENODD
3449
3450    for k, v in kwargs.items():
3451        if k in _PRESEDENCE_KEYS or k in _NON_STYLE_KEYS:
3452            continue
3453
3454        setattr(sketch, k, v)
3455
3456    if sketch.draw_markers:
3457        for name in (
3458            "marker_alpha",
3459            "marker_color",
3460            "marker_line_style",
3461            "marker_line_width",
3462            "marker_radius",
3463            "marker_size",
3464            "marker_type",
3465        ):
3466            if name not in sketch.__dict__ or sketch.__dict__[name] is None:
3467                setattr(sketch, name, runtime_defaults[name])
3468
3469    if "_group_hull_points" in kwargs:
3470        sketch._group_hull_points = kwargs["_group_hull_points"]
3471
3472    if "indices" in kwargs:
3473        sketch.indices = kwargs["indices"]
3474    elif "indices" in item.__dict__:
3475        sketch.indices = item.indices
3476
3477    if "midpoints" in kwargs:
3478        sketch.midpoints = kwargs["midpoints"]
3479
3480    if "index_font_size" in kwargs:
3481        sketch.index_font_size = kwargs["index_font_size"]
3482    elif "index_font_size" in item.__dict__:
3483        sketch.index_font_size = item.index_font_size
3484
3485    if (
3486        kwargs.get("vertices")
3487        or kwargs.get("vertex_on_hull")
3488        or getattr(item, "vertex_on_hull", False)
3489    ):
3490        sketch.show_vertex_coords = True
3491    elif "show_vertex_coords" in item.__dict__:
3492        sketch.show_vertex_coords = item.show_vertex_coords
3493
3494    if "vertex_on_hull" in kwargs:
3495        sketch.vertex_on_hull = kwargs["vertex_on_hull"]
3496    elif "vertex_on_hull" in item.__dict__:
3497        sketch.vertex_on_hull = item.vertex_on_hull
3498
3499    if "vertex_font_size" in kwargs:
3500        sketch.vertex_font_size = kwargs["vertex_font_size"]
3501    elif "vertex_font_size" in item.__dict__:
3502        sketch.vertex_font_size = item.vertex_font_size
3503
3504    if "index_offset" in kwargs:
3505        sketch.index_offset = kwargs["index_offset"]
3506    elif "index_offset" in item.__dict__:
3507        sketch.index_offset = item.index_offset
3508
3509    if "vertex_offset" in kwargs:
3510        sketch.vertex_offset = kwargs["vertex_offset"]
3511    elif "vertex_offset" in item.__dict__:
3512        sketch.vertex_offset = item.vertex_offset
3513
3514    if "index_font_color" in kwargs:
3515        sketch.index_font_color = kwargs["index_font_color"]
3516    elif "index_font_color" in item.__dict__:
3517        sketch.index_font_color = item.index_font_color
3518
3519    if "vertex_font_color" in kwargs:
3520        sketch.vertex_font_color = kwargs["vertex_font_color"]
3521    elif "vertex_font_color" in item.__dict__:
3522        sketch.vertex_font_color = item.vertex_font_color
3523
3524    if "index_font_family" in kwargs:
3525        sketch.index_font_family = kwargs["index_font_family"]
3526    elif "index_font_family" in item.__dict__:
3527        sketch.index_font_family = item.index_font_family
3528
3529    if "vertex_font_family" in kwargs:
3530        sketch.vertex_font_family = kwargs["vertex_font_family"]
3531    elif "vertex_font_family" in item.__dict__:
3532        sketch.vertex_font_family = item.vertex_font_family
3533
3534    if "debug" in kwargs:
3535        sketch.debug = kwargs["debug"]
3536
3537    if (
3538        sketch.marker_type == MarkerType.INDICES
3539        and "indices" not in kwargs
3540        and "indices" not in item.__dict__
3541    ):
3542        sketch.indices = True

3545def get_verts_in_new_pos(item: Shape, **kwargs: object) -> list[PointType]:
3546    """Return the item's vertices, translated when ``pos`` is given.
3547
3548    Args:
3549        item: Item whose vertices are read.
3550        **kwargs: ``pos`` is the new midpoint. Other keys are ignored
3551            by this function.
3552
3553    Returns:
3554        list: Vertices in the new position, or the item's current
3555        vertices when ``pos`` is not given.
3556
3557    Examples:
3558        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
3559        >>> shape = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (80, 0), (80, 80)])
3560        >>> get_verts_in_new_pos(shape, pos=(60, 40))[0]
3561        [20.0, 0.0]
3562    """
3563    if "pos" in kwargs:
3564        x, y = item.midpoint[:2]
3565        x1, y1 = kwargs["pos"][:2]
3566        dx = x1 - x
3567        dy = y1 - y
3568        trans_mat = translation_matrix(dx, dy)
3569        vertices = item.primary_points.homogen_coords @ trans_mat
3570        vertices = vertices[:, :2].tolist()
3571    else:
3572        vertices = item.vertices
3573
3574    return vertices
3575

3580def _get_tag_sketch(
3581    item: Drawable, canvas: Canvas, **kwargs: object
3582) -> TagSketch | LatexSketch:
3583    """Create a text or LaTeX sketch from the given Tag.
3584
3585    Args:
3586        item: Item to be sketched.
3587        canvas: Canvas object.
3588        **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments.
3589
3590    Returns:
3591        TagSketch | LatexSketch: Created sketch.
3592    """
3593    pos = kwargs.get("pos", item.pos)
3594    formula = _tag_latex_formula(item.text)
3595    if formula is not None:
3596        _, item_rotation, _ = decompose_transformations(item.xform_matrix)
3597        font_size = canvas.resolve_property(item, "font_size")
3598        font_family = canvas.resolve_property(item, "font_family")
3599        if font_family == runtime_defaults["font_family"]:
3600            font_family = None
3601        font_color = canvas.resolve_property(item, "font_color")
3602        bold = canvas.resolve_property(item, "bold")
3603        anchor = kwargs["anchor"] if "anchor" in kwargs else item.anchor
3604        sketch = LatexSketch(
3605            formula=formula,
3606            pos=pos,
3607            font_size=font_size,
3608            font_family=font_family,
3609            font_color=font_color,
3610            bold=bold,
3611            anchor=anchor,
3612            angle=item_rotation,
3613            xform_matrix=canvas._sketch_xform_matrix,
3614        )
3615        for name, value in kwargs.items():
3616            if name == "pos":
3617                continue
3618            setattr(sketch, name, value)
3619        width, height = _measure_latex_formula(
3620            formula,
3621            sketch.font_size,
3622            sketch.font_family,
3623            sketch.bold,
3624        )
3625        sketch.formula_size = (width, height)
3626        anchor_offsets = {
3627            Anchor.SOUTHWEST: (0, 0),
3628            Anchor.SOUTH: (width / 2, 0),
3629            Anchor.SOUTHEAST: (width, 0),
3630            Anchor.WEST: (0, height / 2),
3631            Anchor.CENTER: (width / 2, height / 2),
3632            Anchor.EAST: (width, height / 2),
3633            Anchor.NORTHWEST: (0, height),
3634            Anchor.NORTH: (width / 2, height),
3635            Anchor.NORTHEAST: (width, height),
3636        }
3637        offset_x, offset_y = anchor_offsets[sketch.anchor]
3638        x, y = sketch.pos[:2]
3639        canvas._all_vertices.extend(
3640            [
3641                (x - offset_x, y - offset_y),
3642                (x + width - offset_x, y - offset_y),
3643                (x - offset_x, y + height - offset_y),
3644                (x + width - offset_x, y + height - offset_y),
3645            ]
3646        )
3647        return sketch
3648
3649    _, rotation, _ = decompose_transformations(item.xform_matrix)
3650
3651    sketch = TagSketch(
3652        text=item.text,
3653        pos=pos,
3654        anchor=item.anchor,
3655        angle=rotation,
3656        xform_matrix=canvas._sketch_xform_matrix,
3657    )
3658    for attrib_name in tag_style_map:
3659        if attrib_name == "color":
3660            continue
3661        if attrib_name == "fill_color":
3662            fill_color = canvas.resolve_property(item, "fill_color")
3663            if fill_color == colors.black:
3664                sketch.frame_back_color = runtime_defaults["frame_back_color"]
3665            else:
3666                sketch.frame_back_color = fill_color
3667            continue
3668        attrib_value = canvas.resolve_property(item, attrib_name)
3669        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
3670    sketch.text_width = item.text_width
3671    sketch.visible = item.visible
3672
3673    for k, v in kwargs.items():
3674        if k in _PRECEDENCE_KEYS:
3675            continue
3676        setattr(sketch, k, v)
3677    _, rotation, scale = decompose_transformations(canvas._sketch_xform_matrix)
3678    if rotation != 0:
3679        sketch.angle = float(sketch.angle) + float(rotation)
3680    scale_x = float(scale[0])
3681    if scale_x != 1.0 and isinstance(sketch.font_size, (int, float)):
3682        sketch.font_size = float(sketch.font_size) * scale_x
3683    return sketch
3684
3685
3686def _get_text_path_sketch(
3687    item: Drawable, canvas: Canvas, **kwargs: object
3688) -> TextPathSketch:
3689    """Create a TextPathSketch from the given item."""
3690    transformed_path = item.path.copy()
3691    transformed_path._update(item.xform_matrix)
3692    transformed_path._update(canvas._sketch_xform_matrix)
3693    sketch = TextPathSketch(
3694        text=item.text,
3695        path_data=path2d_to_svg_path(transformed_path),
3696        draw_path=item.draw_path,
3697        vertices=list(transformed_path.all_vertices),
3698        xform_matrix=canvas._sketch_xform_matrix,
3699    )
3700    sketch.visible = item.visible
3701    sketch.font_family = canvas.resolve_property(item, "font_family")
3702    sketch.font_size = canvas.resolve_property(item, "font_size")
3703    sketch.font_color = canvas.resolve_property(item, "font_color")
3704    sketch.bold = item.bold
3705    sketch.italic = item.italic
3706    if item.draw_path:
3707        set_shape_sketch_style(sketch, item, canvas, **kwargs)
3708        sketch.stroke = True
3709        sketch.fill = False
3710    for key, value in kwargs.items():
3711        if key in _PRECEDENCE_KEYS:
3712            continue
3713        setattr(sketch, key, value)
3714    return sketch

3880def _sync_path_sketch_fill_rule(
3881    path_sketch: PathSketch,
3882    item: Drawable,
3883    **kwargs: object,
3884) -> None:
3885    """Set ``even_odd`` on a path sketch from ``even_odd``, ``non_zero``, or ``fill_mode``."""
3886    if hasattr(item, "even_odd") and item.even_odd is not None:
3887        path_sketch.even_odd = item.even_odd
3888        return
3889    if "non_zero" in kwargs and kwargs["non_zero"] is not None:
3890        use_nonzero = bool(kwargs["non_zero"])
3891        path_sketch.even_odd = not use_nonzero
3892        path_sketch.fill_mode = (
3893            FillMode.NONZERO if use_nonzero else FillMode.EVENODD
3894        )
3895        return
3896    fill_mode = getattr(path_sketch, "fill_mode", None)
3897    if fill_mode is None:
3898        return
3899    mode = get_enum_value(FillMode, fill_mode)
3900    path_sketch.even_odd = mode == FillMode.EVENODD.value

3903def _get_path_sketch(
3904    item: Drawable, canvas: Canvas, **kwargs: object
3905) -> PathSketch | list[Sketch]:
3906    """Create sketches for a path from the given item.
3907
3908    Args:
3909        item: Item to be sketched.
3910        canvas: Canvas object.
3911        **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments.
3912
3913    Returns:
3914        list: List of created sketches.
3915    """
3916    transformed_path = item.copy()
3917    transformed_path._update(canvas._sketch_xform_matrix)
3918
3919    path_sketch = PathSketch([], canvas._sketch_xform_matrix)
3920    path_sketch.path_data = path2d_to_svg_path(transformed_path)
3921    path_sketch.visible = item.visible
3922    path_sketch.closed = item.closed
3923    path_sketch.vertices = list(transformed_path._label_vertices())
3924    set_shape_sketch_style(path_sketch, item, canvas, **kwargs)
3925    _sync_path_sketch_fill_rule(path_sketch, item, **kwargs)
3926
3927    handle_sketches = []
3928    if kwargs.get("handles"):
3929        del kwargs["handles"]
3930        for handle in item.handles:
3931            shape = Shape(handle)
3932            shape.subtype = Types.HANDLE
3933            sketches = create_sketch(shape, canvas, **kwargs)
3934            handle_sketches.extend(sketches)
3935
3936    if handle_sketches:
3937        return [path_sketch, *handle_sketches]
3938
3939    return path_sketch

3942def _get_bezier_sketch(

3944) -> ShapeSketch | list[Sketch]:

3946    curve_sketch = _get_sketch(item, canvas, **kwargs)
3947    if not kwargs.get("handles"):
3948        return curve_sketch
3949
3950    del kwargs["handles"]
3951    handle_sketches = []
3952    for handle in _bezier_handle_segments(item):
3953        shape = Shape(handle)
3954        shape.subtype = Types.HANDLE
3955        sketches = create_sketch(shape, canvas, **kwargs)
3956        handle_sketches.extend(sketches)
3957
3958    return [curve_sketch, *handle_sketches]

3961def _get_bbox_sketch(
3962    item: BoundingBox, canvas: Canvas, **kwargs: object
3963) -> ShapeSketch | None:
3964    """Create a bounding box sketch from the given item.
3965
3966    Args:
3967        item: Item to be sketched.
3968        canvas: Canvas object.
3969        **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments.
3970
3971    Returns:
3972        ShapeSketch: Created bounding box sketch.
3973    """
3974    nround = runtime_defaults["tikz_nround"]
3975    vertices = [
3976        (round(x[0], nround), round(x[1], nround)) for x in item.corners
3977    ]
3978    if not vertices:
3979        return None
3980    sketch = ShapeSketch(vertices, canvas._sketch_xform_matrix)
3981    sketch.subtype = Types.BBOX_SKETCH
3982    sketch.exclusive = item.exclusive
3983    sketch.visible = True
3984    sketch.closed = True
3985    bbox_style_names = (
3986        "fill",
3987        "stroke",
3988        "line_color",
3989        "line_width",
3990        "line_dash_array",
3991        "draw_markers",
3992    )
3993    for name in bbox_style_names:
3994        if name in kwargs:
3995            setattr(sketch, name, kwargs[name])
3996        else:
3997            setattr(sketch, name, runtime_defaults[f"bbox_{name}"])
3998    for name in shape_style_map:
3999        if name in kwargs and name not in bbox_style_names:
4000            setattr(sketch, name, kwargs[name])
4001    return sketch

4004def _get_handle_sketch(
4005    item: Drawable, canvas: Canvas, **kwargs: object
4006) -> list[Sketch] | None:
4007    """Create handle sketches from the given item.
4008
4009    Args:
4010        item: Item to be sketched.
4011        canvas: Canvas object.
4012        **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments.
4013
4014    Returns:
4015        list: List of created handle sketches.
4016    """
4017    nround = runtime_defaults["tikz_nround"]
4018    vertices = [
4019        (round(x[0], nround), round(x[1], nround)) for x in item.vertices
4020    ]
4021    if not vertices:
4022        return None
4023    if "pos" in kwargs:
4024        x, y = item.midpoint[:2]
4025        x1, y1 = kwargs["pos"][:2]
4026        dx = x1 - x
4027        dy = y1 - y
4028        vertices = [(x + dx, y + dy) for x, y in vertices]
4029    sketches = []
4030    sketch = ShapeSketch(vertices, canvas._sketch_xform_matrix)
4031    sketch.subtype = Types.HANDLE
4032    sketch.closed = False
4033    handle_line_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
4034    handle_line_kwargs["line_width"] = runtime_defaults["line_width"]
4035    set_shape_sketch_style(sketch, item, canvas, **handle_line_kwargs)
4036    sketches.append(sketch)
4037    temp_item = Shape()
4038    temp_item.closed = True
4039    handle_size = runtime_defaults["handle_marker_size"]
4040    handle1 = RectSketch(
4041        item.vertices[0],
4042        handle_size,
4043        handle_size,
4044        canvas._sketch_xform_matrix,
4045    )
4046    set_shape_sketch_style(handle1, temp_item, canvas, **kwargs)
4047    handle2 = RectSketch(
4048        item.vertices[-1],
4049        handle_size,
4050        handle_size,
4051        canvas._sketch_xform_matrix,
4052    )
4053    set_shape_sketch_style(handle2, temp_item, canvas, **kwargs)
4054    sketches.extend([handle1, handle2])
4055
4056    return sketches
4057

4211def create_sketch(
4212    item: Drawable,
4213    canvas: Canvas,
4214    **kwargs: object,
4215) -> Sketch | list[Sketch | None] | None:
4216    """Create a sketch from the given item.
4217
4218    Args:
4219        item: Item to be sketched.
4220        canvas: Canvas object.
4221        **kwargs: Style overrides forwarded to subtype sketch builders.
4222
4223    Returns:
4224        A single sketch, a list of sketches, or ``None`` when invisible.
4225
4226    Examples:
4227        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
4228        >>> from simetri.render.draw import create_sketch
4229        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
4230        >>> shape = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)])
4231        >>> create_sketch(shape, canvas) is not None
4232        True
4233    """
4234    if not (item.visible):
4235        return None
4236
4237    return _d_subtype_sketch[item.subtype](item, canvas, **kwargs)
DrawStyleKwargs = dict[str, object]
def help_lines( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, pos: Sequence[float] | None = None, width: float | None = None, height: float | None = None, spacing: float | None = None, cs_size: float | None = None, deferred: bool = False, **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
130def help_lines(
131    self: Canvas,
132    pos: PointType | None = None,
133    width: float | None = None,
134    height: float | None = None,
135    spacing: float | None = None,
136    cs_size: float | None = None,
137    deferred: bool = False,
138    **kwargs: object,
139) -> Self:
140    """Draw a square grid, and optionally the coordinate axes.
141
142    When ``deferred`` is true, or when ``pos``, ``width``, and ``height``
143    are omitted, a ``HelpLinesSketch`` is stored and clipped to the
144    canvas at save time. Omitted size with ``deferred`` false uses the
145    current canvas matrix. Otherwise the grid is drawn immediately, and
146    the coordinate system is drawn when ``cs_size`` is greater than 0.
147
148    Args:
149        pos: Lower-left corner of the grid.
150        width: Length of the grid along the x-axis.
151        height: Length of the grid along the y-axis.
152        spacing: Distance between grid lines.
153        cs_size: Length of the coordinate axes. Used when ``deferred``
154            is false.
155        deferred: If true, store a help-lines sketch instead of drawing.
156        **kwargs: Style overrides for the grid and axes.
157
158    Returns:
159        Self: The canvas.
160
161    Examples:
162        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
163        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
164        >>> canvas.help_lines((0, 0), 20, 20, spacing=40, cs_size=0, deferred=False) is canvas
165        True
166        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) > 0
167        True
168    """
169    if deferred or (pos is None and width is None and height is None):
170        matrix = (
171            identity_matrix() if deferred else self._xform_matrix.copy()
172        )
173        style_source = SimpleNamespace(type=Types.SKETCH)
174
175        grid_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
176        if "line_width" not in grid_kwargs:
177            grid_kwargs["line_width"] = runtime_defaults["grid_line_width"]
178        if "line_color" not in grid_kwargs and "color" not in grid_kwargs:
179            grid_kwargs["line_color"] = runtime_defaults["grid_line_color"]
180        if "line_dash_array" not in grid_kwargs:
181            grid_kwargs["line_dash_array"] = runtime_defaults[
182                "grid_line_dash_array"
183            ]
184        grid_style = self.resolve_style_properties(
185            style_source,
186            line_style_map,
187            **grid_kwargs,
188        )
189
190        if "colors" in kwargs:
191            x_axis_color, y_axis_color = kwargs["colors"]
192        else:
193            x_axis_color = runtime_defaults["CS_x_color"]
194            y_axis_color = runtime_defaults["CS_y_color"]
195
196        axis_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
197        if "line_width" not in axis_kwargs:
198            axis_kwargs["line_width"] = runtime_defaults["CS_line_width"]
199        x_axis_kwargs = dict(axis_kwargs)
200        x_axis_kwargs["line_color"] = x_axis_color
201        x_axis_style = self.resolve_style_properties(
202            style_source,
203            line_style_map,
204            **x_axis_kwargs,
205        )
206        y_axis_kwargs = dict(axis_kwargs)
207        y_axis_kwargs["line_color"] = y_axis_color
208        y_axis_style = self.resolve_style_properties(
209            style_source,
210            line_style_map,
211            **y_axis_kwargs,
212        )
213
214        if "line_color" in kwargs:
215            origin_color = kwargs["line_color"]
216        elif "color" in kwargs:
217            origin_color = kwargs["color"]
218        else:
219            origin_color = runtime_defaults["CS_origin_color"]
220        origin_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
221        origin_kwargs["color"] = origin_color
222        origin_kwargs["fill"] = True
223        origin_kwargs["stroke"] = True
224        origin_style = self.resolve_style_properties(
225            style_source,
226            shape_style_map,
227            **origin_kwargs,
228        )
229
230        sketch = HelpLinesSketch(
231            spacing,
232            cs_size,
233            grid_style,
234            x_axis_style,
235            y_axis_style,
236            origin_style,
237            runtime_defaults["CS_origin_size"],
238            xform_matrix=matrix,
239        )
240        self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
241    else:
242        self.grid(pos, width, height, spacing, **kwargs)
243        if cs_size > 0:
244            self.draw_CS(cs_size, **kwargs)
245    return self

Draw a square grid, and optionally the coordinate axes.

When deferred is true, or when pos, width, and height are omitted, a HelpLinesSketch is stored and clipped to the canvas at save time. Omitted size with deferred false uses the current canvas matrix. Otherwise the grid is drawn immediately, and the coordinate system is drawn when cs_size is greater than 0.

Arguments:
  • pos: Lower-left corner of the grid.
  • width: Length of the grid along the x-axis.
  • height: Length of the grid along the y-axis.
  • spacing: Distance between grid lines.
  • cs_size: Length of the coordinate axes. Used when deferred is false.
  • deferred: If true, store a help-lines sketch instead of drawing.
  • **kwargs: Style overrides for the grid and axes.
Returns:

Self: The canvas.

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> canvas.help_lines((0, 0), 20, 20, spacing=40, cs_size=0, deferred=False) is canvas
True
>>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) > 0
True
@alias_argument({'radius_x': 'rx', 'radius_y': 'ry'})
def arc( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, center: Sequence[float], radius_x: float, radius_y: float | None = None, start_angle: float = 0, span_angle: float | None = None, rot_angle: float = 0, n_points: int | None = None, *, end_angle: float | None = None, clockwise: bool = False, **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
248@alias_argument({"radius_x": "rx", "radius_y": "ry"})
249def arc(
250    self: Canvas,
251    center: PointType,
252    radius_x: float,
253    radius_y: float | None = None,
254    start_angle: float = 0,
255    span_angle: float | None = None,
256    rot_angle: float = 0,
257    n_points: int | None = None,
258    *,
259    end_angle: float | None = None,
260    clockwise: bool = False,
261    **kwargs: object,
262) -> Self:
263    """Draw an elliptic arc from ``start_angle`` through ``span_angle``
264    or ``end_angle``.
265
266    Args:
267        center: Center of the arc.
268        radius_x: Radius along the local x-axis.
269        radius_y: Radius along the local y-axis; defaults to ``radius_x``.
270        start_angle: Start angle in radians. Defaults to 0.
271        span_angle: Sweep in radians. A negative value draws clockwise.
272            Mutually exclusive with ``end_angle``. At least one of
273            ``span_angle`` or ``end_angle`` is required.
274        rot_angle: Rotation of the arc about ``center``, in radians.
275        n_points: Number of samples along the arc.
276        end_angle: Ending angle in radians. Mutually exclusive with
277            ``span_angle``.
278        clockwise: If True, the arc is drawn clockwise. Defaults to False.
279        **kwargs: Style overrides for the arc sketch.
280
281    Returns:
282        Self: The canvas.
283
284    Examples:
285        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
286        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
287        >>> canvas.arc((0, 0), 10, 10, 0, sg.pi / 2, 0) is canvas
288        True
289        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[-1].subtype.name
290        'ARC_SKETCH'
291    """
292    if radius_y is None:
293        radius_y = radius_x
294    signed_span = resolve_arc_sweep(
295        start_angle,
296        span_angle,
297        end_angle,
298        clockwise,
299    )
300    vertices = _elliptic_arc_points_from_signed(
301        center, radius_x, radius_y, start_angle, signed_span, n_points
302    )
303    if rot_angle != 0:
304        vertices = homogenize(vertices) @ rotation_matrix(rot_angle, center)
305    self._all_vertices.extend(vertices.tolist() + [center])
306
307    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
308    sketch = ArcSketch(
309        vertices=vertices, xform_matrix=self._sketch_xform_matrix
310    )
311    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
312    resolved = self.resolve_style_properties(sketch, shape_style_map, **kwargs)
313    for attrib_name, attrib_value in resolved.items():
314        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
315
316    for k, v in kwargs.items():
317        if k not in _PRECEDENCE_KEYS:
318            setattr(sketch, k, v)
319    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
320
321    return self

Draw an elliptic arc from start_angle through span_angle or end_angle.

def circle( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, radius: float, center: Sequence[float] = (0, 0), **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
378def circle(
379    self: Canvas, radius: float, center: PointType = (0, 0), **kwargs: object
380) -> Self:
381    """Draw a circle with the given radius and optional center.
382
383    Args:
384        radius: Radius of the circle.
385        center: Center of the circle. Defaults to ``(0, 0)``.
386        **kwargs: Style overrides for the circle sketch.
387
388    Returns:
389        Self: The canvas.
390
391    Examples:
392        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
393        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
394        >>> canvas.circle(10, (0, 0)) is canvas
395        True
396        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[-1].subtype.name
397        'CIRCLE_SKETCH'
398    """
399    x, y = center[:2]
400    p1 = x - radius, y - radius
401    p2 = x + radius, y + radius
402    p3 = x - radius, y + radius
403    p4 = x + radius, y - radius
404    self._all_vertices.extend([p1, p2, p3, p4])
405    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
406    sketch = _circle_sketch(center, radius, self._sketch_xform_matrix)
407    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
408    resolved = self.resolve_style_properties(sketch, shape_style_map, **kwargs)
409    for attrib_name, attrib_value in resolved.items():
410        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
411
412    for k, v in kwargs.items():
413        if k not in _PRECEDENCE_KEYS:
414            setattr(sketch, k, v)
415    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
416
417    return self

428    """Draw an ellipse with the given width, height, and optional center.

462    for attrib_name, attrib_value in resolved.items():
463        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
464
465    for k, v in kwargs.items():
466        if k not in _PRECEDENCE_KEYS:

468    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)

473def text(
474    self: Canvas,
475    txt: str,
476    pos: PointType,
477    font_family: str | None = None,
478    font_size: int | None = None,
479    font_color: Color | None = None,
480    anchor: Anchor | None = None,
481    align: Align | None = None,
482    **kwargs: object,
483) -> Self:
484    """Draw text at the given position.
485
486    Args:
487        txt: Text to draw.
488        pos: Position of the text.
489        font_family: Font family. None uses the default.
490        font_size: Font size. None uses the default.
491        font_color: Color of the text. None uses the default.
492        anchor: Anchor of the text. None uses the default.
493        align: Alignment of the text. None uses the default.
494        **kwargs: Style overrides forwarded to the text tag.
495
496    Returns:
497        Self: The canvas.
498
499    Examples:
500        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
501        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
502        >>> canvas.text("A", (0, 0)) is canvas
503        True
504        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
505        1
506    """
507    # first create a Tag object
508    tag_obj = Tag(
509        txt,
510        pos,
511        font_family=font_family,
512        font_size=font_size,
513        font_color=font_color,
514        anchor=anchor,
515        align=align,
516        **kwargs,
517    )
518    tag_obj.draw_frame = False
519    # extend vertices with the Tag's bounding box
520    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
521    extend_vertices(self, tag_obj)
522    sketch = create_sketch(tag_obj, self, **kwargs)
523    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
524    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
525
526    return self

def draw_CS( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, size: float | None = None, **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
661def draw_CS(self: Canvas, size: float | None = None, **kwargs: object) -> Self:
662    """Draw the coordinate axes and an origin marker.
663
664    ``size`` None uses ``runtime_defaults["CS_size"]``. ``kwargs["colors"]`` is
665    ``(x_color, y_color)`` for the two axes.
666
667    Args:
668        size: Length of each axis.
669        **kwargs: Style overrides. ``colors`` selects the axis colors.
670
671    Returns:
672        Self: The canvas.
673
674    Examples:
675        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
676        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
677        >>> canvas.draw_CS(10) is canvas
678        True
679        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) >= 2
680        True
681    """
682    if size is None:
683        size = runtime_defaults["CS_size"]
684    if "colors" in kwargs:
685        x_color, y_color = kwargs["colors"]
686        del kwargs["colors"]
687    else:
688        x_color = runtime_defaults["CS_x_color"]
689        y_color = runtime_defaults["CS_y_color"]
690    if "line_width" not in kwargs:
691        kwargs["line_width"] = runtime_defaults["CS_line_width"]
692    self.line((0, 0), (size, 0), line_color=x_color, **kwargs)
693    self.line((0, 0), (0, size), line_color=y_color, **kwargs)
694    if "line_color" not in kwargs:
695        kwargs["line_color"] = runtime_defaults["CS_origin_color"]
696    self.circle(radius=runtime_defaults["CS_origin_size"], **kwargs)
697
698    return self

714        >>> canvas.lines([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 20)]) is canvas

716        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
717        1
718    """
719    self._all_vertices.extend(points)
720    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
721    sketch = LineSketch(points, self._sketch_xform_matrix, **kwargs)
722    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
723    for attrib_name in line_style_map:
724        attrib_value = self.resolve_property(sketch, attrib_name)
725        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
726    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
727
728    return self

def draw_latex( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, formula: str, pos: Sequence[float], font_size: int = 14, font_family: str | None = None, font_color: simetri.coloring.colors.Color | str | Sequence[float] | None = None, bold: bool = False, anchor: simetri.base.all_enums.Anchor | None = None, **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
805def draw_latex(
806    self: Canvas,
807    formula: str,
808    pos: PointType,
809    font_size: int = 14,
810    font_family: str | None = None,
811    font_color: Color | str | Sequence[float] | None = None,
812    bold: bool = False,
813    anchor: Anchor | None = None,
814    **kwargs: object,
815) -> Self:
816    """Draw a LaTeX math formula on the canvas using matplotlib mathtext (no TeX compiler needed).
817
818    Args:
819        formula (str): LaTeX math string without surrounding $. E.g. r'\\frac{a}{b}'.
820            Text-mode commands are silently mapped to their math-mode equivalents:
821            \\mbox and \\textrm → \\mathrm, \\texttt → \\mathtt
822            (monospace), \\textbf → \\mathbf, \\textit → \\mathit,
823            \\textsf → \\mathsf.
824        pos (PointType): Canvas position of the formula anchor.
825        font_size (int): Font size in points. Defaults to 14.
826        font_family (str, optional): Mathtext fontset — 'computer modern'/'cm', 'stix',
827            'stix sans'/'stixsans', 'dejavu sans'/'dejavusans', 'dejavu serif'/'dejavuserif'.
828            If omitted, Computer Modern is used to match LaTeX's default
829            math font.
830        font_color: Formula colour — simetri Color, (r,g,b) tuple, or matplotlib colour
831            string (e.g. 'red', '#ff0000'). Defaults to black.
832        bold (bool): Wrap the *entire* formula in \\mathbf{}. For partial bold, write
833            \\mathbf{} directly in the formula string.
834            Defaults to False.
835        anchor (Anchor, optional): Anchor point. Defaults to Anchor.SOUTHWEST.
836        **kwargs: Style overrides applied to the formula sketch.
837
838    Returns:
839        Self: The canvas object.
840
841    Examples:
842        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
843        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
844        >>> canvas.draw_latex("x", (0, 0), visible=False) is canvas
845        True
846        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[-1].visible
847        False
848    """
849    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
850    sketch = LatexSketch(
851        formula=formula,
852        pos=pos,
853        font_size=font_size,
854        font_family=font_family,
855        font_color=font_color,
856        bold=bold,
857        anchor=anchor,
858        xform_matrix=self._sketch_xform_matrix,
859    )
860    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
861    for name, value in kwargs.items():
862        setattr(sketch, name, value)
863    # Measure the formula's rendered bounding box so we can register the
864    # correct canvas extents in _all_vertices.
865    W, H = _measure_latex_formula(formula, sketch.font_size, font_family, bold)
866    sketch.formula_size = (W, H)
867
868    # Compute the anchor offset within the formula box (same table as svg.py)
869    _anchor_offsets = {
870        Anchor.SOUTHWEST: (0, 0),
871        Anchor.SOUTH: (W / 2, 0),
872        Anchor.BOTTOM: (W / 2, 0),
873        Anchor.SOUTHEAST: (W, 0),
874        Anchor.WEST: (0, H / 2),
875        Anchor.LEFT: (0, H / 2),
876        Anchor.CENTER: (W / 2, H / 2),
877        Anchor.MIDPOINT: (W / 2, H / 2),
878        Anchor.EAST: (W, H / 2),
879        Anchor.RIGHT: (W, H / 2),
880        Anchor.NORTHWEST: (0, H),
881        Anchor.NORTH: (W / 2, H),
882        Anchor.TOP: (W / 2, H),
883        Anchor.NORTHEAST: (W, H),
884    }
885    resolved_anchor = anchor if anchor is not None else Anchor.SOUTHWEST
886    ax, ay = _anchor_offsets.get(resolved_anchor, (0, 0))
887
888    # sketch.pos is already in transformed canvas-space (xform_matrix applied)
889    sx, sy = sketch.pos[:2]
890    # All four corners of the formula box in canvas-space (y-up)
891    self._all_vertices.extend(
892        [
893            (sx - ax, sy - ay),  # SW
894            (sx + W - ax, sy - ay),  # SE
895            (sx - ax, sy + H - ay),  # NW
896            (sx + W - ax, sy + H - ay),  # NE
897        ]
898    )
899    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
900    return self

Draw a LaTeX math formula on the canvas using matplotlib mathtext (no TeX compiler needed).

Arguments:
  • formula (str): LaTeX math string without surrounding $. E.g. r'\frac{a}{b}'. Text-mode commands are silently mapped to their math-mode equivalents: \mbox and \textrm → \mathrm, \texttt → \mathtt (monospace), \textbf → \mathbf, \textit → \mathit, \textsf → \mathsf.
  • pos (PointType): Canvas position of the formula anchor.
  • font_size (int): Font size in points. Defaults to 14.
  • font_family (str, optional): Mathtext fontset — 'computer modern'/'cm', 'stix', 'stix sans'/'stixsans', 'dejavu sans'/'dejavusans', 'dejavu serif'/'dejavuserif'. If omitted, Computer Modern is used to match LaTeX's default math font.
  • font_color: Formula colour — simetri Color, (r,g,b) tuple, or matplotlib colour string (e.g. 'red', '#ff0000'). Defaults to black.
  • bold (bool): Wrap the entire formula in \mathbf{}. For partial bold, write \mathbf{} directly in the formula string. Defaults to False.
  • anchor (Anchor, optional): Anchor point. Defaults to Anchor.SOUTHWEST.
  • **kwargs: Style overrides applied to the formula sketch.
Returns:

Self: The canvas object.

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> canvas.draw_latex("x", (0, 0), visible=False) is canvas
True
>>> canvas.active_page.sketches[-1].visible
False
