def draw_bbox( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, bbox: simetri.geom.bbox.BoundingBox, border: bool | dict[str, object] = False, centerlines: bool | dict[str, object] = False, diagonals: bool | dict[str, object] = False, **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
 990def draw_bbox(
 991    self: Canvas,
 992    bbox: BoundingBox,
 993    border: bool | dict[str, object] = False,
 994    centerlines: bool | dict[str, object] = False,
 995    diagonals: bool | dict[str, object] = False,
 996    **kwargs: object,
 997) -> Self:
 998    """Draw a bounding box.
 999
1000    If ``border``, ``centerlines``, and ``diagonals`` are all False, the
1001    box is drawn as a bounding-box sketch (same as ``canvas.draw(bbox)``).
1002    If a flag is True, those lines use the default line color and width.
1003    If a flag is a style dict, those lines use that style.
1004
1005    Args:
1006        bbox: Bounding box to draw.
1007        border: Rectangle outline. Defaults to False.
1008        centerlines: Horizontal and vertical centerlines. Defaults to False.
1009        diagonals: Both diagonals. Defaults to False.
1010        **kwargs: Extra style forwarded to each drawn part, or to the
1011            bounding-box sketch when all flags are False.
1012
1013    Returns:
1014        Self: The canvas.
1015
1016    Examples:
1017        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1018        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1019        >>> box = sg.BoundingBox((0, 0), (40, 20))
1020        >>> canvas.draw_bbox(box) is canvas
1021        True
1022        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[0].subtype.name
1023        'BBOX_SKETCH'
1024        >>> len(canvas._all_vertices)
1025        4
1026        >>> canvas.draw_bbox(box, border=True) is canvas
1027        True
1028        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[1].subtype.name
1029        'SHAPE_SKETCH'
1030        >>> before = len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
1031        >>> canvas.draw_bbox(box, centerlines=True, diagonals={"line_width": 2}) is canvas
1032        True
1033        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) - before
1034        4
1035    """
1036    border_style = _bbox_feature_style(border)
1037    centerlines_style = _bbox_feature_style(centerlines)
1038    diagonals_style = _bbox_feature_style(diagonals)
1039    if (
1040        border_style is None
1041        and centerlines_style is None
1042        and diagonals_style is None
1043    ):
1044        extend_vertices(self, bbox)
1045        sketch = create_sketch(bbox, self, **kwargs)
1046        self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
1047        return self
1048
1049    if border_style is not None:
1050        draw(
1051            self,
1052            Shape(bbox.corners, closed=True),
1053            **_merge_style(border_style, kwargs),
1054        )
1055    if centerlines_style is not None:
1056        part_style = _merge_style(centerlines_style, kwargs)
1057        vertical = bbox.vert_centerline
1058        horizontal = bbox.horiz_centerline
1059        draw(self, Shape([vertical[0], vertical[1]]), **part_style)
1060        draw(self, Shape([horizontal[0], horizontal[1]]), **part_style)
1061    if diagonals_style is not None:
1062        part_style = _merge_style(diagonals_style, kwargs)
1063        first = bbox.diagonal1
1064        second = bbox.diagonal2
1065        draw(self, Shape([first[0], first[1]]), **part_style)
1066        draw(self, Shape([second[0], second[1]]), **part_style)
1067
1068    return self

Draw a bounding box.

If border, centerlines, and diagonals are all False, the box is drawn as a bounding-box sketch (same as canvas.draw(bbox)). If a flag is True, those lines use the default line color and width. If a flag is a style dict, those lines use that style.

Arguments:
  • bbox: Bounding box to draw.
  • border: Rectangle outline. Defaults to False.
  • centerlines: Horizontal and vertical centerlines. Defaults to False.
  • diagonals: Both diagonals. Defaults to False.
  • **kwargs: Extra style forwarded to each drawn part, or to the bounding-box sketch when all flags are False.
Returns:

Self: The canvas.

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> box = sg.BoundingBox((0, 0), (40, 20))
>>> canvas.draw_bbox(box) is canvas
True
>>> canvas.active_page.sketches[0].subtype.name
'BBOX_SKETCH'
>>> len(canvas._all_vertices)
4
>>> canvas.draw_bbox(box, border=True) is canvas
True
>>> canvas.active_page.sketches[1].subtype.name
'SHAPE_SKETCH'
>>> before = len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
>>> canvas.draw_bbox(box, centerlines=True, diagonals={"line_width": 2}) is canvas
True
>>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) - before
4
def draw_geometric_grid( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, grid: simetri.group.batch.Group, **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
1081def draw_geometric_grid(self: Canvas, grid: Group, **kwargs: object) -> Self:
1082    """Draw a geometric grid from ``connections``, ``skip``, ``border``,
1083    ``orthogonals``, ``diagonals``, and ``centerlines``.
1084
1085    Args:
1086        grid: ``CircularGrid``, ``SquareGrid``, ``HexGrid``, or ``Grid``.
1087        **kwargs: Extra style forwarded to each drawn part. ``indices=True``
1088            labels the grid vertices only, not the chord endpoints.
1089
1090    Returns:
1091        Self: The canvas.
1092
1093    Examples:
1094        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1095        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1096        >>> grid = sg.CircularGrid(n=6, radius=40)
1097        >>> grid.connections = [3]
1098        >>> grid.orthogonals = False
1099        >>> canvas.draw(grid) is canvas
1100        True
1101        >>> [sketch.subtype.name for sketch in canvas.active_page.sketches]
1102        ['SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'CIRCLE_SKETCH']
1103        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1104        >>> grid = sg.SquareGrid(n=16, cell_size=25)
1105        >>> canvas.draw(grid, indices=True) is canvas
1106        True
1107        >>> [
1108        ...     len(sketch.vertices)
1109        ...     for sketch in canvas.active_page.sketches
1110        ...     if "indices" in sketch.__dict__ and sketch.indices
1111        ... ]
1112        [16]
1113        >>> [
1114        ...     sketch.subtype.name
1115        ...     for sketch in canvas.active_page.sketches
1116        ...     if "indices" not in sketch.__dict__ or not sketch.indices
1117        ... ].count("SHAPE_SKETCH")
1118        22
1119        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1120        >>> grid = sg.SquareGrid(n=16, cell_size=25)
1121        >>> grid.orthogonals = False
1122        >>> grid.diagonals = True
1123        >>> canvas.draw(grid) is canvas
1124        True
1125        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
1126        2
1127        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1128        >>> grid = sg.SquareGrid(n=16, cell_size=25)
1129        >>> grid.orthogonals = False
1130        >>> grid.centerlines = True
1131        >>> canvas.draw(grid) is canvas
1132        True
1133        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
1134        2
1135    """
1136    points = list(grid.points)
1137    part_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
1138    if "indices" in part_kwargs:
1139        del part_kwargs["indices"]
1140    line_style = {
1141        "fill": False,
1142        "stroke": True,
1143        "line_color": runtime_defaults["grid_line_color"],
1144        "line_width": runtime_defaults["grid_line_width"],
1145    }
1146    line_style = _merge_style(line_style, part_kwargs)
1147    for first, second in grid.line_index_pairs():
1148        draw(
1149            self,
1150            Shape([points[first], points[second]]),
1151            **line_style,
1152        )
1153
1154    ortho_style = _bbox_feature_style(grid.orthogonals)
1155    if ortho_style is not None:
1156        for first, second in grid.orthogonal_index_pairs():
1157            draw(
1158                self,
1159                Shape([points[first], points[second]]),
1160                **_merge_style(ortho_style, part_kwargs),
1161            )
1162
1163    centerlines_style = _bbox_feature_style(grid.centerlines)
1164    if centerlines_style is not None and points:
1165        box = bounding_box(points)
1166        part_style = _merge_style(centerlines_style, part_kwargs)
1167        vertical = box.vert_centerline
1168        horizontal = box.horiz_centerline
1169        draw(self, Shape([vertical[0], vertical[1]]), **part_style)
1170        draw(self, Shape([horizontal[0], horizontal[1]]), **part_style)
1171
1172    diag_style = _bbox_feature_style(grid.diagonals)
1173    if diag_style is not None:
1174        for first, second in grid.diagonal_index_pairs():
1175            draw(
1176                self,
1177                Shape([points[first], points[second]]),
1178                **_merge_style(diag_style, part_kwargs),
1179            )
1180
1181    border_style = _bbox_feature_style(grid.border)
1182    if border_style is not None:
1183        draw(
1184            self,
1185            Shape(points, closed=True),
1186            **_merge_style(border_style, part_kwargs),
1187        )
1188
1189    if "indices" in kwargs and kwargs["indices"]:
1190        index_style: dict[str, object] = {
1191            "fill": False,
1192            "stroke": False,
1193            "indices": True,
1194        }
1195        for key in kwargs:
1196            if key == "indices" or key.startswith("index_"):
1197                index_style[key] = kwargs[key]
1198        draw(self, Shape(points), **index_style)
1199
1200    for element in grid:
1201        if element is grid._points:
1202            continue
1203        draw(self, element, **part_kwargs)
1204    return self

Draw a geometric grid from connections, skip, border, orthogonals, diagonals, and centerlines.

Arguments:
  • grid: CircularGrid, SquareGrid, HexGrid, or Grid.
  • **kwargs: Extra style forwarded to each drawn part. indices=True labels the grid vertices only, not the chord endpoints.
Returns:

Self: The canvas.

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> grid = sg.CircularGrid(n=6, radius=40)
>>> grid.connections = [3]
>>> grid.orthogonals = False
>>> canvas.draw(grid) is canvas

>>> [sketch.subtype.name for sketch in canvas.active_page.sketches]
['SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'CIRCLE_SKETCH']
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> grid = sg.SquareGrid(n=16, cell_size=25)
>>> canvas.draw(grid, indices=True) is canvas
True
>>> [
...     len(sketch.vertices)
...     for sketch in canvas.active_page.sketches
...     if "indices" in sketch.__dict__ and sketch.indices
... ]
[16]
>>> [
...     sketch.subtype.name
...     for sketch in canvas.active_page.sketches
...     if "indices" not in sketch.__dict__ or not sketch.indices
... ].count("SHAPE_SKETCH")
22
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> grid = sg.SquareGrid(n=16, cell_size=25)
>>> grid.orthogonals = False
>>> grid.diagonals = True
>>> canvas.draw(grid) is canvas
True
>>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
2
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> grid = sg.SquareGrid(n=16, cell_size=25)
>>> grid.orthogonals = False
>>> grid.centerlines = True
>>> canvas.draw(grid) is canvas
True
>>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
2

1207def draw_pattern(self: Canvas, pattern: Pattern, **kwargs: object) -> Self:
1208    """Draw a pattern by sketching each shape from ``get_shapes()``.
1209
1210    Args:
1211        pattern: Pattern to expand and draw.
1212        **kwargs: Style overrides forwarded to ``get_sketches``.

1214    Returns:

1217    Examples:
1218        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1219        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1220        >>> kernel = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)
1221        >>> pat = sg.Pattern(kernel)
1222        >>> _ = pat.translate(40, 0, reps=1)
1223        >>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_pattern
1224        >>> draw_pattern(canvas, pat) is canvas
1225        True
1226    """
1227    active_sketches = self.active_page.sketches
1228    shapes = pattern.get_shapes()
1229    for shape in shapes:
1230        sketches = get_sketches(shape, self, **kwargs)
1231        if sketches:
1232            active_sketches.extend(sketches)
1233
1234    return self

def draw_widget( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, item: Union[simetri.base.core.Base, simetri.group.batch.Group, simetri.shapes.shape.Shape, simetri.helpers.illustration.Tag, simetri.geom.segments.line_utils.Edge], **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
1262def draw_widget(self: Canvas, item: Drawable, **kwargs: object) -> Self:
1263    """Draw an item that exposes ``draw_list`` as a composite sketch.
1264
1265    Args:
1266        item: Drawable with a ``draw_list`` of drawables and/or functions.
1267        **kwargs: Style overrides applied to nested drawables.
1268
1269    Returns:
1270        Self: The canvas.
1271
1272    Examples:
1273        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1274        >>> from types import SimpleNamespace
1275        >>> widget = SimpleNamespace(
1276        ...     draw_list=[sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)])],
1277        ... )
1278        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1279        >>> canvas.draw_widget(widget) is canvas
1280        True
1281    """
1282    active_sketches = self.active_page.sketches
1283    first_sketch_index = len(active_sketches)
1284
1285    for drawable_item in item.draw_list:
1286        if callable(drawable_item):
1287            drawable_item(self, item, **kwargs)
1288            continue
1289        draw(self, drawable_item, **kwargs)
1290
1291    widget_sketches = active_sketches[first_sketch_index:]
1292    if widget_sketches:
1293        del active_sketches[first_sketch_index:]
1294        active_sketches.append(CompositeSketch(widget_sketches))
1295
1296    return self

Draw an item that exposes draw_list as a composite sketch.

def draw_hobby( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, points: Sequence[Sequence[float]], controls: Sequence[Sequence[float]], cyclic: bool = False, **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
1299def draw_hobby(
1300    self: Canvas,
1301    points: Sequence[PointType],
1302    controls: Sequence[PointType],
1303    cyclic: bool = False,
1304    **kwargs: object,
1305) -> Self:
1306    """Draw a Hobby curve through the given points using the control points.
1307
1308    Args:
1309        points (Sequence[PointType]): Points through which the curve passes.
1310        controls (Sequence[PointType]): Control points for the curve.
1311        cyclic (bool, optional): Whether the curve is cyclic. Defaults to False.
1312        **kwargs: Style overrides forwarded to each Bezier ``draw`` call.
1313
1314    Returns:
1315        Self: The canvas.
1316
1317    Examples:
1318        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1319        >>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_hobby
1320        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1321        >>> draw_hobby(canvas, [(0, 0), (40, 0)], [(20, 20), (20, -20)]) is canvas
1322        True
1323    """
1324    n = len(points)
1325    if cyclic:
1326        for i in range(n):
1327            ind = i * 2
1328            bezier_pnts = bezier_points(
1329                points[i], *controls[ind : ind + 2], points[(i + 1) % n], 20
1330            )
1331            bezier_ = Shape(bezier_pnts)
1332            self.draw(bezier_, **kwargs)
1333    else:
1334        for i in range(len(points) - 1):
1335            ind = i * 2
1336            bezier_pnts = bezier_points(
1337                points[i], *controls[ind : ind + 2], points[i + 1], 20
1338            )
1339            bezier_ = Shape(bezier_pnts)
1340            self.draw(bezier_, **kwargs)
1341    return self

def plait_emboss( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, lace: simetri.interlace.lace.Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None: 
1439def plait_emboss(self: Canvas, lace: Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None:
1440    """Draw lace plaits with ``emboss`` quads and open-end triangles.
1441
1442    Args:
1443        lace: Lace object whose plaits are embossed (mutated).
1444        **kwargs: Style overrides such as ``fill_color``.
1445
1446    Returns:
1447        None
1448
1449    Examples:
1450        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1451        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1452        >>> lace = sg.Lace([(0, 0), (20, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)  # doctest: +SKIP
1453        >>> canvas.draw_lace(lace, plait_style=sg.PlaitStyle.EMBOSS)  # doctest: +SKIP
1454    """
1455    from ..interlace.lace import emboss, shade_emboss, shade_triangle
1456
1457    emboss(lace)
1458    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1459    color = _emboss_base_color(lace, kwargs)
1460    shade = _resolved_shade_plaits(kwargs)
1461    far_point = _lace_far_point(lace)
1462    for ppoly in lace.parallel_poly_list:
1463        poly, poly2 = ppoly.offset_poly_list
1464        for j, div in enumerate(poly.divisions):
1465            for i, sect in enumerate(div.sections):
1466                if sect.is_overlap:
1467                    continue
1468                sect2 = poly2.divisions[j].sections[i]
1469                quad1 = sect.emboss
1470                quad2 = sect2.emboss
1471                if shade:
1472                    color1, color2 = shade_emboss(
1473                        quad1, quad2, color, far_point
1474                    )
1475                else:
1476                    color1 = color2 = color
1477                _draw_fill(self, quad1, color1, style_kwargs)
1478                _draw_fill(self, quad2, color2, style_kwargs)
1479                if sect.end_triangle is not None:
1480                    tri_color = color
1481                    if shade:
1482                        tri_color = shade_triangle(
1483                            sect.end_triangle, color, far_point
1484                        )
1485                    _draw_fill(self, sect.end_triangle, tri_color, style_kwargs)

def plait_emboss2( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, lace: simetri.interlace.lace.Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None: 
1509def plait_emboss2(self: Canvas, lace: Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None:
1510    """Draw lace plaits with ``emboss2_quads``.
1511
1512    Triangles are drawn first, then end quad pairs, then interior pairs.
1513
1514    Args:
1515        lace: Lace object whose plaits are embossed (mutated).
1516        **kwargs: Style overrides such as ``fill_color``.
1517
1518    Returns:
1519        None
1520
1521    Examples:
1522        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1523        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1524        >>> lace = sg.Lace([(0, 0), (20, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)  # doctest: +SKIP
1525        >>> canvas.draw_lace(lace, plait_style=sg.PlaitStyle.EMBOSS2)  # doctest: +SKIP
1526    """
1527    from ..interlace.lace import emboss2_quads, shade_triangle
1528
1529    interior, end_quads, triangles = emboss2_quads(lace)
1530    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1531    color = _emboss_base_color(lace, kwargs)
1532    shade = _resolved_shade_plaits(kwargs)
1533    far_point = _lace_far_point(lace)
1534    for tri in triangles:
1535        tri_color = color
1536        if shade:
1537            tri_color = shade_triangle(tri, color, far_point)
1538        _draw_fill(self, tri, tri_color, style_kwargs)
1539    for pair in end_quads:
1540        _draw_emboss_pair(self, pair, color, far_point, style_kwargs, shade)
1541    for pair in interior:
1542        _draw_emboss_pair(self, pair, color, far_point, style_kwargs, shade)

def plait_frustum( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, lace: simetri.interlace.lace.Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None: 
1545def plait_frustum(self: Canvas, lace: Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None:
1546    """Draw lace plaits with ``get_frustum``.
1547
1548    Args:
1549        lace: Lace object whose plaits are drawn (mutated).
1550        **kwargs: Style overrides such as ``fill_color``.
1551
1552    Returns:
1553        None
1554
1555    Examples:
1556        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1557        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1558        >>> lace = sg.Lace([(0, 0), (20, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)  # doctest: +SKIP
1559        >>> canvas.draw_lace(lace, plait_style=sg.PlaitStyle.FRUSTUM)  # doctest: +SKIP
1560    """
1561    from ..interlace.lace import get_frustum, shade_end_quad
1562
1563    pairs, end_quads, inner_loops = get_frustum(lace)
1564    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1565    color = _emboss_base_color(lace, kwargs)
1566    shade = _resolved_shade_plaits(kwargs)
1567    far_point = _lace_far_point(lace)
1568    for quad1, quad2 in pairs:
1569        if shade:
1570            angle = inclination_angle(*quad1[:2])
1571            shade_angle = abs(radians(135) - angle)
1572            shade_factor = shade_value(shade_angle)
1573            mid1 = midpoint(*quad1[:2])
1574            x1, _ = intersect((far_point, mid1), quad1[:2])
1575            x2, _ = intersect((far_point, mid1), quad2[:2])
1576            shade_step = 0.2
1577            if x2 < x1:
1578                color1 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * -shade_step)
1579                color2 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * shade_step)
1580            elif x1 < x2:
1581                color1 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * shade_step)
1582                color2 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * -shade_step)
1583            else:
1584                color1 = color2 = color
1585        else:
1586            color1 = color2 = color
1587        _draw_fill(self, quad1, color1, style_kwargs)
1588        _draw_fill(self, quad2, color2, style_kwargs)
1589    for quad in end_quads:
1590        end_color = color
1591        if shade:
1592            end_color = shade_end_quad(quad, color, far_point)
1593        _draw_fill(self, quad, end_color, style_kwargs)
1594    for loop in inner_loops:
1595        _draw_fill(self, loop, color, style_kwargs)

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg

def plait_innerloops( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, lace: simetri.interlace.lace.Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None: 
1598def plait_innerloops(self: Canvas, lace: Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None:
1599    loop_offsets = kwargs.get("loop_offsets", None)
1600    loop_offset = kwargs.get("loop_offset", None)
1601    loop_style = kwargs.get("loop_style", None)
1602    plait_style = kwargs.get("plait_style", None)
1603    if not plait_style:
1604        plait_style = {"fill_color": runtime_defaults["plait_color"]}
1605    if loop_offsets:
1606        loop_styles = kwargs.get("loop_styles", None)
1607        for plait in lace.plaits:
1608            self.draw(plait, **plait_style)
1609            for i, offset in enumerate(loop_offsets):
1610                if offset > 0:
1611                    offset *= -1
1612                if loop_styles:
1613                    loop_style = loop_styles[i]
1614                else:
1615                    loop_style = {"fill": False}
1616                loop = Shape(offset_polygon(plait.vertices, offset))
1617                self.draw(loop, **loop_style)
1618    elif loop_offset:
1619        for plait in lace.plaits:
1620            self.draw(plait, **plait_style)
1621            loop = Shape(offset_polygon(plait.vertices, offset))
1622            self.draw(loop, **loop_style)
def plait_diamond( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, lace: simetri.interlace.lace.Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None: 
1625def plait_diamond(self: Canvas, lace: Lace, **kwargs: object) -> None:
1626    """Draw lace plaits using a diamond/offset-quad fill style.
1627
1628    Args:
1629        lace: Lace object whose plaits are drawn.
1630        **kwargs: Style overrides such as ``fill_color``.
1631
1632    Returns:
1633        None
1634
1635    Examples:
1636        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1637        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1638        >>> lace = sg.Lace([(0, 0), (20, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)  # doctest: +SKIP
1639        >>> canvas.plait_diamond(lace)  # doctest: +SKIP
1640    """
1641    lace._set_plait_ends()
1642    quad_pairs = []
1643    end_quads = []
1644    inner_loops = []
1645    if "fill_color" not in kwargs:
1646        kwargs["fill_color"] = _resolved_plait_fill_color(lace, kwargs)
1647    for plait in lace.plaits:
1648        vertices = list(plait.vertices)
1649        e1, e2 = plait.ends
1650        ends = [e1 + 1, e2 + 1]
1651
1652        count = 0
1653        for j, vert in enumerate(vertices):
1654            if j in ends:
1655                break
1656            count += 1
1657
1658        if count:
1659            vertices = vertices[count:] + vertices[:count]
1660
1661        n = len(vertices)
1662        inner_loop = Shape(offset_polygon(vertices, -5), closed=True)
1663        inner_loops.append(inner_loop)
1664        # self.draw(plait, fill=False,**kwargs)
1665        # self.draw(inner_loop, fill=False)
1666        quads = []
1667
1668        for i, vert in enumerate(vertices):
1669            quad = (
1670                vert,
1671                vertices[(i + 1) % n],
1672                inner_loop[(i + 1) % n],
1673                inner_loop[i],
1674            )
1675            shp = Shape(quad, closed=True)
1676            quads.append(shp)
1677        n2 = int(len(quads) / 2) - 1
1678        style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1679        for i in range(n2):
1680            draw(self, quads[i], **style_kwargs)
1681            draw(self, quads[-(i + 2)], **style_kwargs)
1682            quad_pairs.append((quads[i], quads[-(i + 2)]))
1683        end_quads.extend([quads[-1], quads[n2]])
1684
1685    dist = lace.width * 3
1686    cx, cy = lace.midpoint
1687    far_point = cx - dist, cy + dist
1688    plait_fill_color = _resolved_plait_fill_color(lace, kwargs)
1689    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1690
1691    if _resolved_shade_plaits(kwargs):
1692        color = plait_fill_color
1693        for quad1, quad2 in quad_pairs:
1694            angle = inclination_angle(*quad1[:2])
1695            shade_angle = abs(radians(135) - angle)
1696            shade_factor = shade_value(shade_angle)
1697
1698            mid1 = midpoint(*quad1[:2])
1699            line1 = (far_point, mid1)
1700            line2 = quad1[:2]
1701            line3 = quad2[:2]
1702
1703            x1, _ = intersect(line1, line2)
1704            x2, _ = intersect(line1, line3)
1705            shade_step = 0.2
1706
1707            if x2 < x1:
1708                color1 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * -shade_step)
1709                color2 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * shade_step)
1710            elif x1 < x2:
1711                color1 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * shade_step)
1712                color2 = change_lightness(color, shade_factor * -shade_step)
1713            else:
1714                color1 = color2 = color
1715
1716            quad1_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
1717            quad1_kwargs["fill_color"] = color1
1718            quad2_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
1719            quad2_kwargs["fill_color"] = color2
1720            draw(self, quad1, **quad1_kwargs)
1721            draw(self, quad2, **quad2_kwargs)
1722
1723        color = change_lightness(plait_fill_color, -0.1)
1724        for quad in end_quads:
1725            end_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
1726            end_kwargs["fill_color"] = color
1727            draw(self, quad, **end_kwargs)
1728
1729        color = change_lightness(plait_fill_color, 0.1)
1730        for loop in inner_loops:
1731            loop_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
1732            loop_kwargs["fill_color"] = color
1733            draw(self, loop, **loop_kwargs)
1734        return
1735
1736    for quad in end_quads:
1737        draw(self, quad, **style_kwargs)
1738    for loop in inner_loops:
1739        draw(self, loop, **style_kwargs)

def draw_fragments( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, lace: simetri.interlace.lace.Lace | None = None, palette: Sequence[Sequence[float]] | None = None, **kwargs: object) -> None: 
1798def draw_fragments(
1799    self: Canvas,
1800    lace: Lace | None = None,
1801    palette: Sequence[Sequence[float]] | None = None,
1802    **kwargs: object,
1803) -> None:
1804    """Draw lace fragments colored by area or radius bins from a palette.
1805
1806    Args:
1807        lace (optional): Lace object providing ``fragments`` and, for
1808            ``FragmentColoring.RADIUS``, the lace center.
1809        palette (optional): Color palette; ``swatch`` in ``kwargs``
1810            overrides it.
1811        **kwargs: May include ``fragments``, ``fragment_coloring``, and
1812            style overrides forwarded to ``draw``.
1813
1814    Examples:
1815        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1816        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1817        >>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_fragments
1818        >>> fragment = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (20, 0), (20, 20)], closed=True)
1819        >>> draw_fragments(canvas, fragments=[fragment])
1820        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) > 0
1821        True
1822    """
1823    if "fragments" in kwargs:
1824        fragments = kwargs["fragments"]
1825    elif lace is not None:
1826        fragments = lace.fragments
1827    else:
1828        raise KeyError("fragments")
1829
1830    fragments_by_id = {fragment.id: fragment for fragment in fragments}
1831    if "fragment_coloring" in kwargs:
1832        fragment_coloring = kwargs["fragment_coloring"]
1833    else:
1834        fragment_coloring = runtime_defaults["fragment_coloring"]
1835    if fragment_coloring == FragmentColoring.AREA:
1836        items = [(fragment.area, fragment.id) for fragment in fragments]
1837        if lace is not None:
1838            threshold = lace.area_threshold
1839        else:
1840            threshold = runtime_defaults["area_threshold"]
1841    elif fragment_coloring == FragmentColoring.RADIUS:
1842        if lace is None:
1843            raise ValueError("FragmentColoring.RADIUS requires a Lace object.")
1844        center = lace.center
1845        items = [
1846            (distance(center, fragment.CG), fragment.id)
1847            for fragment in fragments
1848        ]
1849        threshold = lace.radius_threshold
1850    else:
1851        raise ValueError(f"Unknown fragment_coloring: {fragment_coloring!r}")
1852
1853    bins = group_into_bins(items, threshold)
1854
1855    if "swatch" in kwargs:
1856        palette = kwargs["swatch"]
1857    elif palette is None:
1858        palette = runtime_defaults["swatch"]
1859
1860    n_palette = len(palette)
1861    n_bins = len(bins)
1862    palette = palette[:: n_palette // n_bins]
1863    palette = [Color(*c) for c in palette]
1864    n = len(palette)
1865    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)
1866    for i, bin_ in enumerate(bins):
1867        color = palette[i % n]
1868        for _, fragment_id in bin_:
1869            fragment = fragments_by_id[fragment_id]
1870            draw_kwargs = dict(style_kwargs)
1871            draw_kwargs["fill_color"] = color
1872            draw(self, fragment, **draw_kwargs)

Draw lace fragments colored by area or radius bins from a palette.

Arguments:
  • lace (optional): Lace object providing fragments and, for FragmentColoring.RADIUS, the lace center.
  • palette (optional): Color palette; swatch in kwargs overrides it.
  • **kwargs: May include fragments, fragment_coloring, and style overrides forwarded to draw.
Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_fragments
>>> fragment = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (20, 0), (20, 20)], closed=True)
>>> draw_fragments(canvas, fragments=[fragment])
>>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) > 0
True

2026    Examples:

2028        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()

2031        True

2058    if line_widths is None:

2060
2061    style_kwargs = _lace_style_kwargs(kwargs)

2063    plaits = lace.plaits

2147def draw_points(
2148    self: Canvas,
2149    points: Sequence[PointType],
2150    marker_style: object | None = None,
2151    **kwargs: object,
2152) -> Self:
2153    """Draw markers at the given points.
2154
2155    If ``marker_style`` is omitted, default marker values are used.
2156    A ``MarkerStyle``, style dict, or ``marker_*`` keyword arguments
2157    override those defaults.
2158
2159    Args:
2160        points: Sequence of ``(x, y)`` positions.
2161        marker_style: Optional marker style. Defaults to None (library
2162            marker defaults).
2163        **kwargs: Extra style forwarded to ``draw``.
2164
2165    Returns:
2166        Self: The canvas.
2167
2168    Raises:
2169        ValueError: If ``points`` is empty.
2170
2171    Examples:
2172        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2173        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2174        >>> canvas.draw_points([(0, 0), (40, 0)]) is canvas
2175        True
2176        >>> sketch = canvas.active_page.sketches[0]
2177        >>> sketch.draw_markers
2178        True
2179        >>> sketch.markers_only
2180        True
2181        >>> sketch.marker_type == sg.defaults["marker_type"]
2182        True
2183        >>> sketch.marker_size == sg.defaults["marker_size"]
2184        True
2185        >>> tuple(sketch.vertices)
2186        ((0.0, 0.0), (40.0, 0.0))
2187        >>> canvas.draw_points([(0, 0)], marker_size=5) is canvas
2188        True
2189        >>> canvas.active_page.sketches[1].marker_size
2190        5
2191    """
2192    point_list = list(points)
2193    if not point_list:
2194        raise ValueError("points must be a non-empty sequence")
2195    draw_kwargs: dict[str, object] = {
2196        "draw_markers": True,
2197        "markers_only": True,
2198    }
2199    for name in _MARKER_DEFAULT_KEYS:
2200        draw_kwargs[name] = runtime_defaults[name]
2201    if marker_style is not None:
2202        overlay = _marker_style_as_draw_kwargs(marker_style)
2203        for name in overlay:
2204            draw_kwargs[name] = overlay[name]
2205    for name in kwargs:
2206        draw_kwargs[name] = kwargs[name]
2207    draw(self, Shape(point_list), **draw_kwargs)
2208    return self

def draw_image( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, image: simetri.images.image.Image, position: Sequence[float] | None = None, scale: tuple[float, float] | float | None = None, **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
2211def draw_image(
2212    self: Canvas,
2213    image: Image,
2214    position: PointType | None = None,
2215    scale: tuple[float, float] | float | None = None,
2216    **kwargs: object,
2217) -> Self:
2218    """Draw the image object.
2219
2220    Args:
2221        image: Image object to be drawn.
2222        position: Position to draw the image at.
2223        scale: Extra scale applied on top of ``image.size``.
2224            ``None`` uses ``(1, 1)``.
2225        **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments.
2226
2227    Returns:
2228        Self: The canvas object.
2229
2230    Examples:
2231        >>> from PIL import Image as PILImage
2232        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2233        >>> from simetri.images.image import Image
2234        >>> image = sg.Image(PILImage.new('RGB', (2, 2)))
2235        >>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_image
2236        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2237        >>> draw_image(canvas, image) is canvas
2238        True
2239    """
2240    if not image.visible:
2241        return self
2242
2243    _translation, rotation, _ = decompose_transformations(image.xform_matrix)
2244    if position is None:
2245        x, y = image.pos[:2]
2246    else:
2247        x, y = position[:2]
2248    pos = [x, y]
2249
2250    if scale is None:
2251        scale = (1, 1)
2252
2253    owns_matrix = (self._sketch_xform_matrix == identity_matrix()).all()
2254    if owns_matrix:
2255        self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
2256    extend_vertices(self, image)
2257    sketch = ImageSketch(
2258        image,
2259        pos=pos,
2260        angle=rotation,
2261        scale=scale,
2262        size=image.size,
2263        file_path=image.file_path,
2264        anchor=image.anchor,
2265        xform_matrix=self._sketch_xform_matrix,
2266    )
2267    if owns_matrix:
2268        self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
2269    for attrib_name in shape_style_map:
2270        attrib_value = self.resolve_property(image, attrib_name)
2271        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
2272    for attrib_name, attrib_value in kwargs.items():
2273        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
2274    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
2275
2276    return self

def draw_pdf( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, pdf: str | simetri.images.image.PDF, pos: Sequence[float] | None = None, size: tuple[float, float] | None = None, scale: float | None = None, angle: float | None = 0, **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
2279def draw_pdf(
2280    self: Canvas,
2281    pdf: str | PDF,
2282    pos: PointType | None = None,
2283    size: tuple[float, float] | None = None,
2284    scale: float | None = None,
2285    angle: float | None = 0,
2286    **kwargs: object,
2287) -> Self:
2288    """Draw a PDF file on the canvas.
2289
2290    Args:
2291        pdf: PDF object, or a file path.
2292        pos: Position of the PDF. None uses the object's position, or
2293            ``(0, 0)`` when ``pdf`` is a path.
2294        size: Drawn size. None uses the object's size.
2295        scale: Scale factor. None uses the object's scale.
2296        angle: Rotation in radians. Defaults to 0.
2297        **kwargs: Style overrides for the PDF sketch.
2298
2299    Returns:
2300        Self: The canvas.
2301
2302    Examples:
2303        >>> import os
2304        >>> import tempfile
2305        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2306        >>> fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.pdf')
2307        >>> _ = os.write(fd, b'%PDF-1.0\\n%%EOF\\n')
2308        >>> os.close(fd)
2309        >>> from simetri.render.draw import draw_pdf
2310        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2311        >>> draw_pdf(canvas, path) is canvas
2312        True
2313        >>> os.unlink(path)
2314    """
2315    if not isinstance(pdf, str):
2316        if not pdf.visible:
2317            return self
2318        translation, rotation, decomposed_scale = decompose_transformations(
2319            pdf.xform_matrix
2320        )
2321        if pos is None:
2322            x, y = pdf.pos[:2]
2323        else:
2324            x, y = pos[:2]
2325        dx, dy = translation
2326        pos = [x + dx, y + dy]
2327
2328        if scale is None:
2329            scale = pdf.scale if pdf.scale is not None else decomposed_scale
2330
2331        if angle is None:
2332            angle = rotation
2333        file_path = pdf.file_path
2334        if size is None:
2335            size = pdf.size
2336    else:
2337        # If pdf is a file path, we assume it is a PDF object
2338        pos = pos[:2] if pos else (0, 0)
2339        scale = scale if scale is not None else 1.0
2340        file_path = pdf
2341    if size is None:
2342        placed = [pos]
2343    else:
2344        width, height = size
2345        if isinstance(scale, (int, float)):
2346            sx = sy = float(scale)
2347        else:
2348            sx, sy = float(scale[0]), float(scale[1])
2349        half_w = width * sx / 2
2350        half_h = height * sy / 2
2351        x, y = pos[:2]
2352        placed = [
2353            (x - half_w, y - half_h),
2354            (x + half_w, y - half_h),
2355            (x + half_w, y + half_h),
2356            (x - half_w, y + half_h),
2357        ]
2358        if angle:
2359            placed = (
2360                homogenize(placed) @ rotation_matrix(angle, (x, y))
2361            ).tolist()
2362    self._sketch_xform_matrix = self.xform_matrix
2363    _extend_canvas_space_points(self, placed)
2364    sketch = PDFSketch(
2365        file_path,
2366        pos=pos,
2367        scale=scale,
2368        angle=angle if angle is not None else 0,
2369        size=size,
2370        xform_matrix=self._sketch_xform_matrix,
2371    )
2372    self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
2373    for attrib_name, attrib_value in kwargs.items():
2374        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
2375    self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
2376
2377    return self

def draw_dimension( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, item: simetri.helpers.dimension.Dimension, **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
2533def draw_dimension(self: Canvas, item: Dimension, **kwargs: object) -> Self:
2534    """Draw the dimension object.
2535
2536    Constructor style keywords stored on ``item.kwargs`` are used first.
2537    Keywords passed to this call replace those.
2538
2539    Args:
2540        item: Dimension object to be drawn.
2541        **kwargs: ``ext_line_alpha``, ``ext_line_color``,
2542            ``ext_line_dash_array``, and ``ext_line_width`` style both
2543            extension lines. ``shaft_line_alpha``, ``shaft_line_color``,
2544            ``shaft_line_dash_array``, and ``shaft_line_width`` style
2545            the dimension line and, when the label is at the side, both
2546            arrow shafts and the line between them. ``head_fill_alpha``,
2547            ``head_fill_color``, ``head_line_alpha``,
2548            ``head_line_color``, and ``head_line_width`` style every
2549            arrow head. ``tag_bold``, ``tag_fill``,
2550            ``tag_fill_color``, ``tag_font_alpha``, ``tag_font_color``,
2551            ``tag_font_family``, ``tag_font_size``, ``tag_line_color``,
2552            ``tag_line_width``, and ``tag_stroke`` style the label.
2553            The label defaults to a white fill with no stroke. ``color``
2554            and ``alpha`` set every part; a prefixed name wins.
2555
2556    Returns:
2557        Self: The canvas object.
2558
2559    Examples:
2560        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2561        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2562        >>> dim = sg.Dimension((0, 0), (40, 0), "up", 5)
2563        >>> canvas.draw_dimension(dim) is canvas
2564        True
2565        >>> dim.ext1.line_width
2566        0.75
2567        >>> dim.dim_line.line.line_width
2568        0.75
2569        >>> dim.ext1.line_color == sg.colors.dark_gray
2570        True
2571        >>> dim.dim_line.head.fill_color == sg.colors.dark_gray
2572        True
2573    """
2574    if item.kwargs:
2575        merged = dict(item.kwargs)
2576        merged.update(kwargs)
2577        kwargs = merged
2578
2579    for shape in item.all_shapes:
2580        _extend_canvas_space_points(self, shape.corners)
2581
2582    def _add_sketch(sketch: Sketch | list[Sketch] | None) -> None:
2583        if sketch is None:
2584            return
2585        if isinstance(sketch, list):
2586            self.active_page.sketches.extend(sketch)
2587        else:
2588            self.active_page.sketches.append(sketch)
2589
2590    draw_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
2591    ext_style = _line_part_style(
2592        _pop_prefixed(draw_kwargs, "ext_"),
2593        draw_kwargs["color"] if "color" in draw_kwargs else None,
2594        draw_kwargs["alpha"] if "alpha" in draw_kwargs else None,
2595    )
2596    common_color = draw_kwargs["color"] if "color" in draw_kwargs else None
2597    common_alpha = draw_kwargs["alpha"] if "alpha" in draw_kwargs else None
2598    if "color" in draw_kwargs:
2599        del draw_kwargs["color"]
2600    if "alpha" in draw_kwargs:
2601        del draw_kwargs["alpha"]
2602    shaft_style = _line_part_style(
2603        _pop_prefixed(draw_kwargs, "shaft_"), common_color, common_alpha
2604    )
2605    head_style = _head_part_style(
2606        _pop_prefixed(draw_kwargs, "head_"), common_color, common_alpha
2607    )
2608    tag_part = _pop_prefixed(draw_kwargs, "tag_")
2609    for name in (
2610        "bold",
2611        "font_alpha",
2612        "font_color",
2613        "font_family",
2614        "italic",
2615    ):
2616        if name not in draw_kwargs:
2617            continue
2618        if name not in tag_part:
2619            tag_part[name] = draw_kwargs[name]
2620        del draw_kwargs[name]
2621
2622    for ext in [item.ext1, item.ext2, item.ext3]:
2623        if ext:
2624            _apply_part_style(ext, ext_style)
2625            _add_sketch(create_sketch(ext, self, **draw_kwargs))
2626    _apply_arrow_style(item.dim_line, shaft_style, head_style)
2627    _apply_arrow_style(item.arrow1, shaft_style, head_style)
2628    _apply_arrow_style(item.arrow2, shaft_style, head_style)
2629    if item.midline is not None and item.show_midline:
2630        _apply_part_style(item.midline, shaft_style)
2631    if item.dim_line:
2632        _add_sketch(create_sketch(item.dim_line, self, **draw_kwargs))
2633    if item.arrow1:
2634        _add_sketch(create_sketch(item.arrow1, self, **draw_kwargs))
2635        if item.midline is not None and item.show_midline:
2636            _add_sketch(create_sketch(item.midline, self, **draw_kwargs))
2637    if item.arrow2:
2638        _add_sketch(create_sketch(item.arrow2, self, **draw_kwargs))
2639    x, y = item.text_pos[:2]
2640    tag_kwargs: dict[str, object] = {}
2641    if "font_size" in tag_part and tag_part["font_size"] is not None:
2642        tag_kwargs["font_size"] = tag_part["font_size"]
2643    elif "font_size" in draw_kwargs:
2644        tag_kwargs["font_size"] = draw_kwargs["font_size"]
2645    else:
2646        tag_kwargs["font_size"] = item.font_size
2647    if "anchor" in draw_kwargs:
2648        tag_kwargs["anchor"] = draw_kwargs["anchor"]
2649    else:
2650        tag_kwargs["anchor"] = item.text_anchor
2651    if "align" in draw_kwargs:
2652        tag_kwargs["align"] = draw_kwargs["align"]
2653    else:
2654        tag_kwargs["align"] = item.text_align
2655    if "fill" in tag_part and tag_part["fill"] is not None:
2656        tag_kwargs["fill"] = tag_part["fill"]
2657    elif "fill" in draw_kwargs:
2658        tag_kwargs["fill"] = draw_kwargs["fill"]
2659    else:
2660        tag_kwargs["fill"] = True
2661    if "stroke" in tag_part and tag_part["stroke"] is not None:
2662        tag_kwargs["stroke"] = tag_part["stroke"]
2663    else:
2664        tag_kwargs["stroke"] = False
2665    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "font_color")
2666    if stated:
2667        tag_kwargs["font_color"] = value
2668    elif common_color is not None:
2669        tag_kwargs["font_color"] = common_color
2670    else:
2671        tag_kwargs["font_color"] = runtime_defaults["dim_color"]
2672    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "font_family")
2673    if stated:
2674        tag_kwargs["font_family"] = value
2675    font_alpha = None
2676    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "font_alpha")
2677    if stated:
2678        font_alpha = value
2679    elif common_alpha is not None:
2680        font_alpha = common_alpha
2681    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "bold")
2682    if stated:
2683        tag_kwargs["bold"] = value
2684    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "italic")
2685    if stated:
2686        tag_kwargs["italic"] = value
2687    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "fill_color")
2688    if stated:
2689        tag_kwargs["fill_color"] = value
2690    elif "fill_color" in draw_kwargs:
2691        tag_kwargs["fill_color"] = draw_kwargs["fill_color"]
2692    else:
2693        tag_kwargs["fill_color"] = colors.white
2694    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "line_color")
2695    if stated:
2696        tag_kwargs["line_color"] = value
2697    elif common_color is not None:
2698        tag_kwargs["line_color"] = common_color
2699    else:
2700        tag_kwargs["line_color"] = runtime_defaults["dim_color"]
2701    stated, value = _stated(tag_part, "line_width")
2702    if stated:
2703        tag_kwargs["line_width"] = value
2704    tag = Tag(item.text, (x, y), **tag_kwargs)
2705    if font_alpha is not None:
2706        tag.font_alpha = font_alpha
2707    formula_frame = _dimension_formula_frame(tag)
2708    if formula_frame is not None:
2709        _extend_canvas_space_points(self, formula_frame.corners)
2710        self.active_page.sketches.append(create_sketch(formula_frame, self))
2711    extend_vertices(self, tag)
2712    self.active_page.sketches.append(create_sketch(tag, self))
2713
2714    return self

Draw the dimension object.

Constructor style keywords stored on item.kwargs are used first. Keywords passed to this call replace those.

Arguments:
  • item: Dimension object to be drawn.
  • **kwargs: ext_line_alpha, ext_line_color, ext_line_dash_array, and ext_line_width style both extension lines. shaft_line_alpha, shaft_line_color, shaft_line_dash_array, and shaft_line_width style the dimension line and, when the label is at the side, both arrow shafts and the line between them. head_fill_alpha, head_fill_color, head_line_alpha, head_line_color, and head_line_width style every arrow head. tag_bold, tag_fill, tag_fill_color, tag_font_alpha, tag_font_color, tag_font_family, tag_font_size, tag_line_color, tag_line_width, and tag_stroke style the label. The label defaults to a white fill with no stroke. color and alpha set every part; a prefixed name wins.
Returns:

Self: The canvas object.

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> dim = sg.Dimension((0, 0), (40, 0), "up", 5)
>>> canvas.draw_dimension(dim) is canvas
True
>>> dim.ext1.line_width
0.75
>>> dim.dim_line.line.line_width
0.75
>>> dim.ext1.line_color == sg.colors.dark_gray
True
>>> dim.dim_line.head.fill_color == sg.colors.dark_gray
True
def grid( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, pos: Sequence[float] = (0, 0), width: float | None = None, height: float | None = None, step_size: float | None = None, **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
2717def grid(
2718    self: Canvas,
2719    pos: PointType = (0, 0),
2720    width: float | None = None,
2721    height: float | None = None,
2722    step_size: float | None = None,
2723    **kwargs: object,
2724) -> Self:
2725    """Draw a rectangular grid.
2726
2727    Args:
2728        pos: Lower-left corner of the grid.
2729        width: Length along the x-axis. None uses ``runtime_defaults["grid_size"]``.
2730        height: Length along the y-axis. None uses ``runtime_defaults["grid_size"]``
2731            when ``width`` is also None.
2732        step_size: Distance between grid lines.
2733        **kwargs: Style overrides for the grid lines.
2734
2735    Returns:
2736        Self: The canvas.
2737
2738    Examples:
2739        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2740        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2741        >>> canvas.grid((0, 0), 20, 20, 10) is canvas
2742        True
2743        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches) > 0
2744        True
2745    """
2746    x, y = pos[:2]
2747    if width is None:
2748        width = runtime_defaults["grid_size"]
2749        height = runtime_defaults["grid_size"]
2750    if "line_width" not in kwargs:
2751        kwargs["line_width"] = runtime_defaults["grid_line_width"]
2752    if "line_color" not in kwargs:
2753        kwargs["line_color"] = runtime_defaults["grid_line_color"]
2754    if "line_dash_array" not in kwargs:
2755        kwargs["line_dash_array"] = runtime_defaults["grid_line_dash_array"]
2756
2757    line_y = Shape([(x, y), (x + width, y)], **kwargs)
2758    line_x = Shape([(x, y), (x, y + height)], **kwargs)
2759    lines_x = line_y.translate(0, step_size, reps=int(height / step_size))
2760    lines_y = line_x.translate(step_size, 0, reps=int(width / step_size))
2761    self.draw(lines_x)
2762    self.draw(lines_y)
2763    return self

def extend_vertices( canvas: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, item: Union[simetri.base.core.Base, simetri.group.batch.Group, simetri.shapes.shape.Shape, simetri.helpers.illustration.Tag, simetri.geom.segments.line_utils.Edge, simetri.geom.bbox.BoundingBox]) -> None: 
2841def extend_vertices(canvas: Canvas, item: Drawable | BoundingBox) -> None:
2842    """Append the item's bounds geometry in draw-time canvas space.
2843
2844    Polygonal shapes and arrow parts use their actual vertices so rotating
2845    an enclosing rectangle does not introduce empty space into the bounds.
2846
2847    Args:
2848        canvas: Canvas whose ``_all_vertices`` list is extended (mutated).
2849        item: Item whose vertices are copied onto the canvas.
2850
2851    Examples:
2852        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2853        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2854        >>> extend_vertices(canvas, sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (0, 40)]))
2855        >>> len(canvas._all_vertices) > 0
2856        True
2857    """
2858    all_vertices = canvas._all_vertices
2859    if item.subtype == Types.DOTS:
2860        vertices = [x.pos for x in item.all_shapes]
2861        vertices = [
2862            x[:2] for x in homogenize(vertices) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2863        ]
2864        all_vertices.extend(vertices)
2865    elif item.subtype == Types.DOT:
2866        vertices = [item.pos]
2867        vertices = [
2868            x[:2] for x in homogenize(vertices) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2869        ]
2870        all_vertices.extend(vertices)
2871    elif item.subtype == Types.TABLE:
2872        vertices = [
2873            x[:2]
2874            for x in homogenize(item.all_vertices) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2875        ]
2876        all_vertices.extend(vertices)
2877    elif item.subtype == Types.TAG:
2878        # Tag objects have all_vertices property that includes text bounding box
2879        vertices = [
2880            x[:2]
2881            for x in homogenize(item.all_vertices) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2882        ]
2883        all_vertices.extend(vertices)
2884    elif item.subtype == Types.TEXT_PATH:
2885        vertices = [
2886            x[:2]
2887            for x in homogenize(item.all_vertices) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2888        ]
2889        all_vertices.extend(vertices)
2890    elif item.subtype == Types.ARROW:
2891        for shape in item.all_shapes:
2892            all_vertices.extend(_canvas_space_points(canvas, shape.vertices))
2893    elif item.subtype == Types.LACE:
2894        for plait in item.plaits:
2895            all_vertices.extend(_canvas_space_points(canvas, plait.corners))
2896        for fragment in item.fragments:
2897            all_vertices.extend(_canvas_space_points(canvas, fragment.corners))
2898    elif item.subtype == Types.PATH2D:
2899        vertices = [
2900            x[:2]
2901            for x in homogenize(item.all_vertices) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2902        ]
2903        all_vertices.extend(vertices)
2904    elif item.subtype == Types.PATTERN:
2905        all_vertices.extend(_canvas_space_points(canvas, item.all_vertices))
2906    elif item.subtype in (Types.ANNOTATION, Types.DCEL, Types.GROUP):
2907        for element in item:
2908            extend_vertices(canvas, element)
2909    elif item.subtype == Types.FIGURE:
2910        if getattr(item, "draw_geometry", True) and item.geometry is not None:
2911            extend_vertices(canvas, item.geometry)
2912        if getattr(item, "draw_skin", True) and item.skin is not None:
2913            extend_vertices(canvas, item.skin)
2914    elif item.subtype == Types.VECTOR:
2915        return
2916    elif item.subtype in (
2917        Types.ARROW_HEAD,
2918        Types.LINE,
2919        Types.POLYLINE,
2920        Types.RECTANGLE,
2921        Types.SEGMENT,
2922        Types.SHAPE,
2923        Types.SQUARE,
2924    ):
2925        all_vertices.extend(_canvas_space_points(canvas, item.vertices))
2926    else:
2927        corners = [
2928            x[:2]
2929            for x in homogenize(item.corners) @ canvas._sketch_xform_matrix
2930        ]
2931        all_vertices.extend(corners)

def draw( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, item: Union[simetri.base.core.Base, simetri.group.batch.Group, simetri.shapes.shape.Shape, simetri.helpers.illustration.Tag, simetri.geom.segments.line_utils.Edge, simetri.geom.bbox.BoundingBox, simetri.shapes.shape.Clipping], **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
2963def draw(
2964    self: Canvas, item: Drawable | BoundingBox | Clipping, **kwargs: object
2965) -> Self:
2966    """Draw an item on the canvas.
2967
2968    ``draw_items`` and ``draw_pos`` are the ``Canvas.draw`` call list and
2969    its ``pos``. They are removed before any sketch is styled.
2970
2971    Args:
2972        item: Shape, group, or other drawable.
2973        **kwargs: Style overrides applied while drawing.
2974
2975    Returns:
2976        Self: The canvas.
2977
2978    Raises:
2979        TypeError: If ``item`` is a ``Lattice``. Draw ``lattice.pattern``
2980            after ``expand`` or ``populate_unit``.
2981
2982    Examples:
2983        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2984        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2985        >>> canvas.draw(sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)])) is canvas
2986        True
2987        >>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
2988        1
2989        >>> lattice = sg.lattice_p1(40, 40)
2990        >>> _ = lattice.expand(sg.letter_F(), 1)
2991        >>> canvas.draw(lattice)  # doctest: +IGNORE_EXCEPTION_DETAIL
2992        Traceback (most recent call last):
2993            ...
2994        TypeError: Cannot draw a Lattice. Draw lattice.pattern instead.
2995        >>> mesh = sg.DCEL()
2996        >>> _ = mesh.build_from_polygons([[(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40), (0, 40)]])
2997        >>> dcel_canvas = sg.Canvas()
2998        >>> dcel_canvas.draw(mesh) is dcel_canvas
2999        True
3000        >>> len(dcel_canvas.active_page.sketches)
3001        1
3002        >>> labeled = sg.Canvas()
3003        >>> labeled.draw(mesh, face_indices=True) is labeled
3004        True
3005        >>> len(labeled.active_page.sketches)
3006        2
3007    """
3008    draw_items = kwargs.pop("draw_items", None)
3009    draw_pos = kwargs.pop("draw_pos", None)
3010    try:
3011        draw_list = item.draw_list
3012    except AttributeError:
3013        draw_list = None
3014    if draw_list is not None:
3015        if callable(draw_list):
3016            raise TypeError(
3017                "item.draw_list must be a list of drawables and/or functions."
3018            )
3019        draw_widget(self, item, **kwargs)
3020        return self
3021
3022    # check if the item has any points
3023    if not item:
3024        return self
3025
3026    if item.type is Types.LATTICE:
3027        raise TypeError("Cannot draw a Lattice. Draw lattice.pattern instead.")
3028
3029    if vector_draw.is_vector_marker_shape(item, kwargs):
3030        vector_draw.draw_vector_marker_shape(self, item, kwargs)
3031        return self
3032
3033    active_sketches = self.active_page.sketches
3034    subtype = item.subtype
3035    tag_formula = (
3036        _tag_latex_formula(item.text) if subtype == Types.TAG else None
3037    )
3038    if item.type is not Types.CLIPPING and tag_formula is None:
3039        extend_vertices(self, item)
3040
3041    if subtype in _GEOMETRIC_GRID_TYPES:
3042        draw_geometric_grid(self, item, **kwargs)
3043        return self
3044
3045    if subtype == Types.PATH2D and kwargs.get("handles", False):
3046        handle_size = runtime_defaults["handle_marker_size"]
3047        half_size = handle_size / 2
3048        for handle in item.handles:
3049            if not handle:
3050                continue
3051            _extend_canvas_space_points(self, handle)
3052
3053            # square handle markers at segment endpoints (3x3)
3054            for x, y in (handle[0], handle[-1]):
3055                _extend_canvas_space_points(
3056                    self,
3057                    [
3058                        (x - half_size, y - half_size),
3059                        (x + half_size, y - half_size),
3060                        (x + half_size, y + half_size),
3061                        (x - half_size, y + half_size),
3062                    ],
3063                )
3064    elif subtype in (Types.BEZIER, Types.Q_BEZIER) and kwargs.get(
3065        "handles", False
3066    ):
3067        handle_size = runtime_defaults["handle_marker_size"]
3068        half_size = handle_size / 2
3069        for handle in _bezier_handle_segments(item):
3070            _extend_canvas_space_points(self, handle)
3071            for x, y in (handle[0], handle[-1]):
3072                _extend_canvas_space_points(
3073                    self,
3074                    [
3075                        (x - half_size, y - half_size),
3076                        (x + half_size, y - half_size),
3077                        (x + half_size, y + half_size),
3078                        (x - half_size, y + half_size),
3079                    ],
3080                )
3081
3082    if subtype == Types.ANNOTATION:
3083        kwargs = _style_annotation(item, kwargs)
3084    if subtype in (Types.GROUP, Types.STAR, Types.ANNOTATION, Types.DCEL):
3085        group_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
3086        if kwargs.get("vertex_on_hull") and "_group_hull_points" not in kwargs:
3087            group_kwargs["_group_hull_points"] = convex_hull(
3088                item.all_vertices, on_edge=True
3089            )
3090        index_requested = False
3091        face_index_requested = False
3092        if subtype == Types.DCEL:
3093            if "indices" in group_kwargs:
3094                index_requested = bool(group_kwargs["indices"])
3095                del group_kwargs["indices"]
3096            if "face_indices" in group_kwargs:
3097                face_index_requested = bool(group_kwargs["face_indices"])
3098                del group_kwargs["face_indices"]
3099        if subtype == Types.GROUP and group_kwargs.get("non_zero"):
3100            compound_path = group_to_nonzero_path(item)
3101            active_sketches.extend(
3102                get_sketches(compound_path, self, **group_kwargs)
3103            )
3104        else:
3105            for group_item in item:
3106                if subtype == Types.DCEL and group_item is item.outer_face:
3107                    continue
3108                draw(self, group_item, **group_kwargs)
3109            if subtype == Types.DCEL:
3110                for edge in item.edges:
3111                    if edge.half_edge is None:
3112                        continue
3113                    left, right = edge.adjacent_faces()
3114                    if left is not right:
3115                        continue
3116                    draw(self, edge, **group_kwargs)
3117                if index_requested:
3118                    points = [vertex.point for vertex in item.vertices]
3119                    index_style: dict[str, object] = {
3120                        "fill": False,
3121                        "stroke": False,
3122                        "indices": True,
3123                    }
3124                    for key in kwargs:
3125                        if key == "indices" or key.startswith("index_"):
3126                            index_style[key] = kwargs[key]
3127                    if points:
3128                        draw(self, Shape(points), **index_style)
3129                if face_index_requested:
3130                    tag_kwargs: dict[str, object] = {}
3131                    if "index_font_size" in kwargs:
3132                        tag_kwargs["font_size"] = kwargs["index_font_size"]
3133                    if "index_font_color" in kwargs:
3134                        tag_kwargs["font_color"] = kwargs["index_font_color"]
3135                    if "index_font_family" in kwargs:
3136                        tag_kwargs["font_family"] = kwargs["index_font_family"]
3137                    for index, face in enumerate(item.faces):
3138                        if face is item.outer_face:
3139                            continue
3140                        tag_obj = Tag(str(index), face.midpoint, **tag_kwargs)
3141                        tag_obj.draw_frame = False
3142                        draw(self, tag_obj)
3143    elif subtype == Types.FACE and item.inner_boundaries:
3144        # Holes belong to the face; same path as canvas.draw(group, non_zero=True).
3145        if item.mesh is None:
3146            raise ValueError("face with holes is not linked to a DCEL")
3147        outer_points = [vertex.point for vertex in item.boundary_vertices()]
3148        rings = [Shape(outer_points, closed=True)]
3149        outer_area = polygon_area(outer_points)
3150        for cycle in item.mesh.holes(item):
3151            points = [vertex.point for vertex in cycle]
3152            # group_to_nonzero_path reverses non-outer rings; feed matching
3153            # winding (DCEL hole cycles are opposite the outer).
3154            if polygon_area(points) * outer_area < 0:
3155                points = list(reversed(points))
3156            rings.append(Shape(points, closed=True))
3157        hole_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
3158        hole_kwargs["non_zero"] = True
3159        draw(self, Group(rings), **hole_kwargs)
3160    elif subtype in regular_sketch_types:
3161        sketches = get_sketches(item, self, **kwargs)
3162        if sketches:
3163            active_sketches.extend(sketches)
3164            if (
3165                "midpoints" in kwargs
3166                and kwargs["midpoints"]
3167                and isinstance(item, Shape)
3168            ):
3169                midpoint_indices = "indices" in kwargs and bool(
3170                    kwargs["indices"]
3171                )
3172                edge_midpoints = item.edge_midpoints
3173                if edge_midpoints and midpoint_indices:
3174                    label_source = sketches[0]
3175                    marker_radius = runtime_defaults["midpoint_radius"]
3176                    midpoint_markers = Shape(
3177                        edge_midpoints,
3178                        closed=False,
3179                        draw_markers=True,
3180                        markers_only=True,
3181                        marker_type=MarkerType.CIRCLE,
3182                        marker_radius=marker_radius,
3183                        marker_size=marker_radius,
3184                        marker_color=sketch_label_font_color(
3185                            label_source, "index"
3186                        ),
3187                        fill=False,
3188                        stroke=True,
3189                    )
3190                    draw(self, midpoint_markers)
3191    elif subtype == Types.IMAGE:
3192        draw_image(self, item, **kwargs)
3193    elif subtype == Types.PATTERN:
3194        draw_pattern(self, item, **kwargs)
3195    elif subtype in (
3196        Types.ALIGNED_DIMENSION,
3197        Types.ANGULAR_DIMENSION,
3198        Types.DIMENSION,
3199    ):
3200        draw_dimension(self, item, **kwargs)
3201    elif subtype == Types.ARROW:
3202        active_sketches.append(create_sketch(item.line, self, **kwargs))
3203        for head in item.heads:
3204            active_sketches.append(create_sketch(head, self, **kwargs))
3205    elif subtype == Types.VECTOR:
3206        draw_vector(
3207            self,
3208            item,
3209            draw_items=draw_items,
3210            draw_pos=draw_pos,
3211            **kwargs,
3212        )
3213    elif subtype == Types.LACE:
3214        draw_lace(self, item, **kwargs)
3215    elif subtype == Types.FIGURE:
3216        if getattr(item, "draw_geometry", True) and item.geometry is not None:
3217            draw(self, item.geometry, **kwargs)
3218        if getattr(item, "draw_skin", True) and item.skin is not None:
3219            draw(self, item.skin)
3220    elif subtype == Types.BOUNDING_BOX:
3221        draw_bbox(self, item, **kwargs)
3222    elif subtype == Types.CLIPPING:
3223        target = item.target
3224        clipper = item.clipper
3225        self._sketch_xform_matrix = (
3226            self._sketch_xform_matrix @ self._xform_matrix
3227        )
3228        self.active_page.sketches.append(
3229            get_clipped_sketch(target, clipper, self, **kwargs)
3230        )
3231        extend_vertices(self, clipper)
3232        self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
3233
3234        return self
3235    return self

Draw an item on the canvas.

draw_items and draw_pos are the Canvas.draw call list and its pos. They are removed before any sketch is styled.

Arguments:
  • item: Shape, group, or other drawable.
  • **kwargs: Style overrides applied while drawing.
Returns:

Self: The canvas.

Raises:
  • TypeError: If item is a Lattice. Draw lattice.pattern after expand or populate_unit.
Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> canvas.draw(sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)])) is canvas
True
>>> len(canvas.active_page.sketches)
1
>>> lattice = sg.lattice_p1(40, 40)
>>> _ = lattice.expand(sg.letter_F(), 1)
>>> canvas.draw(lattice)  # doctest: +IGNORE_EXCEPTION_DETAIL
Traceback (most recent call last):
    ...
TypeError: Cannot draw a Lattice. Draw lattice.pattern instead.
>>> mesh = sg.DCEL()
>>> _ = mesh.build_from_polygons([[(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40), (0, 40)]])
>>> dcel_canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> dcel_canvas.draw(mesh) is dcel_canvas
True
>>> len(dcel_canvas.active_page.sketches)
1
>>> labeled = sg.Canvas()
>>> labeled.draw(mesh, face_indices=True) is labeled
True
>>> len(labeled.active_page.sketches)
2
def draw_all_segments( self: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, item: simetri.shapes.shape.Shape | simetri.group.batch.Group, vert_indices: bool = False, **kwargs: object) -> Self: 
3238def draw_all_segments(
3239    self: Canvas,
3240    item: Shape | Group,
3241    vert_indices: bool = False,
3242    **kwargs: object,
3243) -> Self:
3244    """Split edges into segments and draw them with index labels.
3245
3246    Used with loop-finding workflows. When ``vert_indices`` is true,
3247    vertex indices are drawn at endpoints instead of edge indices at
3248    midpoints.
3249
3250    Args:
3251        item: Shape or group whose edges are split and drawn.
3252        vert_indices: Label vertices instead of edges.
3253        **kwargs: Style overrides forwarded to ``draw`` and ``text``.
3254
3255    Returns:
3256        Self: The canvas.
3257
3258    Examples:
3259        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
3260        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
3261        >>> shape = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40), (0, 40)])
3262        >>> canvas.draw_all_segments(shape) is canvas
3263        True
3264    """
3265    segments = all_segments(item)
3266    count = 0
3267    for i, edge in enumerate(segments):
3268        draw(self, Shape(edge), **kwargs)
3269        if vert_indices:
3270            p1, p2 = edge
3271            text(self, f"{count}", p1, **kwargs)
3272            count += 1
3273            text(self, f"{count}", p2, **kwargs)
3274            count += 1
3275        else:
3276            text(self, f"{i}", midpoint(*edge), **kwargs)
3277
3278    return self

def get_clipped_sketch( target: Union[simetri.base.core.Base, simetri.group.batch.Group, simetri.shapes.shape.Shape, simetri.helpers.illustration.Tag, simetri.geom.segments.line_utils.Edge], clipper: Union[simetri.base.core.Base, simetri.group.batch.Group, simetri.shapes.shape.Shape, simetri.helpers.illustration.Tag, simetri.geom.segments.line_utils.Edge], canvas: simetri.render.canvas.Canvas, **kwargs: object) -> simetri.render.sketch.ClippedSketch: 
3281def get_clipped_sketch(
3282    target: Drawable,
3283    clipper: Drawable,
3284    canvas: Canvas,
3285    **kwargs: object,
3286) -> ClippedSketch:
3287    """Build a ``ClippedSketch`` for a target clipped by ``clipper``.
3288
3289    Args:
3290        target: Drawable content to clip (shape or group).
3291        clipper: Drawable used as the clipping path.
3292        canvas: Canvas providing transform context.
3293        **kwargs: Style overrides for target sketches.
3294
3295    Returns:
3296        ClippedSketch: Composite sketch with clipper attached.
3297
3298    Examples:
3299        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
3300        >>> from simetri.render.draw import get_clipped_sketch
3301        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
3302        >>> target = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)])
3303        >>> clipper = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (20, 0), (20, 20)])
3304        >>> clipped = get_clipped_sketch(target, clipper, canvas)
3305        >>> clipped.subtype.name
3306        'CLIPPED_SKETCH'
3307    """
3308    if target.type == Types.GROUP:
3309        sketches = [get_sketches(item, canvas, **kwargs) for item in target]
3310    else:
3311        sketches = [get_sketches(target, canvas, **kwargs)]
3312    clipper = get_sketches(clipper, canvas)
3313    return ClippedSketch(sketches=sketches, clipper=clipper)

3321    """Create sketches from the given item and return them as a list.

3388def set_shape_sketch_style(
3389    sketch: Sketch,

3392    linear: bool = False,
3393    **kwargs: object,
3394) -> None:
3395    """Set the style properties of the sketch.
3396
3397    Args:
3398        sketch: Sketch object (mutated).
3399        item: Item whose style properties are to be set.
3400        canvas: Canvas object.
3401        linear (bool, optional): Whether the style is linear. Defaults to False.
3402        **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments.
3403
3404    Examples:
3405        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
3406        >>> from simetri.render.draw import create_sketch, set_shape_sketch_style
3407        >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()

3409        >>> sketch = create_sketch(shape, canvas)
3410        >>> set_shape_sketch_style(sketch, shape, canvas)
3411        >>> sketch.visible
3412        True
3413    """
3414    if linear:
3415        style_map = line_style_map
3416    else:
3417        style_map = shape_style_map
3418
3419    resolved_style = canvas.resolve_style_properties(item, style_map, **kwargs)
3420
3421    for attrib_name, attrib_value in resolved_style.items():
3422        setattr(sketch, attrib_name, attrib_value)
3423
3424    sketch.visible = item.visible
3425    sketch.closed = item.closed
3426    # fill and stroke are resolved through resolve_property in the loop above
3427
3428    # Copy tile_svg (direct shape property, not style attribute)
3429    if hasattr(item, "tile_svg"):
3430        sketch.tile_svg = item.tile_svg
3431
3432    # Copy clip and mask for clipping support
3433    if hasattr(item, "clip"):
3434        sketch.clip = item.clip
3435    if hasattr(item, "mask"):
3436        sketch.mask = item.mask
3437    if "_mask_opacity" in item.__dict__:
3438        sketch._mask_opacity = item._mask_opacity
3439    if "_mask_stops" in item.__dict__:
3440        sketch._mask_stops = item._mask_stops
3441    if "_mask_axis" in item.__dict__:
3442        sketch._mask_axis = item._mask_axis
3443
3444    if hasattr(item, "even_odd") and item.even_odd is not None:
3445        sketch.even_odd = item.even_odd
3446    elif "non_zero" in kwargs and kwargs["non_zero"] is not None:
3447        use_nonzero = bool(kwargs["non_zero"])
3448        sketch.even_odd = not use_nonzero
3449        sketch.fill_mode = FillMode.NONZERO if use_nonzero else FillMode.EVENODD
3450
3451    for k, v in kwargs.items():
3452        if k in _PRESEDENCE_KEYS or k in _NON_STYLE_KEYS:
3453            continue
3454
3455        setattr(sketch, k, v)
3456
3457    if sketch.draw_markers:
3458        for name in (
3459            "marker_alpha",
3460            "marker_color",
3461            "marker_line_style",
3462            "marker_line_width",
3463            "marker_radius",
3464            "marker_size",
3465            "marker_type",
3466        ):
3467            if name not in sketch.__dict__ or sketch.__dict__[name] is None:
3468                setattr(sketch, name, runtime_defaults[name])
3469
3470    if "_group_hull_points" in kwargs:
3471        sketch._group_hull_points = kwargs["_group_hull_points"]
3472
3473    if "indices" in kwargs:
3474        sketch.indices = kwargs["indices"]
3475    elif "indices" in item.__dict__:
3476        sketch.indices = item.indices
3477
3478    if "midpoints" in kwargs:
3479        sketch.midpoints = kwargs["midpoints"]
3480
3481    if "index_font_size" in kwargs:
3482        sketch.index_font_size = kwargs["index_font_size"]
3483    elif "index_font_size" in item.__dict__:
3484        sketch.index_font_size = item.index_font_size
3485
3486    if (
3487        kwargs.get("vertices")
3488        or kwargs.get("vertex_on_hull")
3489        or getattr(item, "vertex_on_hull", False)
3490    ):
3491        sketch.show_vertex_coords = True
3492    elif "show_vertex_coords" in item.__dict__:
3493        sketch.show_vertex_coords = item.show_vertex_coords
3494
3495    if "vertex_on_hull" in kwargs:
3496        sketch.vertex_on_hull = kwargs["vertex_on_hull"]
3497    elif "vertex_on_hull" in item.__dict__:
3498        sketch.vertex_on_hull = item.vertex_on_hull
3499
3500    if "vertex_font_size" in kwargs:
3501        sketch.vertex_font_size = kwargs["vertex_font_size"]
3502    elif "vertex_font_size" in item.__dict__:
3503        sketch.vertex_font_size = item.vertex_font_size
3504
3505    if "index_offset" in kwargs:
3506        sketch.index_offset = kwargs["index_offset"]
3507    elif "index_offset" in item.__dict__:
3508        sketch.index_offset = item.index_offset
3509
3510    if "vertex_offset" in kwargs:
3511        sketch.vertex_offset = kwargs["vertex_offset"]
3512    elif "vertex_offset" in item.__dict__:
3513        sketch.vertex_offset = item.vertex_offset
3514
3515    if "index_font_color" in kwargs:
3516        sketch.index_font_color = kwargs["index_font_color"]
3517    elif "index_font_color" in item.__dict__:
3518        sketch.index_font_color = item.index_font_color
3519
3520    if "vertex_font_color" in kwargs:
3521        sketch.vertex_font_color = kwargs["vertex_font_color"]
3522    elif "vertex_font_color" in item.__dict__:
3523        sketch.vertex_font_color = item.vertex_font_color
3524
3525    if "index_font_family" in kwargs:
3526        sketch.index_font_family = kwargs["index_font_family"]
3527    elif "index_font_family" in item.__dict__:
3528        sketch.index_font_family = item.index_font_family
3529
3530    if "vertex_font_family" in kwargs:

3534

3537

3542    ):

def get_verts_in_new_pos( item: simetri.shapes.shape.Shape, **kwargs: object) -> list[Sequence[float]]: 
3546def get_verts_in_new_pos(item: Shape, **kwargs: object) -> list[PointType]:
3547    """Return the item's vertices, translated when ``pos`` is given.
3548
3549    Args:
3550        item: Item whose vertices are read.
3551        **kwargs: ``pos`` is the new midpoint. Other keys are ignored
3552            by this function.
3553
3554    Returns:
3555        list: Vertices in the new position, or the item's current
3556        vertices when ``pos`` is not given.
3557
3558    Examples:
3559        >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
3560        >>> shape = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (80, 0), (80, 80)])
3561        >>> get_verts_in_new_pos(shape, pos=(60, 40))[0]
3562        [20.0, 0.0]
3563    """
3564    if "pos" in kwargs:
3565        x, y = item.midpoint[:2]
3566        x1, y1 = kwargs["pos"][:2]
3567        dx = x1 - x
3568        dy = y1 - y
3569        trans_mat = translation_matrix(dx, dy)
3570        vertices = item.primary_points.homogen_coords @ trans_mat
3571        vertices = vertices[:, :2].tolist()
3572    else:
3573        vertices = item.vertices
3574
3575    return vertices

  • **kwargs: pos is the new midpoint. Other keys are ignored by this function.
Returns:

list: Vertices in the new position, or the item's current vertices when pos is not given.

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> shape = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (80, 0), (80, 80)])
>>> get_verts_in_new_pos(shape, pos=(60, 40))[0]
[20.0, 0.0]

Create a sketch from the given item.

Arguments:
  • item: Item to be sketched.
  • canvas: Canvas object.
  • **kwargs: Style overrides forwarded to subtype sketch builders.
Returns:

A single sketch, a list of sketches, or None when invisible.

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> from simetri.render.draw import create_sketch
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> shape = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)])
>>> create_sketch(shape, canvas) is not None
True
